notesStmt.note:
MUKTABODHA INDOLOGICAL RESEARCH INSTITUTEUse of this material (e-texts) is covered by Creative Commons license BY-NC 4.0. Catalog number : M00309 Uniform title: bhuvaneśvarīmahāstotra Author : pṛthavīdharācārya Commentator : Kavi Padmanābha Editor : Gopal Narayan Bahura Description: Description by Mark S.G. Dyczkowski: The Bhuvaneśvarīmahāstotra by Pṛthavīdharācārya with a commentary by Kavi Padmanābha edited by Gopal Narayan Bahura
Under this title the editor presents a collection of texts related to Bhuvaneśvarī and her worship drawn from several manuscripts. They are:
1) Bhuvaneśvarīmahāstotra by Pṛthavīdharācārya with a commentary by Kavi PadmanAbha.
2) Rudrayāmalīyabhuvaneśvarīpañcāṅga
This is a chapter (paṭala) of the Daśavidyārahasya which said to be part of the Rudrayāmala
3) Bhuvaneśvarīpūjāpaddhatiḥ
This is the regular rite of the worship (nityapūjanapaddhati) of Bhuvaneśvarī drawn from the Daśavidyārahasya
4) Bhuvaneśvarīkavaca called Trailokyamaṅgala attributed to the Rudrayāmala.
3) Bhuvaneśvarīsahasranāmastotram attributed to the Rudrayāmala
4) Bhuvaneśvaryaṣṭottaraśatanāmastotram attributed to the Rudrayāmala
5) Bhuvaneśvaryaṣṭakam
6) Bhuvaneśvarīsahasranāmastotram attributed to the Mahātantrārṇava
7) Bhuvaneśvarīhṛdayastotram attributed to the Nīlasarasvatītantra
8) Bhuvaneśvarīstotram attributed to the Rudrayāmala
9) A text by Pṛthvīdharācārya with a commentary called Bhuvaneśvarīkramacandrikā by Anantadeva of Mātṛpura who belonged to the lineage of Dāyīdeva. There are three chapters (kalpa) dealing with the daily rites dedicated to the goddess Bhuvaneśvarī.
10) Laghusaptaśatīstotram. A short hymn to caṇḍikā based on the Durgāsaptaśatī by Pṛthvīdharācārya
In his introduction the editor presents Pṛthvīdharācārya as a direct disciple of śaṅkarācārya whom he dates as belonging to the ninth century. Although Pṛthvīdharācārya may have been a sannyasin belonging to that order, it is not possible for him to have been so early. Bhuvaneśvarī is one of the Ten Mahāvidyās. Indeed two of the texts in this collection is the chapter (paṭala) of the Daśavidyārahasya, said to be a part of the Rudrayāmala. Four more are attributed to the Rudrayāmala directly. The practice of attributing revelation to this work is common in the later period. Nīlasarasvatītantra is certainly late as is mot probably the Mahātantrārṇava. The grouping and worship of the ten goddesses that constitutes the Ten Mahāvidyā is very popular in North India where temples and shrines to them are found in several cities in the North and even in the Kathmandu Valley. However, although the goddesses are known in the South they are not worshipped there as members of this group. The texts where they appear together are not earlier than the 15th century and their introduction into Nepal is probably later. Notes: Revision 0: November 13, 2014
Data-entered by the staff of Muktabodha under the supervision of Mark S.G. Dyczkowski. Publisher : Rajasthan Oriental Research Institute Publication year : 1960 Publication city : Jodhapur Publication country : India

text.body:
śrīḥ
[sakalāgamācāryacakravarttiśrīpṛthvīdharācāryaviracitam
bhuvaneśvarīmahāstotram
kavipadmanābhaviracitabhāṣyavibhūṣitam]
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
oṃ cañcanamauktikahemamaṇḍanayutā mātā'tiraktāmbarā tanvaṅgī nayanatrayātirucirā bālārkavadbhāsurā | yā divyāṅkuśapāśabhūṣitakarā devī sadā bhītihā cittasthā bhuvaneśvarī bhavatu naḥ seyaṃ mudaḥ (de) sarvadā (kh: padyasyāsya; g: pratyornopalabdhiḥ) || 1 ||
karṇasvarṇavilolakuṇḍaladharāmāpīnavakṣoruhāṃ muktāhāravibhūṣaṇāṃ parilasaddhammillasanmallikām | līlālolitalocanāṃ śaśimukhīmābaddhakāñcīsrajaṃ dīvyantīṃ bhuvaneśvarīmanudinaṃ vandāmahe mātaram || 2 ||
atha satāmudanyādimahormivelākulitasya (g: satāṃ dainyādimohormimālākulitasya) sakalendriyamakarakuṇḍalavat (g: maṇḍalacaṭuladuravagāhanasya) duravagāhasyānavarataprabhūtībhavanmohamahābhramasya (g: mahāmohabhramasya) saṃsāravārāṃnidheḥ prataraṇāya satpotamivasakalasampadāmāspadamiva yasyāḥ prasādamāsādya caturacaturānano'pi sargādau nikhilanigamāgamoditāśca vidyāḥ (kh: caturdaśavidyāḥ; g: nikhilanigamādividyāḥ) sadyo'ṅkurayāñcakārāmbhojanābhimiva (g: samaṅkurayāñcakāra;. kh, g: tāṃ jananīmiva) sambhāvanodyatāṃ kalpavallīmivābhimataphaladānadakṣāṃ ruciracaraṇasaṅkramaṇataḥ (g: saṃkramaṇayā) karuṇayā vasundharāmabhisanāthayantīmiva (kh: saṃnāthayamānāmiva)
caraṇaraṇanmaṇimayamañjīrāṃ (kh: caraṇaraṇanmaṇimayamañjīrādikasakalacaraṇābharaṇamaṇḍitaṃ; g: raṇanmaṇimayamañjīrādicaraṇābharaṇamaṇḍitāṃ) vararaśanollasatkiṅkiṇīkulakvāṇakalitāṃ picchalāṃ nāvasthitodakabimbavadavabhāsamānā (kh: pippaladalāntāvasthitodakabinduvadavabhāsamānāṃ; g: picchila.....bhāsamānāṃ) mamalamuktāphalaprakarahāravibhūṣitapīnonnatapayodharāṃ navamadhukakusumasuṣamātiraskārakārikaracaraṇakapolayugalapratibimbita(##-) kalaravakapotayugalapratibimbitacārucāmikarakuṇḍalāṃ; g: navabandhūkakusumanikurambatiraskārakārivarakapolayugalapratibimbitacāru(##-) sphuranmahāmaulimāṇikyavirājamānāṃ bhuvaneśāmabhivandya (kh, g: bhuvaneśānīmabhivandya) sakalāgamācāryacakravarttipṛthvīdharācāryaviracitamahāstotrasya yathācāhaṃ (kh: yathāmati) bālaprabodhinīṃ sakalavimalapadadīpikāṃ ṭīkāṃ viracayāmīti (kh: pratijānīte padmanābhapaṇḍitaṣṭīkākāraḥ) ||
aiṃdavyā kalayāvataṃsitaśiro vistāri nādātmakaṃ tadrūpaṃ janani smarāmi paramaṃ sanmātramekaṃ (g: cinmātraṃ) tava | yatrodeti parābhiddhā bhagavatī bhāsāṃ hi tāsāṃ padaṃ paśyantīmanumadhyamā viharati svairaṃ ca sā vaikharī || 1 ||
aiṃdavyeti(-) he janani tava tat rūpaṃ smarāmi aharaho (kh: ahaṃ raho) dhyāyāmi kimbhūtaṃ tava tadrūpaṃ avataṃsitaśiraḥ avataṃsitaṃ śekharīkṛtaṃ śiro mūrddhā yasya tat tathā | kayā indoriyaṃ aiṃdavī tayā aiṃdavyā (g: indusambandhinyā) kalayā | punaḥ kimbhūtaṃ tava rūpaṃ vistāri vistāro'syāstīti vistāri sarvavyāpakamityarthaḥ | punaḥ kimbhūtaṃ (g: sanmātraṃ sattāmātraṃ nādātmakaṃ uccāraṇakāle nādavat) nādātmakaṃ nādasvarūpaṃ uccāraṇakāle nādavat | punaḥ kimbhūtaṃ paramaṃ parā utkṛṣṭā mā śobhā yasya tat paramaṃ prakṛṣṭamityarthaḥ (g: paramamutkṛṣṭamityarthaḥ) | punaḥ kimbhūtaṃ sanmātraṃ sadbhāvarūpamiti yāvat | aparaṃ kimbhūtaṃ ekaṃ advitīyam | he viśveśvari (kh: he janani) yatra yasmin tava rūpe parābhidhā parāsaṃjñā (g: tat saṃjñā) vāṇī udeti udayaṃ prāpnoti kimbhūtā vāṇī (sā) bhagavatī ṣaḍaiśvaryajñānavatī bhagorkajñānamāhātmyaṃ (g: bhagorkaḥ bhago jñānamityanekārthadarśanāt) iti cānekārthaśravaṇāt |
punaḥ kiṃvidhā parābhidhā bhāsāṃ hi tāsāṃ padaṃ hi niścitaṃ tat tāsāṃ prasiddhānāṃ bhāsāṃ dīptīnāṃ padaṃ sthānaṃ tataḥ parābhidhāyāḥ paśyaṃtī vāk viharati punaḥ paśyaṃtīmanu paścānmadhyamā vāg viharati tataḥ svairaṃ svecchayā cāṣṭasthānaviśadīkṛtā seti (kh: satī; g: ceti) sarvaprasiddhā vaikharī vāg viharati | atha ca manoḥpakṣe aiṃdavyā kalayāvataṃsitaśiro iti candrārdhānukāri (kh, g: candrānukāri cālikhyate) lakṣyate | tataḥ vistāri prapañco māyā yasyā'stīti tataḥ vistāri māyābījamiti niṣkṛṣṭārthaḥ | tadanu nādātmakaṃ nādaśabdenātra binduranusvāro'bhidhīyate tena sahitamiti sānusvāraṃ hrīmiti yāvat |
atha vaikharyāḥ sātiśayaṃ mahimānamunmīlayan aparavṛttamāha(-)
ādikṣāntavilāsalālasatayā tāsāṃ turīyā tu (g: ca) yā kroḍīkṛtya jagattrayaṃ vijayate vedādividyāmayī | tāṃ vācaṃ mayi saṃprasādaya sudhākallolakolāhala(-) krīḍākarṇanavarṇanīyakavitāsāmrājyasiddhipradām || 2 ||
ādīti(-) he mātaḥ sakaleśvari tu iti vyavacchede tāsāṃ pūrvoktānāṃ parāpaśyantīmadhyamāvaikharīlakṣaṇānāṃ vācāṃ madhye turīyā caturthī vāk vaikharīlakṣaṇā sā jagattrayaṃ bhuvanatritayaṃ (trayaṃ) kroḍīkṛtya abhivyāpya vijayate sarvotkarṣeṇa varttate | kayā kṛtvā ādikṣāntavilāsalālasatayā ādayaḥ akārādayaḥ kṣāntāḥ kṣakārāntāḥ ye varṇāsteṣāṃ yo vilāso vilasanaṃ tasya yā lālasatā uccāraṇaviśeṣaḥ tayā ādikṣāntavilāsalālasatayā viśvamakhilamabhivyāpya varttata ityarthaḥ | kimbhūtā sā turīyā (vaikha)rī vedādividyāmayī vedādayo yā vidyāḥ tāḥ svarūpaṃ yasyāḥ sā tathā he janani tāṃ turīyāṃ vaikharīṃ (kh: vaikharīlakṣaṇāṃ) vācaṃ mayi viṣaye samprasādaya samyak prasādaṃ vidhāya utpādaya | kimbhūtāṃ vācaṃ suddhākallolakolāhalakrīḍākarṇanavarṇanīyakavitāsāmrājyasiddhipradāṃ sudhāyāḥ pīyūṣasya kallolā laharyasteṣāṃ yaḥ kolāhalaḥ kalaravaḥ tasya yā krīḍā khelanaṃ tasyāḥ yadākarṇanaṃ tadvadvarṇanīyā stutyā yā kavitā tasyāḥ yā sāmrājyasiddhiḥ svacchandavihāriṇī (g: svacchandā vihāriṇāṃ siddhiḥ) siddhistāṃ prakarṣeṇa dadātīti tathā tām || 2 ||
athedānīṃ viśiṣṭavāgbhavasya mahimānamāha(-)
kalpādau kamalāsano'pi kalayā viddhaḥ kayācit kila tvāṃ dhyātvā'ṅkurayāñcakāra caturo vedāśca vidyāśca tāḥ | tanmātarlalite prasīda saralaṃ sārasvataṃ dehi me yasyāmodamudīrayanti pulakairantargatā devatāḥ || 3 ||
kalpādāviti(-) he mātaḥ janani kila iti satye (kh: satyaṃ) kalpādau sṛṣṭerādau kamalāsanopi brahmāpi tvāṃ dhyātvā caturo vedān punaśca tāḥ vidyāścarurdaśa aṅkurayāñcakāra prakaṭīkṛtavān kimbhūtaḥ kamalāsano'pi niścayena kayācit kalayā viddhaḥ syūtaḥ punaḥ kimbhūtaḥ vā catura iti brahmaṇo viśeṣaṇam | he mātaḥ tataḥ kāraṇāt tvaṃ prasīda prasādaṃ kuru me mahyaṃ saralaṃ sārasvataṃ dehi saśca raśca laśca sarvo dvandvo vibhāṣayaikavaditi etairvarṇaiḥ sahitamiti yāvat athavā saralamiti prāñjalaṃ kevalaṃ vāgbhavameva aiṃkārarūpamityarthaḥ | he lalite etanmahimānaṃ vāgbhavarūpaṃ manuṃ mayi prasārayeti prārthanā | aparaṃ he viśveśvari yasya vāgbhavāmodaṃ (kh: me mahyaṃ sārasvataṃ dehi saralaṃ arthāvagamamādhuryādiguṇaviśiṣṭaṃ na tu vaiṣamyādyupahataṃ) yasyāmodamudīrayanti pulakairantargatā devatā yasya vāgbhavasya āmodaṃ mahimāna antarmadhye sthitā devatā ātmāprabhṛtaya udīrayanti kaiḥ pulakaiḥ romāñcairiti yāvat || 3 ||
atha bhagavatyā bījāṃtaradhyāne phalamāha(-)
mātardehabhṛtāmaho dhṛtimayī nādaikarekhāmayī sā tvaṃ prāṇamayī hutāśanamayī bindupratiṣṭhāmayī | tena tvāṃ bhuvaneśvarīṃ vijayinīṃ dhyāyāmi jāyāṃ vibho(-) stvatkāruṇyavikāśa (si) puṇyamatayaḥ khelantu me sūktayaḥ || 4 ||
mātariti(-) aho iti sambodhane (kh: sambodhanaṃ) he mātaḥ sā tvaṃ dehabhṛtāṃ śarīriṇāṃ evaṃvidhā vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇā varttase tena kāraṇena vibhormahādevasya (kh: vibhoḥ śrīmahādevasya) jāyāṃ kuṭumbinīṃ bhuvaneśvarīṃ dhyāyāmi | kimbhūtāṃ tvāṃ vijayinīṃ vijayanaśīlāṃ ata eva me sūktayaḥ śobhanā vācaḥ khelantu navanavagadyapadyakaraṇodyame (kh: navanavāḥ gadyapadyamayyaḥ me sūktayaḥ khelantu vilasantvityarthaḥ navanavagadyapadyasadyaḥ karaṇodyamāṃ) dīvyantu | kimbhūtāḥ suktayaḥ rvatkāruṇyavikāsipuṇyamatayaḥ
tvatkāruṇyena tvatkaruṇaya vikāśinī (kh: vikāśī) prakāśaśīlā unmīlayantī (g: unmīlantī) puṇyā pavitrā matiryāsāṃ tāstathā | kimbhūtā tvaṃ dhṛtimayī (kh: dhṛtirdhāraṇāvatībuddhistanmayī) dhṛtirekārastanmayī (g: dhṛtirīkārastanmayī) aparaṃ kimbhūtā tvaṃ nādaikarekhāmayī nādaśabdenātra ukāro gṛhyate (kh: nādaśabdena anusvāro vidhīyate; g: oṃkāro vidhīyate) tasya ekā rekhā candrakalā tanmayī punaḥ kimbhūtā prāṇamayī prāṇo hakārastanmayī punaḥ kimbhūtā hutāśanamayī hutāśano rephastanmayī punaḥ kimbhūtā bindupratiṣṭhāmayī binduranusvārastasya pratiṣṭhā āropaṇaṃ tanmayī hṛīṃ bhavati manuḥ | iha dhṛtimayītyādiṣu sarvaviśeṣaṇeṣu (kh: dhṛtimayyādiviśeṣaṇeṣu mayaḍvidhānaṃ tattanmayattvajñāpanārtham) svarūpārthe mayaḍvidhārthābhidhānaṃ || 4 ||
athedānīṃ yantroddhāramāha (kh: yantroddhāraṇamāha)
tvāmaśvatthadalānukāramadhurāmādhārabaddhodarāṃ (g: baddhodarīṃ) saṃseve bhuvaneśvarīmanudinaṃ vāgdevatāmeva tām | tanme śāradakaumudīparicayāmodaṃ suddhāsāgara(-) (kh, g: paricayodañcatsudhāsāgara) svairojjāgaravīcivibhramajito dīvyantu divyā giraḥ || 5 ||
tvāmiti(-) he janani(!) anudinaṃ dinaṃ dinaṃ anulakṣyīkṛtya (kh: dinaṃdinamadurlabhīkṛtya) tāṃ tvāṃ vāgdevatāmeva bhuvaneśvarīṃ saṃseve samyagārādhayāmi | tataḥkāraṇāt me mama divyā giro vāṇyaḥ dīvyantu krīḍantu | kimbhūtā giraḥ śāradakaumudīparicarāmodaṃ (paricayodañcat) sudhāsāgarasvairojjāgaravīcivibhramajitaḥ śaradi bhavā śāradī śāradī cāsau kaumudī ca śāradakaumudī ityatra striyāḥ puṃvadbhāṣitapuṃskāditi puṃvadbhāve pūrvapadasya lopaḥ tasyāyaṃ paricayaḥ paridarśanaṃ (kh: tasyā yaḥ paricayo darśanam) tena udañcadudvelībhavat (kh: yaḥ) sudhāsāgaraḥ pīyūṣavāridhistasya svairaṃ svecchayā yā ujjāgarāḥ śabdāyamānā vīcayo laharyastāsāṃ yo vibhramo vilāsastaṃ jayantīti tathā kimbhūtāṃ tvāṃ aśvatthadalānukāramadhurāṃ aśvatthadalānukāreṇa pippaladalasadṛśatayā madhurāṃ trikoṇamadhurāmityarthaḥ (kh: manoharā; g: trikoṇena manoharāmityarthaḥ) | ādhārabaddhodarāṃ ādhāre (kh, g: ādhāreṇa) ṣaṭkoṇena baddhodarāṃ racitanilayāṃ etāvatā pūrvaṃ trikoṇamālikhya
tataḥ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vidhāya tasyānu paścāddinaṃ aṣṭapraharamānatayā (g: aṣṭapraharamāpātatayā) aṣṭadalakamalamiti saṃketitaṃ bhavati (kh: saṃbhavati) tato vāṅmayaṃ (kh: vāgbhavaṃ) bījaṃ candrakalānusvārasahitaṃ tanmadhye vilikhediti yantroddhāravidhiḥ || 5 ||
athedānīṃ parameśvaryā dhyānamāha(-)
lekhaprastutavedyavastusurabhiśrīpustakottaṃsito mātaḥ svastikṛdastu me tava karo vāmo'bhirāmaḥ śriyā | sadyo vidrumakandalīsaralatāsandohasāndrā'ṅguli(-) (kh: sāndrā'ṅgulī) rmudrāṃ bodhamayīṃ dadhat tadaparopyāstāmapāstabhramaḥ || 6 ||
lekheti(-) he mātaḥ tava vāmakaro me mama svastikṛdastu śubhakaro (g: śubhakārako) bhavatu | kimbhūto vāmakaraḥ lekhaprastutavedyavastusurabhiśrīpustakottaṃsahitaḥ lekhena yatprastutavedyaṃ prastutajñāpyaṃ (kh: yatprastutaṃ vedyaṃ jñāpyaṃ) vastu tatpratipādakaṃ surabhiśriyā (kh: tena yatsurabhiḥ saugandhyaṃ tadrūpā yā śrīstayā) manoharakāntyā sahitaṃ yatpustakaṃ tenottaṃsito maṇḍitaḥ (g: sahitaḥ) | punaḥ kimbhūtaḥ śriyā abhirāmaḥ śobhayā manoharaḥ (kh: śobhāmanoharaḥ) tadaparo dakṣiṇakaraḥ sadyastatkālameva me mama apāstabhramaḥ āstāṃ nirākṛtabhrāntirbhavatu | kiṃ kurvan bodhamayīṃ mudrāṃ dadhat | punaḥ kimbhūtaḥ vidrumakandalīsandohasāndrāṃguliḥ vidrumakandalyāḥ pravālalatāyāḥ saralatāsaṃdohaḥ prāñjalatā vilāsastadvat sāndrā manoharā (kh: prāñjalivilāsastena sāndrāḥ saṃhatā aṇgulayo) aṃgulayo yasya saḥ tathā iti dvayorapi viśeṣaṇaṃ || 6 ||
atha bhagavatyāḥ kṛpābhavavīkṣaṇena prārthannāha(-) (kh, g: kṛpābharavīkṣaṇaṃ saṃprārthayannāha)
mātaḥ pātakajālamūladalanakrīḍākaṭhorā dṛśaḥ kāruṇyāmṛtakomalāstava mayi sphūrjjantu siddhyūrjjitāḥ | ābhiḥ svābhimataprabandhalaharīsākūtakautūhalā(-) 'bhrānta (g: kautūhalā'krānt....) svāntacaturmukhocitaguṇodgārāṃ kariṣye giram || 7 ||
mātariti(-) he mātaḥ tava dṛśo dṛṣṭayo mayi (mama) viśaye sphūrjantu ullasantu | kimbhūtāḥ dṛśaḥ pātakajālamūladalanakrīḍākaṭhorāḥ pātakānāṃ jālaṃ samūhaḥ tasya mūlaṃ kandaḥ tasya dahane vidāraṇe krīḍayā līlayā kaṭhorāḥ punaḥ kimbhūtāḥ kāruṇyāmṛtakomalāḥ kāruṇyaṃ karuṇā tadevā'mṛtaṃ (kh. pīyūṣaṃ) tena komalāḥ (kh, g: mṛdulāḥ) | punaḥ siddhyūrjitāḥ siddhyā (kh, g: tava ārādhanena) ūrjitāḥ preritāḥ (kh, g: he sureśvari ābhirdṛgbhirahaṃ giraṃ vāṇīṃ kariṣye vācaṃ prakaṭayiṣyāmi) kimbhūtāṃ giraṃ svābhimataprabandhalaharīsākūtakautūhalābhrāntasvāntacaturmukhocita(##-) (kh; g: gadyapadyādimayaḥ) tasya yā laharī sphuraṇā tasyāḥ yat sākūtakautūhalaṃ sābhiprāyakautukaṃ tatra ābhrāntaṃ (g: ākrāntaṃ) śliṣṭaṃ śuci yat svāntaṃ manaḥ tena caturmukhasyeva brahmaṇa iva ucitaḥ sadṛśo guṇānāmudgāro (g: udvamanaṃ ghanaprakaṭanaṃ yatra) yasyāḥ sā tathā tām || 7 ||
idānīṃ bhagavatyāḥ yajanavidhānamāha(-)
tvāmādhāracaturdalāmbujagatāṃ vāgbījagarbhe yaje pratyāvṛttibhirādibhiḥ kusumitāṃ māyālatāmunnatām | cūḍāmūlapavitrapatrakamalapreṅkholakhelatsudhā(-) kallolākulacakracaṅkramacamatkāraikalokottarām || 8 ||
tvāmiti(-) he janani(!) tvāṃ vāgbījagarbhe aiṃkāramadhye māyālatāṃ hrīṃkāravallīṃ yaje pūjayāmi kimbhūtāṃ māyālatāṃ ādhāracaturdalāmbujagatāṃ ādhāracakrameva caturdalāmbujaṃ caturdalakamalaṃ tatragatāṃ sthitāṃ (kh, g: saṃsthitāṃ) punaḥ kimbūtāṃ unnatāṃ (kh, g: uccairgatāṃ) punaḥ kimbhūtāṃ ādibhirakārādibhirvarṇaiḥ kusumitāṃ puṣpitāṃ anyāpi latā unnatā satī puṣpitā bhavati | kimbhūtaiḥ ādibhiḥ pratyāvṛttibhiḥ ekaṃ ekaṃ prati āsamantād bhāvena vṛttirvarttanaṃ yeṣāṃ te pratyāvṛttayastaistathā | athavā ādibhirakārādibhiḥ kṣaparyantaiḥ pratyāvṛttibhiḥ lomapratilomabhirvarṇaiḥ kusumitāṃ paramaśobhānvitāmityarthaḥ | yathā hrīṃ aṃ hrīṃ āṃ ityevamādayaḥ kṣaparyantā (kh: saparyantāḥ) varṇāḥ svayamūhanīyāḥ | pratilomato yathā hrīṃ kṣaṃ hrīṃ laṃ hrīṃ saṃ ityādi punaḥ kimbhūtāṃ māyālatāṃ cūḍāmūlapavitrapatrakamalapreṅkholakhelat(##-) brahmarandhre yat pavitrapatrakamalaṃ vimalasahasradalapaṅkajaṃ tatra yaḥ preṅkholakhelaṃtsudhākallolaḥ capalataraṃ khelantī pīyūṣalaharī tenākulaṃ yat cakrākāratvāt cakraṃ patrasamūhaḥ tasya yaḥ caṅkramacamatkāro vilokanacamatkaraṇaṃ (kh: vilomajaṃ camatkaraṇaṃ; g: vilopanacamatkaraṇaṃ) tena lokottarāṃ anirvacanīyām || 8 ||
idānīṃ parameśvaryā ārādhanena phalamāha(-)
so'haṃ tvatkaruṇākaṭākṣaśaraṇaḥ pañcādhvasaṃcārataḥ pratyāhṛtya mano vasāmi rasanā raṅgaṃ mamāliṅgatu | śrīsarvajñavibhūṣaṇīkṛtakalāniṣyandamānāmṛta(-) svacchandasphaṭikādrisāndritapayaḥ śobhāvatī bhāratī || 9 ||
so'hamiti(-) he mātaḥ so'haṃ tava sevakaḥ tvatkaruṇākaṭākṣaśaraṇaḥ san tava dayāpāṅga(-) (kh, g: dayālutā) vīkṣaṇaśaraṇaḥ san vasāmi tiṣṭhāmi kiṃ kṛttvā manaḥ cittaṃ pratyāhṛtya (nirvartya) kasmāt pañcādhvasaṃcārataḥ prāṇādīnāṃ pañcānāmapi vāyūnāṃ (g: ātmanāṃ) pañcādhvasaṃcāraṇāt (kh: tasmāt) pañcamārgasaṃkramaṇāt | yatra ca vātasaṃcaraṇaṃ tatra tatra manaḥ saṃcaraṇamapi śrūyate athavā pañcānāṃ adhvanāṃ mārgāṇāṃ gāṇapatya (kh: gaṇapati) vaiṣṇavasauraśāktika (kh: śākta) śāmbhavānāṃ saṃcārataḥ saṃcaraṇāt (kh: manoniṣṭhavāyuḥ) mano nirvartya yataḥ tvayi eva vasāmi ataḥkāraṇāt bhāratī amararasanā (kh, g: sarasvatī mama rasanā) raṅgaṃ āliṅgatu āśrayatu | kimbhūtā bhāratī śrīsarvajñavibhūṣaṇīkṛtakalāniṣyandamānāmṛtasvacchandasphaṭikādri(##-) śrīsarvajño maheśaḥ (kh: maheśvaraḥ) tasya yā vibhūṣaṇīkṛtakalā (g: candrakalā) tato niṣyandamānaṃ nissarat yadamṛtaṃ pīyūṣaṃ ca svacchando nirāśrayo nirmalo yaḥ sphaṭikādriḥ sa ca tābhyāṃ sāndritaṃ bahulīkṛtaṃ yatpayo dugdha eteṣāmekatrakaraṇe yādṛśī śobhā bhā bhavati tādṛśyeva vidyate yasyāḥ sā tathā athavā śrīsarvajñasya maheśvarasya vibhūṣaṇīkṛtakalāyāḥ candrakalāyāḥ niṣyandamānāmṛtena svacchandasphaṭikādreḥ nirmalasphaṭikaparvatasya sāndritaṃ bahulīkṛtaṃ yatpayo nīraṃ tadvat śobhā yasyāḥ sā tathā yukto'yamarthaḥ | yataścandrakiraṇāḥ pīyūṣaṃ varṣanti (yataścandrakiraṇānāṃ pīyuṣaṃ vartate) taddarśanena ca sphaṭikādrirdravati tadubhayamekībhūya tadvat śobhate tadvat seti piṇḍitārthaḥ || 9 ||
idāniṃ bhagavatyā bījajapasya prakārantaramāha(-)
mātarmātṛkayā vidarbhitamidaṃ garbhīkṛtānāhata(-) svacchandadhvanipeyamadhvani rataṃ candrārkanidrāgirau | saṃseve viparītarītiracanoccārādakārāvadhi svādhīnāmṛtasindhubandhuramaho māyāmayaṃ te mahaḥ || 10 ||
mātariti(-) aho iti sambodhane he mātaḥ te tava idaṃ māyāmayaṃ maho jyotiḥ saṃseve samyagārādhayāmi (g: dhyāyāmi) | kimbhūtaṃ māyāmayaṃ mahaḥ garbhīkṛtānāhatasvacchandadhvanipeyaṃ garbhīkṛta iti agarbho garbhaḥ kṛtaḥ iti garbhīkṛtaḥ yaḥ anāhatadhvaniḥ (kh, g: svacchandadhvaniḥ) anāhataḥ svecchayotpanno'nāhataḥ (kh, g: anāhataḥ svecchayotpanno nādaḥ) tena peyaṃ dṛśyaṃ punaḥ kimbhūtaṃ māyāmayaṃ candrārkanidrāgirau adhvani rataṃ candrārkayoḥ śvāsocchvāsayornidrāvigatavyāpāraḥ tasyāgiririva giriḥ tasmin candrārkanidrāgirau eva adhvani svādhiṣṭhānacakre rataṃ āśritaṃ punaḥ kimbhūtaṃ māyāmayaṃ mahaḥ mātṛkayā vidarbhitaṃ mātṛkayā ca gumphitaṃ (g: mātṛkayā'vagumphitaṃ) yathā aiṃ hrīṃ aṃ aiṃ hrīṃ āṃ ityādi (kh: aiṃ hrīṃ iṃ aiṃ hrīṃ īṃ ityādi) kṣaparyantaṃ jñeyaṃ aparaṃ kimbhūtaṃ māyāmayaṃ mahaḥ svādhīnāmṛtasiṃdhubaṃdhuraṃ svādhīnaḥ svasya vaśyaḥ yaḥ amṛtasindhuḥ sāgaraḥ tadvat bandhuraṃ manoharaṃ abhimataphaladamityarthaḥ | punaḥ kiṃviśiṣṭaṃ viparītarītiracanoccārādakāravadhi viparīte rītiracanāyā (kh: viparītarītiracanāyām; g: viparītiriti racanāyā mātṛkāyāḥ) mātṛkāyā uccāraṇāt akārāvadhi yathā aiṃ hrīṃ kṣaṃ aiṃ hrīṃ haṃ aiṃ hrīṃ yaṃ (kh: aiṃ hrīṃ kṣaṃ aiṃ hrīṃ haṃ aiṃ hrīṃ saṃ aiṃ hrīṃ ṣaṃ hrīṃ śaṃ ityakārāvadhi svayamūhanīyam) ityakārāvadhi svayamūhanīyam || 10 ||
athedānīṃ parameśvaryā bījārādhanena yatphalaṃ bhavati tadāha(-)
tasmānnandanacārucandanatarucchāyāsu puṣpāsava(-) svairāsvādanamodamānamanasāmuddāmavāmabhruvām | vīṇābhaṅgitaraṅgitasvaracamatkāropi sārojjhito yena syādiha dehi me tadabhitaḥ saṃcāri sārasvatam || 11 ||
tasmāditi(-) he mātaḥ tasmāt tava mahasaḥ (kh: mahaḥ) sevanāt (kh: saṃsevanāt; g: sevanāvihāri salloke) iha asmin loke mahyaṃ sārasvataṃ (kh: mahāsārasvatam) dehi samarpaya | kimbhūtaṃ abhitaḥ saṃcāri sarvataḥ prasaraṇaśīlaṃ api niścitaṃ
yena sārasvatena sārojjhitaḥ syāt gatasattvo bhavet nīrasaḥ syāt ko'sau vīṇābhaṅgitaraṅgitasvaracamatkāraḥ vīṇā prasiddhā tasyāḥ yā bhaṅgiḥ tantrīracanāviśeṣaḥ tayā taraṅgitaḥ unnādito'bhita utpādito (kh: utthāpito) yaḥ svarāṇāṃ niṣādādīnāṃ camatkāraḥ camatkaraṇaṃ sa nīrasa iti sambandhaḥ kāsāṃ uddāmavāmabhruvāṃ amaravarasundarīṇāṃ kiṃllakṣaṇānāṃ vāmabhruvāṃ nandanacārucandanatarucchāyāsu puṣpāsavasvairāsvādanamodamānamanasāṃ nandane vane ye cārucandanataravaḥ manoharacandanavṛkṣāḥ teṣāṃ chāyāsu viṣaye puṣpāṇāmāsavasya (kh: āsavastasya) makarandasya svairaṃ svecchayā yadāsvādanaṃ tena modamānāni saharṣāṇi manāṃsi yāsāṃ tāstathā tāsām || 11 ||
idānīṃ bhagavatyā vakṣyamāṇaślokena bījatrayasya sthānānyāha (kh: dhyānamāha; g: bījatrayadhyānasya sthānānyāha) (-)
ādhāre hṛdaye śikhāparisare saṃdhāya medhāmayīṃ tredhā bījatanūmanūnakaruṇāpīyūṣakallolinīm | tvāṃ mātarjapato niraṅkuśanijādvaitāmṛtāsvādana(-) prajñāmbhaśculukaiḥ sphurantu pulakairaṅgāni tuṅgāni me || 12 ||
ādhāra iti(-) he mātaḥ tvāṃ bījatattvaṃ (kh, g: bījatanūṃ) japato me mama aṅgāni śarīrāvayavāḥ tuṅgāni ucchvasitāni sphurantu ullasantu kaiḥ pulakaiḥ romaharṣaṇaiḥ kiṃ kṛttvā uttaraśloke vakṣyamāṇaṃ bījatrayaṃ eṣu triṣu sthāneṣu tredhā saṃdhāya triprakāramanubadhya anubadhanaṃ vidhāya keṣu keṣu sthāneṣu ādhare ādhāracakre hṛdaye mānase śikhāparisare brahmarandhre | (kh: + saṃdhyāya sannidhīkṛtya) kimbhūtaiḥ pulakaiḥ niraṃkuśanijādvaitāmṛtāsvādanaprajñāmbhaśculukaiḥ niraṃkuśaṃ maryādārahitaṃ nijasya svasya yat advaitāmṛtāsvādanaṃ tatra yat prajñāmbho jñānajalaṃ tasya culukaiḥ kimbhūtāṃ tvāṃ medhāmayīṃ medhāsvarūpāṃ punaḥ kimbhūtāṃ anūnakaruṇāpīyūṣakallolinīṃ anūnamanavarataṃ (kh, g: anūnaṃ ghanataraṃ) yat karuṇāpīyūṣaṃ dayā'mṛtaṃ tasya kallolā laharyo vidyante yasyāṃ sā tathā tāṃ (kh: yat karuṇāpīyūṣaṃ tena kallolinīṃ taraṅgavatīmityarthaḥ) || 12 ||
athedānīṃ bījatrayasya dhyānaphalamāha(-)
vāṇībījamidaṃ japāmi paramaṃ tatkāmarājābhidhaṃ mātaḥ sāntaparaṃ visargasahitaukārottaraṃ tena me |
dīrghāndolitamaulikīlitamaṇiprārabdhanīrājanai(-) rdhīraiḥ pītarasā nirantaramasau vāgjṛmbhatāmadbhutā || 13 ||
vāṇīti(-) he mātaḥ sarveśvari (g: sakaleśvari) tena kāraṇena me mama asau adbhutā vāk nirantaraṃ satataṃ ujjṛmbhatāṃ prasaratu kathaṃ yena kāraṇena idaṃ vāṇībījaṃ aiṃkārarūpaṃ ādhāracakre ahaṃ japāmi | tato'pi kāmarājaṃ klīṃkārarūpaṃ hṛdaye japāmi | tataḥ sāntaparaṃ sa eva antaḥ antabhūtaḥ para utkṛṣṭo yasya tat sāntaparaṃ | punaḥ kimbhūtaṃ visargasahitaukārottaraṃ visargeṇa sahitaṃ aukārottaro yasya tat visargasahitaukārottaraṃ sauṃ iti (kh: yathā sauriti) śaktibījaṃ brahmarandhreṇaiva japāmi athavā sāntaparamityatra bījaviśeṣādhāne (g: bījaviśeṣopadhāne) kriyamāṇe hi evaṃ (kh: sā eva samāsaghaṭanā) samāsaghaṭanā | antaḥśabdenātra hakāro labhyate sakārānuṣaṅgitvāt atra tāvat hakārāt paraḥ sakāraḥ antāt hakārantāt paro'gre yasya bījasya tatsāntaparaṃ visargasahitaukārottaraṃ | hsauṃriti rūpaṃ śaktibījaṃ vā | kiṃ viśiṣṭā vāk dhīraiḥ pītarasā budhairāsvāditarasā kimbhūtaiḥ dhīraiḥ dīrghāndolitamaulikīlitamaṇiprārabdhanīrājanaiḥ dīrghaṃ yathā bhavati tathā āndoliteṣu mauliṣu kīlitāḥ āropitāḥ maṇayaḥ taireva prārabdhā nīrājanā yaiḥ te tathā taiḥ | kimbhūtaṃ bījatrayaṃ paramaṃ utkṛṣṭā (kh, g: parotkṛṣṭā) mā śobhā yasya tatparamaṃ athavā parāyāḥ parābhidhāyāḥ vāṇyāḥ mā śobhā yasya tatparamamiti vāṇībījaviśeṣaṇameva || 13 ||
atha bhagavatyāḥ saphalaṃ dakṣiṇabhujadhyānamāha(-)
cūḍācandrakalānirantaragalatpīyūṣabinduśriyā sandehocitamakṣasūtravalayaṃ yā bibhratī nirbharam | antarmantramayaṃ svameva japasi pratyakṣavṛttyakṣaraṃ sā ttvaṃ dakṣiṇapāṇināmba vitara śreyāṃsi bhūyāṃsi me || 14 ||
cūḍeti(-) he amba(!) sā tvaṃ uktarūpā dakṣiṇapāṇinā (kh: me mahyaṃ iti viśeṣaḥ) bhūyāṃsi śreyāṃsi vitara utpādaya (kh: dehītyarthaḥ) | yā tvaṃ nirbharaṃ sundaraṃ sphaṭikamaṇisaṃbhūtaṃ (kh: sphaṭikamaṇisadṛśaṃ dhṛtaṃ) sūtravalayaṃ bibhratī satī antarmadhye svameva ātmīyameva mantramayaṃ akṣaraṃ japasi kiṃ lakṣaṇamakṣaraṃ (kh: kimbhūtamakṣaraṃ) pratyakṣavṛtti akṣaṃ akṣaṃ prati
vṛttirvarttanaṃ yasya tat tathā | athavā pratyakṣā vṛttiryasya tat pratyakṣavṛtti (kh: tat tathā) kimbhūtamakṣasūtravalayaṃ cūḍācandrakalānirantaragalatpīyūṣabinduśriyā sandehocitaṃ cuḍācandrakalā śekharībhutā yā candrakalā tasyāḥ sakāśāt nirantaraṃ avicchinnaṃ yathā bhavati tathā galanto ye pīyūṣabindavaḥ teṣāṃ yā śrīḥ śobhā tayā sandehocitaṃ atiśubhrattvāt tadanurūpaṃ tatsadṛśākāramityarthaḥ (kh: tat sadṛśamityarthaḥ) || 14 ||
athedānīṃ bhagavatyā vāmabhujadhyānamāha(-)
baddhvā svastikamāsanaṃ sitarucicchedāvadātacchavi(-) śreṇīśrīsubhagaṃ bhaviṣṇu satataṃ vyājṛmbhamāṇe'mbuje (kh: vyājṛmbhamāṇe bhuje) | dīvyantīmadhivāmajānuruciraṃ nyastena hastena tāṃ nityaṃ pustakadhāraṇapraṇayinīṃ seve girāmīśvarīm || 15 ||
baddhveti(-) ahaṃ nityaṃ niraṃtaraṃ girāmīśvarīṃ (g: vācāmadhidevatāṃ vāgīśvarīṃ) seve samārādhayāmi (kh: samyak ārādhayāmi) kimbhūtāṃ girāmīśvarīṃ hastena pustakadhāraṇapraṇayinīṃ hastena pāṇinā pustakadhāraṇe praṇayaḥ sneho yasyāḥ sā tathā tām | kimbhūtena hastena (adhi) vāmajānu ruciraṃ nyastena āropitena kiṃ kṛtvā svastikaṃ svastikasaṃjñaṃ āsanaṃ baddhvā kimbhūtamāsanaṃ sitarucicchedāvadātacchaviśrīsubhagaṃ sitaruceḥ sphaṭikādeḥ yaḥ chedaḥ bhaṅgaḥ tasya yā avadātacchaviḥ (kh: śreṇī) ujjvalatā (kh: ujjvalatarakāntiḥ; g: ujjvalatarakāntipaṃktiḥ) tasyāḥ yā śreṇī tasyāḥ yā śrīḥ śobhā tayā subhagaṃ manoharaṃ punaḥ kimbhūtaṃ bhaviṣṇu bhavanaśīlaṃ punaḥ kimbhūtāṃ girāmiśvarīṃ satataṃ vyājṛmbhamāṇe'mbuje adhidīvyantī ( kh: dīvyaṃtīṃ) adhikaśobhāyuktāṃ (kh: tad yuktāṃ) || 15 ||
athedānīṃ bhagavatyā (kh, g: parameśvaryāḥ) dhyānasya viśiṣṭaphalamāha(-)
tanme viśvapathīnapīnavilasanniḥsīmasārasvata(-) srotovīcivicitrabhaṅgisubhagā vibhrājatāṃ bhāratī | yāmākarṇya vighūrṇamānamanasaḥ preṅkholitairmaulibhi(-) rmīladbhirnayanāñcalaiḥ sumanaso nindeyurindoḥkalām (g: kalāḥ) || 16 ||
tanma iti(-) he mātaḥ tat evaṃvidhāt tava dhyānāt (kh: evaṃ vidhottamadhyānāt) me mama bhāratī bibhrājatāṃ śobhatāṃ kimbhūtā bhāratī viśvapathīnapīnavilasannissīmasārasvatasrotovīcivicitrabhaṅgisubhagā viśvapathaṃ vyāpnotīti viśvapathīnaṃ yat sarvavyāpakaṃ pīnaṃ prauḍhaṃ vilasat krīḍāyuktaṃ nissīmaṃ sīmārahitaṃ yat sarasvatyāḥ idaṃ sārasvataṃ srotaḥ pravāhaḥ tasya vīcīnāṃ yāścitrā (kh: vicitrā) bhaṅgayaḥ śobhāḥ tadvat subhagā manoharā | yāṃ bhāratīmākarṇya sumanaso devāḥ vidvāṃso vā (kh: nāsti) indoścandrasya kalāṃ nindeyuḥ | kimbhūtāḥ sumanasaḥ vighūrṇamānamanasaḥ vighūrṇamānāni manāṃsi yeṣāṃ te (g: āhlādakarāṇi harṣakarāṇi) tathā kaiḥ (kh: taiḥ) nayanāñcalaiḥ mīladbhiḥ aparaṃ kaiḥ kṛtvā maulibhirmastakaiḥ kimbhūtaiḥ taiḥ preṅkholitaiḥ cāpalitaiḥ (g: cālitaiḥ) avadhūnitairityarthaḥ || 16 ||
athedānīṃ parameśvaryā bījatrayasya prakārāntareṇa japavidhānamāha(-)
ādau vāgbhavamindubindumadhuraṃ jhānte ca kāmātmakaṃ yogānte kaṣayostṛtīyamitiṃ te bījatrayaṃ dhyāyatā | sārddhaṃ mātṛkayā vilomaviṣamaṃ (kh, g: viṣayaṃ) saṃdhāya bandhacchidā vācāntargatayā maheśvari mayāṃ mātrāśataṃ japyate || 17 ||
ādāviti(-) he janani(!) he maheśvari(!) antargatayā vācā mayā mātrāśataṃ japyate | kimbhūtena mayā iti amunā prakāreṇa bījatrayaṃ vilomaviṣamaṃ yathā bhavati tathā mātṛkayā saha sandhāya anubadhya dhyāyatā cintayatā itīti kiṃ ādau akārādau indubindumadhuraṃ induścandrakalā binduranusvārastābhyāṃ manoharaḥ tābhyāṃ sahitaṃ vāgbhavaṃ bījaṃ aiṃ ityarthaḥ ca punaḥ jhānte jhakārānte kāmātmakaṃ klīṃkāraṃ (kh: klīṃkārarūpaṃ) tadanu kaṣayoryogānte kṣakārasyānte tṛtīyaṃ śaktibījaṃ sauriti tadyathā aiṃ aṃ āṃ iṃ īṃ uṃ ūṃ ṛṃ ṝṃ ḷṃ ḹṃ eṃ aiṃ oṃ auṃ aṃ aṁḥ kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ ghaṃ ṅaṃ caṃ chaṃ jaṃ jhaṃ klīṃ ñaṃ ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ ṇaṃ taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ naṃ paṃ phaṃ baṃ bhaṃ maṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ haṃ laṃ kṣaṃ sauṃḥ | pratilomato yathā sauṃḥ kṣaṃ laṃ haṃ saṃ ṣaṃ śaṃ vaṃ laṃ raṃ yaṃ maṃ bhaṃ baṃ phaṃ paṃ naṃ dhaṃ daṃ thaṃ taṃ ṇaṃ ḍhaṃ ḍaṃ ṭhaṃ ṭaṃ ñaṃ klīṃ jhaṃ jaṃ chaṃ caṃ ṅaṃ ghaṃ gaṃ khaṃ kaṃ aṃḥ aṃ auṃ oṃ aiṃ eṃ ḹṃ ḷṃ ṝṃ ṛṃ ūṃ uṃ īṃ iṃ āṃ aṃ aiṃ | punaḥ kiṃ bhūtena mayā bandhacchidā bandhaḥ saṃsāraḥ taṃ chinattīti bandhacchit tena tat tathā || 17 ||
idānīṃ bhagavatyārādhanaphalamāha(-)
tatsārasvatasārvabhaumapadavī sadyo mama dyotatāṃ yatrājñāvihitairmahākaviśataiḥ sphītāṃ giraṃ cumbattām | caitronmīlitakelikokilakuhūkārāvatārāñcita(-) ślāghāsiñcita (kh, g: sañcita) pañcamaśrutisamāhāropi bhāropamaḥ || 18 ||
taditi(-) he janani(!) tat kāraṇāt sadyaḥ tatkālaṃ mama sārasvatasārvabhaumapadavī dyotatāṃ apīti niścitaṃ yatra yasyāṃ sārvabhaumapadavyāṃ (g: sārasvatasārvabhaumapadavyāṃ) giraṃ cumbatāṃ vāṇīṃ śṛṇvatāṃ (kh: śṛṇutāṃ) puruṣāṇāṃ evaṃ vidhaḥ śrutisamāhāropi bhāropamaḥ syāt evamiti kiṃ caitronmīlitakelikokilakuhūkārāvatārāñcitaślāghā(##-) puṃskokilāḥ) teṣāṃ ye kuhūkārāvatārāḥ taiḥ añcitā prāptā yā ślāghā stutiḥ tayā siṃcito (kh, g: sañcito) varddhito yaḥ pañcamaśrutisamāhāraḥ sopi bhārarūpo (kh: bhāropamo) bhavati | kimbhūtāṃ giraṃ mahākaviśataiḥ sphītāṃ prauḍhīkṛtāṃ kimbhūtairmahākaviśataiḥ ājñāvihitaiḥ mahāprabandhe āryādicchandasi yatra gururvilokyate tatra gurureva yatra laghurvilokyate tatra laghureveti yā ājñā tayā vihitāḥ preritāḥ (kh: vihitaiḥ preritaiḥ) taiḥ || 18 ||
idānīṃ bhagavatyā mantragarbhitaṃ (g: mantrāntargarbhitaṃ) dhyānāntaramāha(-)
vāgbījaṃ bhuvaneśvarīṃ vada vadetyuccārya vāgvādinīṃ (kh: vāgvādini) svāhā varṇaviśīrṇapātakabharāṃ dhyāyāmi nityāṃ giram | vīṇā (kh: vīṇāṃ) pustakamakṣasūtravalayaṃ vyājṛmbhamambhoruhaṃ vibhrāṇāmaruṇāṃśubhiḥ karatalairāvirbhavadvibhramām || 19 ||
vāgiti(-) ahaṃ nityāṃ (kh: nityāṃ giraṃ) vāgīśvarīṃ dhyāyāmi kiṃ kṛtvā iti uccārya itīti kiṃ vāgbījaṃ aiṃkāraṃ bhuvaneśvarīṃ (kh: + māyābījaṃ) hrīkāraṃ vada vada vāgvādini (kh: vāgvādini) svāhā iti | kimbhūtāṃ giraṃ varṇaviśīrṇapātakabharāṃ varṇairiti mantrākṣarairviśīrṇo dūrīkṛtaḥ pātakabharo yayā sā tathā tām | punaḥ kiṃbhūtāṃ giraṃ karatalaiścaturbhiḥ pāṇitalaiḥ vīṇāṃ pustakaṃ akṣasūtravalayaṃ ambhoruhaṃ ca bibhrāṇāṃ dakṣiṇādhaḥkarakrameṇātra mantavyaṃ | adhodakṣiṇakareṇa vīṇāṃ vāmādhaḥ kareṇa pustakaṃ dakṣiṇorddhvakareṇa akṣasūtraṃ vāmorddhvakareṇāmbhoruhaṃ dadhānāṃ kimbhūtamambhoruhaṃ vyājṛmbhaṃ utphullamityarthaḥ | kiṃ viśiṣṭaiḥ karatalaiḥ aruṇāṃśubhiḥ raktakāntibhiḥ (kh: pustake ayaṃ na) punaḥ kimbhūtāṃ giraṃ āvirbhavadvibhramāṃ avirbhavan prakaṭībhavan vibhramo vilāso yasyāḥ sā tathā tām | sukaratayā mantro yathā aiṃ hrīṃ vada vada vāgvādinī (kh: vāgvādini) svāhā || 19 ||
idānīṃ bhagavatyā japadhyānataḥ (kh, g: mantrajapadhyānataḥ) phalamāha(-)
tanmātaḥ kṛpayā taraṅgyatarāṃ vidyādhipatyaṃ mayi jyotsnāsaurabhacaurakīrtikavitāsevyaikasiṃhāsanam | kālājñādi (kh: kālāgnyādi) śivāvasānabhavana (kh: bhuvana) prāgbhārakukṣiṃbhari(-) prajñāmbhaḥparipākapīvaraparā'nandapratiṣṭhāspadam || 20 ||
tanmātariti(-) he mātaḥ tat tasmāt kāraṇāt tvajjapadhyānataḥ mayi viṣaye vidyānāmādhipatyaṃ (kh, g: vidyānāmadhipatitvaṃ) taraṅgyatarāṃ atyarthaṃ prakaṭaya (g: ghaṭaya) kayā kṛpayā anukampayā kimbhūtaṃ vidyādhipatyaṃ jyotsnāsaurabhacaurakīrttikavitāsevyaikasiṃhāsanaṃ jyotsnā candrikā tasyāḥ yatsaurabhaṃ manoharattvaṃ tasya yā cauravat kīrtirevaṃvidhā yā kavitā etāvatā candrikāsaundaryasadṛśā (kh, g: sadṛśī) yā kavitā tayā sevyaṃ ekasiṃhāsanaṃ yasya tat tathā (g: + yadvā kīrtikavitayordvandvaḥ) punaḥ kimbhūtaṃ vidyādhipatyaṃ kālājñādiśivāvasānabhavana(##-) avasānaṃ virāmasthānaṃ yasya bhuvanasya anena śivasya pañcakṛtyatā kathitā evaṃvidhasya bhuvanasya yaḥ prāgbhāraḥ bharaṇarūpā yā prāksthitiḥ viṣṇudharmaḥ pālanatetyarthaḥ tasya prāgbhartuḥ viṣṇoryā kukṣiṃbharitā prajñā saivāmbhaḥ udakaṃ tasya yaḥ paripākaḥ pariṇāmāvasthā tasya yaḥ pīvarānandaḥ tasya yā pratiṣṭhā tasyāḥ āspadaṃ sthānam) kālasya īśvarasya yadājñāprārambhaḥ abhyāsaḥ jñānaṃ ceti ādiśabdenopalabhyate śivāvasānamiti tattvajñānaprāpti kālājñādi tadeva śivāvasānaṃ tasya yadbhavanaṃ utpattiḥ (g: upapattiḥ) tasya yaḥ prāgbhāraḥ pūrvasthitiḥ tasya yat kukṣiṃbhariprajñāmbhaḥ prajñābahulataraṃ jñānodakaṃ tasya yaḥ paripākaḥ pariṇāmaḥ tasya yaḥ pīvaraparā'nandaḥ pīnaparā'nandaḥ tasya yā pratiṣṭhā saṃsthā tasyā āspadaṃ sthānaṃ || 20 ||
idānīṃ bhagavatyā bījasthānāntaraphalañca (kh: bījasthānaṃ tat phalaṃ) vṛttayugalenāha(-)
lekhābhistuhinadyuteriva kṛtaṃ vāgbījamuccaiḥ sphurat tārākārakarālabinduparito māyā tridhā veṣṭitam | pūrṇendorudare tadetadakhilaṃ pīyūṣagaurākṣaraṃ srotaḥ saṃbhramasaṃbhṛtaṃ smaratiṃ yo jihvāñcale niścalaḥ || 21 ||
tasya tvatkaruṇākaṭākṣakaṇikāsaṃkrāntimātrādapi svānte śāntimupaiti dīrghajaḍatā jāgradvikārāgraṇīḥ | tasmādāśu jagattrayādbhutarasādvaitapratītipradaṃ (g: pradaiḥ) saurabhyaṃ paramabhyudeti vadanāmbhoje girāṃ vibhramaiḥ || 22 ||
lekheti(-) he mātaḥ yaḥ pumān vāgbījaṃ aiṃkāraṃ tuhinadyuteścandramaso lekhābhiḥ kṛtamiva punaḥ uccairupari sphurat yaḥ tārāyāḥ ākāravat karālo manoharo yo vinduḥ anusvāro yasya tat tathā tataḥ parito māyātridhāveṣṭitaṃ paritaḥ samantādbhāvena māyayā māyābījena lomapratilomato hi tridhā triprakāraṃ (kh: triḥprakāreṇa) veṣṭitaṃ tatastadetat akhilaṃ samagraṃ pūrṇendorudare sampūrṇacandramadhye (kh, g: pūrṇacandramadhye) pīyūṣagaurākṣaraṃ amṛtadhavalavarṇaṃ aparaṃ srotaḥsaṃbhramasaṃbhṛtaṃ srotaḥ pravāhaḥ tasya saṃbhramo vilāsaḥ tena saṃbhṛtaṃ vyāptaṃ stimito niścalaḥ san jihvāñcale rasanāgre smarati dhyāyati tasya puruṣasya api niścitaṃ svānte mānase dirghajaḍatā śāntiṃ nāśaṃ upaiti kasmāt tasya tvatkaruṇākaṭākṣakaṇikāsaṃkrāṃtimātrāt tvatkaruṇākaṭākṣavīkṣaṇamātrāt kimbhūtā dīrghajaḍatā jāgradvikārāgraṇīḥ jāgrato'pi udbodharūpā ye vikārāḥ vikṛtayaḥ (g: + anācārāḥ) teṣāṃ madhye agraṇīḥ agresaraḥ ityarthaḥ | tasmādityupasaṃhāre | āśu śīghraṃ vadanāmbhoje mukhakamale paraṃ utkṛṣṭaṃ saurabhyaṃ (g: + sundaratvamiti) abhyudeti udayaṃ prāpnoti | kiṃ (kh, g: kaiḥ) girāṃ bibhramaiḥ vācāṃ vilāsaiḥ kiṃbhūtaṃ saurabhyaṃ jagattrayādbhutarasādvaitapratītipradaṃ jagattrayasya adbhutarasaḥ tasya advaitapratītiḥ advitīyajñānaṃ tāṃ (kh: tat) pradadātīti tat tathā athavā jagattrayādbhutarasādvaitapratītipradairiti vā pāṭhāntare girāṃ vibhramairityasya padasya viśeṣaṇaṃ (kh: viśeṣaṇī) bhavitumarhati || 22 ||
athedānīṃ bhagavatyā vṛttadvayena mātṛkāmayaṃ śarīrāvayavamāha (kh: śarīramāha) (-)
ādyo maulirathāparo mukhami(-)ī netre ca karṇāvu(-)ū nāsā vaṃśapuṭe ṛ(-)ṛ tadanujau varṇau kapoladvayam | dantāścordhvamadhastathauṣṭhayugalaṃ sandhyakṣarāṇi kramāt jihvāmūlamudagrabindurapi ca grīvā visargī svaraḥ || 23 ||
kādirdakṣiṇato bhujastaditaro vargaśca (kh: vargastu) vāmo bhuja(-) ṣṭādistādiranukrameṇa caraṇau kukṣidvayaṃ te paphau | vaṃśaḥ pṛṣṭhabhavo'tha nābhihṛdaye vāditrayaṃ dhatavo yādyāḥ (yādyaḥ) saptasamīraṇaśca saparaḥ kṣaḥ krodha ityambike || 24 ||
ādya iti(-) he ambike (!) te tava ādyaḥ akāraḥ mauliḥ śiraḥ atha aparaḥ ākāraḥ mukham | ca punaḥ i(-)ī netre netradvayam | u(-)ū karṇau ṛ(-)ṛ nāsāvaṃśapuṭe iti nāsāvaṃśapuṭadvayam | tadanujau tayoranujau (kh: tayoranujātau) ḷkāraḹkārau (kh: ḷḹkārau) kapoladvayam | ūrdhvamatho dantāstathordhvādhoṣṭhayugalaṃ kramāt sandhyakṣarāṇi ekārādīni e(-)ai ūdhrvādho dantāḥ u(-)ū (kh: o(-)au) ūrdhvādhaḥ oṣṭhayugalaṃ tadagrabinduḥ aṃkāraḥ jihvāmūlam | aparaḥ visargī svaraḥ (kh: aḥ) tava grīvā || 23 ||
kādiḥ ka kha ga gha ṅa ityevaṃ rūpaṃ tava dakṣiṇo (kh: dakṣiṇato) bhujaḥ dakṣiṇata ityatra tasaḥ (kh: tas) sārvavibhaktikatvāt prathamāyāṃ nirdeśaḥ | taditaro vargaḥ cavargaḥ ca cha ja jha ña ityevaṃrūpo vāmo bhujaḥ ṭādiṣṭavargaḥ tādistavargaḥ ityanukrameṇa te tava dakṣiṇavāmacaraṇau ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa ityevaṃrūpo dakṣiṇaḥ caraṇaḥ ta tha da dha na ityevaṃrūpo vāmacaraṇaḥ | he mātaḥ te tava kukṣidvayaṃ paphau pakāraphakārau dakṣiṇakukṣiḥ pakāraḥ vāmakukṣiḥ phakāraḥ | atha bāditrayaṃ ba bha ma ititrayaṃ pṛṣṭhabhavo vaṃśaḥ nābhihṛdaye vaṃśaḥ pṛṣṭhabhavaḥ bakāraḥ nābhirbhakāraḥ hṛdayaṃ makāraḥ dhātavo yādyāḥ sapta yādyā iti ya ra la va śa ṣa sa ityevaṃrūpāstava saptadhātavo bhavanti | tvagasṛṅ (k: rasa) māṃsameda(-)asthimajjāśukrāṇi | ādhāraliṅganābhihṛdayamukhabhrūmadhyaśiraḥ iti (kh: yādyāḥ) sapta ca punaḥ saparo hakāraḥ samīraṇaḥ prāṇaḥ tāluḥ (kh: tālu ca) | he janani kṣaḥ kṣakāraḥ tava krodho brahmarandhramiti || 24 ||
atha (kh: iti) bhagavatyā varṇamayaśarīrasya bhajanaphalamāha (kh: bhajanamāha)(-)
evaṃ varṇamayaṃ vapustava śive lokatrayavyāpakaṃ (g: lokatraye) yo'haṃbhāvanayā bhajatyavayaveṣvāropitairakṣaraiḥ | mūrtībhūya divāvasānakamalākāraiḥ (g: dināvasānaṃ) staṃ vidyāḥ samupāsate karatalairdṛṣṭiprasādotsukāḥ || 25 ||
evamiti(-) he śive (!) evaṃ amunā prakāreṇa yaḥ pumān tava varṇamayaṃ vapurlokatrayavyāpakaṃ bhajati āśrayati kayā kṛttvā avayaveṣu śarīrāvayaveṣu āropitaiḥ akṣaraiḥ ahaṃbhāvanayā ahameva varṇamaya iti matvā taṃ puruṣaṃ vidyāścaturddaśavidyāḥ mūrtībhūya mūrtirūpā bhūtvā karatalaiḥ samupāsate kimbhutāḥ vidyāḥ dṛṣṭiprasādotsukāḥ iyamasmāsu (kh: ayamasmāsu) dṛṣṭyā prasādaṃ kariṣyatītyutsukāḥ | śiraḥśāyibhiḥ śiraḥsanniviṣṭaiḥ punaḥ kimbhūtaiḥ divāvasānakamalākāraiḥ divāvasāne sāyaṃ samaye kamalākārā iva ākārāḥ ākṛtayo yeṣāṃ te tathā taiḥ mukulākṛtairityarthaḥ (kh: mukulākṛtibhirityarthaḥ) || 25 ||
atha (kh: idānīṃ) bhagavatyā dhyāne (kh: dhyānena) phalāntaramāha(-)
ye jānanti japanti santatamamidhyāyanti gāyanti vā teṣāmāsyamupāsyate mṛdupadanyāsairvilāsairgirām | kiṃ ca krīḍati bhūrbhuvaḥsvarabhitaḥ śrīcandanasyandinī kīrttiḥ kārttikarātrikairavasabhāsaubhhagyaśobhākarī || 26 ||
ya iti(-) he janani ye puruṣāḥ evaṃvidhaṃ te tava varṇamayaṃ vapurjānanti athavā yajanti (kh: japanti) satatamabhidhyāyanti vā athavā gāyanti vā teṣāmāsyaṃ teṣāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ āsyaṃ mukhaṃ girāṃ vilāsaiḥ vācāṃ vilasanaiḥ upāsyate kimbhūtaiḥ girāṃ vilāsaiḥ mṛdupadanyāsaiḥ komalapadaviracanaiḥ na kevalaṃ tadeva bhavati kiṃ ca teṣāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svarabhitaḥ bhūrlokamabhivyāpya (kh: bhūrlokādi; g: bhūrlokaṃ bhuvarlokaṃ svarlokamabhivyāpya) kīrtiḥ krīḍati kimbhūtā kīrtiḥ kārtikarātrikairavasabhāsaubhāgyaśobhākarī kārtikasya rātrau yaḥ kairavasamudāyaḥ tasya saubhāgyaśobhā sundarakāntiḥ tāṃ karotīti tathā punaḥ kimbhūtā śrīcandanasyandinī śrīcandanaṃ amṛtaṃ iva syaṃdanamiti (kh: syaṃdata iti; g: śrīcandanamamṛtadravaṃ syandate sravati sā tathā) || 26 ||
idānīṃ (kh: atha) viśiṣṭavarṇamayavapurdhyānāntareṇa (kh: vapuṣo) phalāntaramāha
māyābījavidarbhitaṃ punaridaṃ śrīkūrmacakroditaṃ dīpāmnāyavido japanti khalu ye teṣāṃ narendrāḥ sadā | sevante caraṇau kirīṭavalabhīviśrāntaratnāṅkura(-) jyotsnāmeduramedinītalarajomiśrāṅgarāgaśriyaḥ || 27 ||
māyeti(-) he janani(!) punaridaṃ tava varṇamayaṃ vapuḥ māyābījavidarbhitaṃ māyābījena gumphitaṃ tat (kh: sat) punaśca śrīkūrmacakroditaṃ (kh, g: śrīkūrmacakre uditaṃ) ye janāḥ dīpāmnāyavidaḥ satataṃ (kh: santo) japanti khalu niścayena teṣāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ sadā nityaṃ narendrāḥ rājānaḥ cara'nu sevante kimbhūtāḥ narendrāḥ kirīṭavalabhīviśrāntaratnāṅkurajyotsnāmeduramedinītalarajomiśrāṅgarāga(##-) viśrāntāni niviṣṭāni (kh: sanniviṣṭāni) yāni ratnāni teṣāṃ aṃkurāḥ jyotsnākiraṇakāntiḥ tayā meduraṃ susnigdhaṃ dīptisaṃyuktaṃ yat medinītalarajaḥ mahītalareṇuḥ tena miśrā aṅgarāgaśrīryeṣāṃ te tathā | dīpāmnāya iti aṣṭakoṣṭhānālikhya sṛṣṭikrameṇaiva koṣṭhe koṣṭhe (kh: koṣṭheṣu) svarāṇāṃ akārādināṃ dvandvamālikhya (kh: svarānakārādīnālikhya) tataḥ kādīn samudāyarūpān varṇānālikhya ca yatra koṣṭhe sthānādhipatergrāmādhiṣṭhātṛdevatāyāḥ (kh, g: grāmādhiṣṭhānadevatāyāḥ) nāmnaḥ prathamākṣaraṃ yatra bhavati tatra tatra deśe bhūtvā māyābījavidarbhitaṃ māyābījena hrīṃkāreṇa (kh: vidarbhakrameṇa yutaṃ) gumphitaṃ mātṛkāmayaṃ (kh: māyāmayaṃ) vapuḥ śarīraṃ japanti te dīpāmnāyavida ucyante tathā coktam(-)
dvadvaṃ svārāṇāṃ vilikhecca pūrvaṃ kādīṃstathā varṇasamūharūpān | sthānādhipasyākṣaramasti yatra taṃ dīpadeṣaṃ munayo vadanti ||
idānīṃ bhagavatyāḥ punarvarṇamayaśarīrasya prakārāntarato dhyānāntareṇa phalāntaramāha(-)
śrībījaṃ sakalākṣarādiṣu punaḥ krodhākṣarānte bhave(-) devaṃ yo bhajate ca te (kh, g: bhajate'mba (!) te) tanumimāṃ tasyā'grato jāgratī |
lakṣmīḥ sindhuradānagandhalaharīlobhāndhapuṣpandhaya(-) śreṇībandhuraśṛṅkhalāniyamitevāpaiti naiva kvacit || 28 ||
śrībījamiti(-) he amba(!) sakalākṣarāṇāṃ akārādīnāṃ varṇānāmādiṣu prathamaṃ śrībījaṃ śrīṃ iti rūpaṃ punaśca krodhākṣarānte (kh, g: kṣakārānte) śrībījaṃ bhavet evaṃ amunā prakāreṇa yaḥ pumān te tava imāṃ tanuṃ śrīṃ aṃ śrīṃ āṃ śrīṃ iṃ śrīṃ īṃ śrriṃ iti kṣaparyantaṃ (śrīṃ aṃ śrīṃ āṃ śrīṃ iṃ śrīṃ īṃ śrīṃ uṃ śrīṃ ūṃ śrīṃ ṛṃ śrīṃ ṝṃ śrīṃ ḷṃ śrīṃ ḹṃ śrīṃ eṃ śrīṃ aiṃ śrīṃ oṃ śrīṃ auṃ śrīṃ aṃ śrīṃ aḥ śrīṃ kaṃ śrīṃ khaṃ śrīṃ gaṃ śrīṃ ghaṃ śrīṃ ṅaṃ śrīṃ caṃ śrīṃ chaṃ śrīṃ jaṃ śrīṃ jhaṃ śrīṃ ñaṃ śrīṃ ṭaṃ śrīṃ ṭhaṃ śrīṃ ḍaṃ śrīṃ ḍhaṃ śrīṃ ṇaṃ śrīṃ taṃ śrīṃ thaṃ śrīṃ daṃ śrīṃ dhaṃ śrīṃ naṃ śrīṃ paṃ śrīṃ phaṃ śrīṃ baṃ śrīṃ bhaṃ śrīṃ maṃ śrīṃ yaṃ śrīṃ raṃ śrīṃ laṃ śrīṃ vaṃ śrīṃ śaṃ śrīṃ ṣaṃ śrīṃ saṃ śrīṃ haṃ śrīṃ laṁ śrīṃ kṣaṃ śrīṃ) śrībījena gumphitaṃ mātṛkāmayaṃ śarīraṃ yo bhajate tasya puruṣasyāgrataḥ lakṣmīḥ padmālayā jāgratī vinidrā satī kvacidapi anyapradeśe (kh: pradeśaṃ) naivāpayāti (kh: naivāpaiti) | kimbhūtā lakṣmīḥ utprekṣyate (kh: utprekṣate) sindhuradānagandhalaharī.ṁiyamitā iva (kh: sindhurāṇā gajendrāṇāṃ yaddānaṃ madaṃ tasya yā gandhalaharī) parimalasphuraṇaṃ tatra yo lobho grahaṇamatiḥ (kh: grahaṇamiti) tena andhāḥ vyākulāḥ vilolā yā puṣpandhayaśreṇī bhramarapaṃktiḥ saiva bandurā manoharā śṛṅkhalā tayā niyamitā iva baddhā iva (g: + yathā anyo'pi kaścit baddhaḥ san nānyatra apaiti dadvat iti) || 28 ||
athedānīṃ bhagavatyā dhyānāntareṇa punaśca phalāntaramāha(-)
yastvāṃ vidrumapallavadravamayīṃ lekhāmivālohitā(-) mātmānaṃ paritaḥ sphurattrivalayāṃ māyāmabhidhyāyati | tasmai ninditacandanendukadalīkāntārahārasrajo niśvāsabhramavāṣpadāhagahanā mūrchanti tāstāsstriyaḥ || 29 ||
ya iti(-) he janani (!) ātmānaṃ paritaḥ ātmanaḥ samīpe tvāṃ vidrumapallavadravamayīṃ pravālāṅkuraprasaraṇasvarūpāṃ (g: yadvā pravālāṅkurāṇāṃ dravo rasaḥ tannirmitamiti) āsamantāt lohitāṃ raktāṃ lekhāmiva sphurattrivalayāṃ māyāṃ hrīṃkararūpāṃ ullasattrikoṇagatāṃ (kh: trikoṇamadhyagāṃ yaḥ) abhidhyāyati tasmai tasya puruṣasyārthe tāstāḥ sakalaguṇayakṣaṇasampannāḥ striyo mūrcchanti mohaṃ prāpnuvanti kimbhūtāḥ striyaḥ
ninditacandanendukadalīkāntārahārasrajaḥ (g: + candanaśca induśca kadalīkāntāraṃ kadalīvanañca hārasrajaśca) ninditāḥ candanendukadalīkāntārahārasrajo yābhistāḥ tathā | aparaṃ kimbhūtāḥ striyaḥ niśvāsabhramavāṣpadāhagahanāḥ niśvāsabhrameṇa niśvāsacalanena mocanena yo bāṣpaḥ ūṣmā sa eva dāhaḥ tena gahanāḥ vyākulāḥ (g: + yad vā niśvāsānāṃ bhrama āvartaḥ bāṣpānyaśrūṇi dāhontarbahissantāpaśca tairgahanāḥ vyākulāḥ) || 29 ||
idānīṃ bhagavatyāḥ punardhyānāntareṇa phalāntaramāha(-)
mātaḥ śrībhagamālinītyabhidhayā divyāgamottaṃsitāṃ tvāmānandamayīmanusmarati yastaṃ nāma vāmabhruvaḥ | bāhusvastikapīḍitaiḥstanataṭairdainyāñcitaiścāṭubhi(-) rnīrandhraiḥ pulakāṃkulairmukulitairdhyāyanti (kh: g: pulakāṃkuraiḥ) netrāñcalaiḥ || 30 ||
mātariti(-) nāma iti sambodhane (kh: prasidhau) he mātaḥ(!) yaḥ pumān bhagamālinītyabhidhayā (kh: śrībhagamālinī) aiṃ hrīṃ ānandamayī (kh: ānandamayi) bhagamālini svāheti tvāṃ divyāgamottaṃsitāṃ divyāgame (g: śaivāgame rudrayāmalādau) uttaṃsitāṃ śekharīkṛtāṃ tvāṃ ānandamayīmānandasvarūpāṃ anusmarati anucintayati taṃ puruṣaṃ vāmabhruvo varavarṇinyaḥ dhyāyanti kaiḥ stanataṭaiḥ kimbhūtaiḥ bāhusvastikapīḍitaiḥ bāhusvastikena dorddaṇḍamaṇḍalena (kh: svastikākṛtibāhumaṇḍalena) pīḍitaiḥ punaḥ kimbhūtaiḥ stanataṭaiḥ pulakāṃkuraiḥ (kh: romāñcitaiḥ) aparaṃ kaiḥ cāṭubhiḥ priyavacanaiḥ kimbhūtaiścāṭubhiḥ dainyāñcitaiḥ ahaṃ tava dāsī bhavāmīti dainyasahitaiḥ punaḥ kaiḥ netrāñcalaiḥ (g: nayanaprāntaiḥ kaṭākṣairityarthaḥ kimbhūtaiḥ nīraṃdhraiḥ niścalaiḥ calanakriyārahitaiḥ punaḥ) niyamitaiḥ tadavalokanādi(nā)nyanirīkṣaṇe (kh, g: tadavalokanādanyanirīkṣaṇe) viṣayīkṛtaiḥ (kh: nirviṣayīkṛtaiḥ; g: aviṣayīkṛtaiḥ) tadavalokanatatparairityarthaḥ || 30 ||
atha punaridānīṃ dhyānāntareṇa phalāntaramāha vṛttayugalena (kh: pustake padya ime pārthakyena vyākhyāte staḥ)(-)
yastvāṃ dhyāyati rāgasāgarataratsindūranaukāntara(-) svairojjāgarapadmarāganalinīpuṣpāsanādhyāsinīm | bālādityasapatnaratnarucirapratyaṅgabhūṣāruci(-) (kh: racita) śreṇīsammilitāṅgarāgavasanāstasya (kh: g: saṃvalitāṅga) smarantyaṅganāḥ || 31 ||
karpūraṃ kumudākāraṃ kamalinīpatraṃ kalākauśalaṃ kūjatkokilakāminīkulakuhūkallolakolāhalam | śaṅkante pralayānalasmaramahāpasmāravegāturāḥ kampante nipatanti hanta na giraṃ muñcanti śocanti ca || 32 ||
ya iti(-) he amba(!) yaḥ pumān tvāṃ rāgasāgarataratsindūranaukāntarasvairojjāgarapadmarāganalinīpuṣpāsanā(##-) madhye svairaṃ svecchayā ujjāgaraṃ vikasitaṃ yatpadmarāgasadṛśaṃ nalinīpuṣpaṃ kamalinīkusumaṃ (kh: kamalinīpuṣpaṃ) tadevāsanaṃ adhyāste iti tathā tāṃ evaṃvidhāṃ tvāṃ yo dhyāyati tasya puruṣasya aṅganāḥ sundaryaḥ smarantyaḥ satyaḥ (taṃ prāpnuvantītyarthaḥ kimbhūtāḥ aṅganāḥ bālāditya...vasanāḥ..... tadagre'valokanīyaṃ) karpūraṃ śaṅkante (kh: nindanti) na kevalaṃ karpūrameva nindanti kiṃ ca kumudākaraṃ kumudaśreṇīṃ kiṃ tadeva kamalinīpatraṃ punaḥ kiṃ kalākauśalaṃ kalānāṃ naipuṇyaṃ na kevalamidameva kiṃ ca kūjatkokilakāminīkulakuhūkallolakolāhalaṃ kūjat avyaktaśabdāyamānaṃ yatkokilakāminīkulaṃ kalakaṇṭhīvṛndaṃ tasya yaḥ kuhūkallolakolāhalaḥ kuhūśabdoccāreṇa (kh: kuhūśabdoccāraṇena) bavatpunaḥ punaḥ punārāvaḥ taṃ aṅganāḥ punaḥ kiṃ kurvanti pralayānalasmaramahāpasmāravegākulāḥ (kh: vegāturāḥ) kampante pralayakālīno yaḥ analo vaiśvānaraḥ (g: agniḥ) sa eva smaraḥ tasya yo mahāpasmārasadṛśo vegaḥ tena āturāḥ pīḍitāḥ satyo vepathuṃ kurvanti hanta iti khede nipatanti ca niḥśeṣeṇa vasundharāyāṃ patanti (kh, g: vasudhāṃ yānti) punargiraṃ vācaṃ na muñcanti nodīrayanti ca punarlabdhasaṃjñāḥ satyaḥ śocanti sa na milita iti kāraṇāt anyopi yopasmāravegāturo bhavati saḥ kampate nipatati giraṃ na muñcati punaśca labdhasaṃjño bhūtvā (kh: śocati) kimidameno mayā kṛtamiti yena mamāpasmārasadṛśo vyādhirutpanna iti | kimbhūtāḥ aṅganāḥ bālādityasapatnaratnarucirapratyaṅgabhūṣāruciśreṇīsammilitāṅga(##-) nijāruṇa) bālādityaṃ prathamamudayaṃkurvāṇaṃ raviṃ sapatnayanti (kh: sapanti) dviṣanti iti bālādityasapatnāni yāni ratnāni taiḥ racitāḥ nirmitāḥ yāḥ pratyaṅgabhūṣāḥ sakalāṅganāḥ (kh, g: sakalāṅgaśobhāḥ) tāsāṃ yā rucayaḥ śreṇyaḥ (kh, g: ruciśreṇyaḥ) kāntipaṃktayaḥ (kh: kāntiparamparāḥ) tābhiḥ sammilitāni (kh, g: saṃvalitāni) miśrāṇi aṅgarāgavasanāni (kh, g: aṅgarāgo vasanāni ca) yāsāṃ tāḥ tathā (kh: tasyeti karmmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī; g: yad vā dvitīyā prathamāntatve devyāḥ viśeṣaṇaṃ) || 32 ||
athedānīṃ bhagavatyā mṛtyuñjayamantrārādhanamāha(-) (g: manunā'rādhanamāha)
śrīmṛtyuñjayanāmadheyabhagavaccaitanyacandrātmike hrīṃkāri (g: hrīṃkāra) prathamātamāṃsi dalaya tvaṃ haṃsasaṃjīvini (g: saṃjīvani) jīvaṃ prāṇavijṛmbhamāṇahṛdayagranthisthitaṃ me kuru tvāṃ seve nijabodhalābharabhasā svāhabhujāmīśvarīṃ || 33 ||
śrīti(-) he mṛtyuñjayanāmadheyabhagavaccaitanyacandrātmike (!) (g: mṛtyuñjaya iti nāmadheyaṃ yasyā īdṛśī bhagavataḥ śambhoścaitanyameva candrikā prakāśakatvāt tatsarūpe) he hrīṃkāri(!) he haṃsasañjīvini (g: he haṃsasaṃjīvani(!) haṃsaṃ nirguṇaṃ brahma jīvayati jīvā'bhidhaṃ sampādayati tasyāḥ sambodhanam) ahaṃ nijabodhalābharabhasā svajñānaprāptirabhasatvena harṣeṇa tvāṃ svāhābhujāṃ devānāmīśvarīṃ seve āśraye | ataḥ kāraṇāt tvaṃ (yataḥ candrātmikā hrīṃkāraḥ prathamo yasyāḥ sā evaṃ bhūtā tvaṃ mama tamāṃsyajñānāni hrīṃkāri prathamātamāṃsīti pāṭhe śilopaḥ) me mama prathamātamāṃsi pūrvāṇi ajñānādīni dalaya vidāraya | prathamātamāṣītyatra chandasi ṅiśyorvā lopa iti śilopaḥ (kh: yadvā prathame ādye atra kopi na doṣaḥ) cakāro'trādhyāharttavyaḥ | ca punaḥ mama jīvaṃ prāṇavijṛmbhamāṇahṛdayagranthisthitaṃ prāṇavāyunā vijṛmbhamāṇa utphullito yo hṛdayagranthiḥ tatra sthitaṃ āśritaṃ kuru (mṛtyuñjayamantroddharapakṣe tu śrīmṛtyuñjaye iti nāmadheye bhagavacchabdātmike tataścaitanyacandraśabdātmike hrīṃkāraḥ prathamādakṣarāt śrīkārottaro yatra svāhāśabdaḥ bhujo yasyāḥ bhaktadattadravyagrahaṇāya tadvāñchitadānāya ca) mṛtyuñjayamanuryathā oṃ (kh: pustake praṇavo nāsti mantre'smin) śrīṃ hrīṃ mṛtyuñjaye bhagavati caitanyacandre haṃsasaṃjīvini svāheti || 33 ||
idānīṃ mṛtyuñjayanāma dhyānamāha (kh, g: parameśvaryā mṛtyuñjayasya phalamāha)(-)
evaṃ tvāmamṛteśvarīmanudinaṃ rākāniśākāmuka(-) svānte (g: syāntaḥ saṃtata....) santatabhāsamānavapuṣaṃ sākṣādyajante tu ye | te mṛtyoḥ kavalīkṛtatribhuvanābhogasya maulau padaṃ dattvā bhogamahodadhau niravadhi krīḍanti taistaiḥ sukhaiḥ || 34 ||
evamiti(-) he mātaḥ(!) te puruṣāḥ mṛtyoḥ kṛtāntasya (kh: maulau śirasi vāmaṃ pādaṃ datvā bhogasāgare taistaiḥ dhanakalatraputrahayarājamānādibhiḥ sukhaiḥ niravadhi yathā bhavati tathā krīḍanti vilasanti kimbhūtasya mṛtyoḥ kavalīkṛtatribhuvanābhogasya...........) kavalīkṛtatribhuvanābhogasya kavalīkṛtaṃ grāsīkṛtaṃ yat tribhuvanaṃ tasya āsamantādbhāvena bhogo yasya tathā tasya te ke tu punaḥ ye puruṣāḥ evaṃvidhāṃ pūrvalakṣaṇāṃ (kh: pūrvoktalakṣaṇāṃ) amṛteśvarīṃ mokṣadātrīṃ tvāṃ sākṣāt anudinaṃ nirantaraṃ yajante (kh: yajanti) kimbhūtāṃ tvāṃ rākāniśākāmukasvānte santatabhāsamānavapuṣaṃ rākāyāḥ pūrṇimāyāḥ niśākāmukasya candrasya (kh: indoḥ) antaḥ madhye satataṃ bhāsamānaṃ vapuḥ śarīraṃ yasyāḥ sā tathā tām || 34 ||
idānīṃ parameśvaryā mṛtyuñjayamanordhyānamāha (kh: mṛtyuñjayanāma dhyanamāha; g: mṛtyuñjayamanordhyānamāha)(-)
jāgradbodhasudhāmayūkhanicayairāplāvya sarvā diśo yasyāḥ kāpi kalā kalaṅkarahitā ṣaṭcakramākrāmati | dainyadhvāntavidāraṇaikacaturā vācaṃ parāṃ tanvatī sā nityā bhuvaneśvarī viharatāṃ haṃsīva manmānase || 35 ||
jāgraditi(-) sā nityā cidrūpā bhuvaneśvarī hrīṃkārarūpā manmānase madīye citte viharatāṃ krīḍatāṃ (kh: krīḍāṃ kurutām; g: karotu) keva haṃsīva yathā haṃsī mānase sarasi viharati tathā sā kā yasyāḥ bhuvaneśvaryāḥ kalaṅkarahitā kāpi kalā turīyāvasthā ṣaṭcakramākrāmati ṣaṭcakrāṇi vibhidya sadya uditā bhavati kiṃ kṛtvā sarvāḥ diśaḥ āplāvya vyāpya kaiḥ tāgradbodhasudhāmayūkhanicayaiḥ jāgrat tāgradrūpo yo bodho jñānaṃ saiva sudhā tasyāḥ ye mayūkhanicayāḥ kiraṇasamūhāḥ taiḥ | kimbhūtā kalā dainyadhvantavidāraṇaikacaturādainyamajñānaṃ tadeva dhvāntaṃ gāḍhāndhakāraṃ tadvidāraṇe tannirākaraṇe ekacaturā ekā pravīṇā punaḥ kimbhūtā kalā parāṃ vācaṃ tanvatī parābhiddhāṃ vāṇīṃ tanvatī vistārayantī || 35 ||
idānīṃ parameśvaryā ananyaparatvenāha(-)
tvaṃ mātāpitarau tvameva suhṛdastvaṃ bhrātarastvaṃ sakhā tvaṃ vidyā tvamudārakīrticaritaṃ tvaṃ bhāgyamatyadbhutaṃ | kimbhūyaḥ sakalaṃ tvamīhitamiti jñātvā kṛpākomale śrīviśveśvari saṃprasīda śaraṇaṃ mātaḥ paraṃ nāsti me || 36 ||
he mātaḥ he kṛpākomale he (kh: śrī) viśveśvari saṃprasīda samyak prasādaṃ kuru yato me mama tvattaḥ paraṃ anyat kimapi śaraṇaṃ nāsti | kiṃkṛtvā iti jñātvā itīti kiṃ he janani tvaṃ mama mātāpitarau jananījanakau eva śabdo'tra nirdhāraṇe punaḥ suhṛdo mitrāṇi tvameva bhrātaro bāndhavāstvameva tvameva sakhā sahacaraḥ vidyāścaturdarśavidyāstvameva tat udārakīrticaritaṃ prabhūkīrtipravarttanaṃ tvameva | atyadbhutaṃ pracurataraṃ bhāgyaṃ tvameva | bhūyaḥ kiṃ punarapi kimucyate sakalamīhitaṃ nikhilaṃ (g: sakalaṃ) vāñchitaṃ tvameveti || 36 ||
idānīṃ paramasiddhikārakaṃ gurornāmāha(-)
śrīsiddhinātha iti ko'pi yuge caturthe prāvirbabhuva (kh, g: prādurbabhūva) karuṇāvaruṇālaye'smin | śrīśambhurityabhidhayā sa mayi prasannaṃ (g: mayi suprasannaṃ) cetaścakāra sakalāgamacakravarttī || 37 ||
śrīsiddhinātheti(-) karuṇāvaruṇālaye karuṇayā yukte varuṇālaye grāmaviśeṣe narmadātaṭanikaṭavarttini śrīsiddhinātha iti kopi caturthe yuge kaliyuge prādurbabhūva (g: prakaṭo'bhūt) kimbhūtaḥ tasmin śrīsiddhināthe abhidhayā śrīśambhuriti saḥ mayi viṣaye ceto manaḥ prasannaṃ cakāra snehaṃ (kh: sasnehaṃ) kṛtavān | punaḥ kimbhūtaḥ śrīśambhuḥ sakalāgamacakravartti sakalāgamacakre varttata iti (sakaleṣvāgameṣu cakravarttī sarvatantrasvatantra iti) kimbhūte asmin śrīsiddhināthe karuṇāvaruṇālaye kṛpāsāgare ityarthaḥ iti tu asminnityasya (g: siddhasyāpi) padasya viśeṣaṇaṃ saṃpanīpadyate || 37 ||
idānīṃ (kh: tasya) kṛpābāhulyaṃ (g: kriyābāhulyaṃ) viracayannāha (kh: viśayadayannāha)
tasyā'jñayā pariṇatānvayasiddhavidyā(-) bhedāspadaiḥ stutipadairvacasāṃ vilāsaiḥ | tasmādanena bhuvaneśvari vedagarbhe sadyaḥ prasīda vadane mama sannidhehi || 38 ||
tasyeti(-) he bhuvaneśvari(!) vedagarbhe(!) yataḥ mayi viśaye saḥ śrīśambhuḥ cetaḥ suprasannaṃ manaścakāra anenaiva hetunā sadyaḥ tatkālaṃ tvaṃ prasīda prasādaparā (kh: prasannā bhava) bhava | tasmātprasādānantaraṃ mama vadane vacasāṃ vāṇīnāṃ vilāsaiḥ sannidhehi sannidhānaṃ kuru | kimbhūtaiḥ vilāsaiḥ stutipadaiḥ stavanānurūpaiḥ punaḥ kimbhūtairvilāsaiḥ tasyājñayāpariṇatānvayasiddhavidyābhedāspadaiḥ (kh: tasya śrīśambhoḥ) ājñayā pariṇataḥ pariṇāmaṃ prāptaḥ yo'nvayaḥ āmnāyo gurukramaḥ tatra siddhavidyānāṃ bhedāspadāni bhedasthānāni taiḥ tathā || 38 ||
athedānīṃ bhagavatyāḥ prārthanāmāha(-)
yeśāṃ paraṃ kuladaivatamambike tvaṃ teṣāṃ girā mama giro na bhavantu (g: bhavanti) miśrāḥ | taistu kṣaṇaṃ paricite (g: paricitirviṣaye) viṣaye'pi vāso mā bhūtkadācidapi (kh: kadāciditi) santatamarthaye tvām || 39 ||
yeṣāmiti(-) he sarveśvari(!) santataṃ nirantaraṃ tvāṃ ahaṃ arthaye prārthayāmi ittiti kiṃ he ambike(!) yeṣāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ paraṃ atyarthaṃ tvaṃ na kuladaivatamasi teṣāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ girā saha mama giro vāṇyaḥ miśrāḥ na bhavantu punaḥ taiḥ puruṣaiḥ saha viṣaye deśe paricite'pi paricayaṃ prāpte'pi abhyāsaṃ prāpte'pi pitṛpitāmahaprapitāmahādinivāsāvanaukṣaṇaṃ (kh: pitṛpitāmahādyāvāse'vanau) kṣaṇamātraṃ kadācidapi vāso mābhūt māstu || 39 ||
idānīṃ gurumabhyarthayannāha(-) (kh: guruvaraṃ prārthayannāha)
śrīśambhunātha(!) karuṇākara(!) siddhinātha(!) śrīsiddhinātha(!) karuṇākara(!) śambhunātha(!) sarvāparādhamaline'pi mayi parannaṃ (g: maline mayi suprasannaṃ) cetaḥ kuruṣva śaraṇaṃ mama nānyadasti || 40 ||
śrīśambhunātheti(-) he śrīśambhunātha(!) he karuṇākara siddhinātha(!) he śrīsiddhinātha karuṇākara śambhunātha(!) sarvāparādhamaline'pi nikhilāparādhakaluṣīkṛte'pi mayi viṣaye ceto manaḥ prasannaṃ sadayaṃ kuruṣva yataḥ kāraṇāt mama kiñcidanyadapi śaraṇaṃ nāsti || 40 ||
idānīṃ parameśvaryā dayāluttvamāha(-)
itthaṃ pratikṣaṇamudaśruvilocanasya pṛthvīdharasya purataḥ sphuṭamāvirāsīt | dattvā varaṃ bhagavatī hṛdayaṃ praviṣṭā śāstraiḥ svayaṃ navanavaiśca mukhe'vatīrṇā || 41 ||
ithamiti(-) itthaṃ anena prakāreṇa gurusmaraṇāditaḥ (kh, g: gurusmaraṇādinā) pratikṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇaṃ prati udaśruvilocanasya atyarthaṃ niryadaśralocanasya (g: aśrupūrṇavilocanasya) pṛthvīdharasya purato'gre sphuṭaṃ prakaṭaṃ yathā bhavati tathā bhagavatī bhuvaneśvarī āvirāsīt prakaṭībabhūva | kimbhūtā varaṃ datvā hṛdayaṃ praviṣṭā punaḥ kimbhūtā ca punaḥ bhagavatī svayaṃ sayameva navanavairgadyapdyādimayaiḥ śāstraiḥ kṛtvā mukhe'vatīrṇā vistāraṃ prāptā || 41 ||
idānīṃ stotraviṣaye prasādamāha(-)
vāksiddhimevamatulāmavalokya nāthaḥ śrīśambhurasya mahatīmapi (kh: mahatīmiha) tāṃ pratiṣṭhām | svasmin pade tribhuvanāgamavandyavidyā(-) siṃhāsanaikarucire suciraṃ cakāra || 42 ||
vāgiti(-) asmin loke nāthaḥ śrīśambhuḥ asya stotrasya vāksiddhiṃ atulāṃ bahulāṃ me vācaṃ avalokya asmin (kh: svasmin) sthāne ciraṃ yathā bhavati tathā tāṃ pāṭhamātrato (kh: g: paṭhanamātrato) hi sakalasiddhividhāyinīṃ mahīyasīṃ mahatīṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ cakāra | kimbhūte svasmin (kh: tasmin) pade tribhuvanāgamavandyavidyāsiṃhāsanaikarucire tribhuvane yāni āgamaśāstrāṇi tairvandyaṃ stutyaṃ vidyāsiṃhāsanaṃ yat tenaikaruciraṃ sundaraṃ tasmin tatheti || 42 ||
idānīṃ mantrajapasamaye vidhānamāha(-)
bhūmau śayyā vacasi niyamaḥ kāminībhyo nirvṛttiḥ prātarjātīviṭapasamidhā (kh: viṭapi) dantajihvāviśuddhiḥ |
patrāvalyāṃ madhuramaśanaṃ brahmavṛkṣasya puṣpaiḥ pūjāhomau kusumavasanālepanānyujjvalāni || 43 ||
bhūmāviti(-) bhūmau śayyā bhūmiśayanaṃ vacasi niyamo vāksaṃyamaḥ kāminībhyo nivṛttiḥ strībhyo nivarttanaṃ tathā prātaḥ prabhāte jātaṃ viṭapasamidhā jātīvṛkṣaśākhayā dantajihvāviśuddhiḥ dantānāṃ jihvāyāśca viśodhanaṃ nirmalīkaraṇaṃ (g: nairmalyaṃ) patrāvalī prasiddhā tasyāṃ madhuramaśanaṃ udanādi (kh: pāyasādi) tathā brahmavṛkṣasya puṣpaiḥ palāśasya puṣpaiḥ kusumaiḥ pūjāhomau kāryau | tathā kusumavasanālepanāni ujjvalāni (kh, g: tathā kusumavasanāni ujjvalāni kusumāni puṣpāṇi śatapatrādīni vasanāni vastrāṇi śubhrāṇīti tathā lepanāni candanādibhavāni etānyujjvalāni iti) || 43 ||
idānīṃ gurusmaraṇato yadbhavati (kh: yadyadbhavati; g: stotrapaṭhanato yadbhavati) tadāha(-)
itthaṃ māsatrayamavikalaṃ yo vratasthaḥ prabhāte madhyāhne vā'stamanasamaye (kh, g: vā'stamitasamaye) kīrtayedekacittaḥ | tasyollāsaiḥ sakalabhuvanāścaryabhūtaiḥ prabhūtaiḥ vidyāḥ sarvāḥ sapadi vadane śambhunāthaprasādāt || 44 ||
itthamiti(-) itthaṃ amunā prakāreṇa yaḥ pumān vratasthaḥ san māsatrayaṃ avikalaṃ nirantaraṃ prabhāte prātaḥ kāle athavā madhyāhne madhyaṃdine athavā astamanasamaye (kh: g: vā'stamitasamaye) sāyaṃ samaye ekacittaḥ ekamanābhūttvā śrīguruṃ kīrttayet (kh, g: śrīstotraṃ kīrtayet paṭhet) paṭhet cintayet tasya puruṣasya sapadi tatkālaṃ vadane mukhe sarvāḥ sakalāḥ vidyāḥ ullāsaiḥ gadyapadyādirūpaiḥ (kh: gadyapadyādimayaiḥ) sphuranti kasmāt śambhunāthaprasādāt kimbhūtairullāsaiḥ prabhūtaiḥ sadyaḥ sphuradrūpaiḥ punaḥ kimbhūtaiḥ sakalabhuvanāścaryabhūtaiḥ (kh: bhuvanāścaryakārakaiḥ) gurusmaraṇataḥ tribhuvanaviṣaye kiṃ na prāpyate apitu sakalameva prāpyata ityarthaḥ || 44 ||
idānīṃ yathārtha(-)prabhāvaṃ stotramahimānamāha(-)
vratena hīno'pyanavāptamantraḥ śraddhāviśuddho'nuditaṃ paṭhedyaḥ (kh: japedyaḥ) | tasyāpi varṣādanavadyasadyaḥ(-) kavittvahṛdyāḥ prabhavanti vidyāḥ || 45 ||
vrateneti(-) yaḥ pumān vratena hīno'pi anavāptamantraḥ aprāptamantraḥ śraddhāviśuddho bhūtvā śraddhayā nirmalīkṛtamānasaḥ san anudinaṃ nirantaraṃ idaṃ japet tasyāpi puruṣasya varṣāt saṃvatsarāt vidyāḥ prabhavanti sphuranti kimbūtāḥ anavadyasadyaḥkavitvahṛdyāḥ anavadyena nirdoṣeṇa sadyaḥ kavittvena tatkāloditakāvyena (kh: tatkālocitakāvyena) hṛdyāḥ manoharāḥ || 45 ||
idānīṃ asya stotrasyācintyamahimānamāha(-)
kopyacintyaḥ prabhāvo'sya stotrasya pratyayāvahaḥ | śrīśambhorājñayā sarvāḥ siddhayo'smin pratiṣṭhitāḥ || 46 ||
kopīti(-) asya stotrasya kopyacintyaḥ prabhāvaḥ pratyayāvaho varttate prītijanako (kh, g: pratītijanako) bhavati yataḥ kāraṇāt śrīśambhorājñayā sarvāḥ aṇimādyāḥ siddhayo'smin stotre pratiṣṭhitāḥ āropitāḥ ata eva acintyamahimastotramityarthaḥ || 46 ||
padmanābhena kavinā vipulā vimalā kṛtā | pṛthvīdharakṛtestenavṛttiḥ (kh: tattu; g: śrīmat pṛthvīdharanutervṛttiḥ sadyuktidīpinī; kh: pṛthvīdharakṛtau tatra vṛttiḥ sadyuktidīpikā) sadyuktidīpikā ||
[iti śrīpadmanābhakaviviracitaṃ bhuvaneśvarīstotrabhāṣyaṃ (kh: vivaraṇam; g: vyākyānam) sampūrṇam] ||
[likhitaṃ brāhmaṇajerāmena] ||
kha pustakasya puṣpikā(-)
|| śubham || saṃvat (1950) pauṣamāsīyakṛṣṇapakṣīyanavamyāṃ śukre gaṃgāsahāyaśarmaṇo lipiḥ | śrīsavāyī śrīmādhavasiṃharājye jayapure pustakamidamāyodhyakasarayuprasādadvivedinaḥ śivaṃ ||
ga pustakasya puṣpikā(-)
vikram saṃvat (1993) likhitaṃ kedāranāthena samāptamadya āśvina śuklapratipadi dehalyām ||
yanmātrā bindubindudvitayapadapadadvandvavarṇādihīnaṃ bhaktyā bhaktyā'nupūrvyaprabhavakṛtavaśādvyaktamavyaktamamba(!) mohādajñānato vā paṭhitamapaṭhitaṃ sāṃprataṃ stotrametat tat sarvaṃ sāṅgamāstāṃ tribhuvanavarade(!) devi vidye(!) prasīda |
[iti śrīpṛthvīdharācāryaviracitaṃ śrībhuvaneśvarīstotraṃ śrīsiddhasārasvatāparaparyāyaṃ jayajayaharikavimallabhaṭṭalikhitaṃ samāptaṃ] ||
śubhaṃ bhavatutamām ||
śrīḥ
[atha bhuvaneśvarīpañcāṅgam]
tatrādau paṭalaḥ
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
atha vakṣye jagaddhātrīmadhunā bhuvaneśvarīm | brahmādayopi yāṃ jñātvā lebhire śriyamuttamām (śriyamūrjitām) || 1 ||
nakuleśo'gninārūḍho vāmanetrārddhacandravān | bījamasyāḥ samākhyātaṃ samagrasiddhikāṅkṣibhiḥ || 2 ||
ṛṣiḥ śaktirbhavecchando gāyatrī samudīritam | devatā surasaṅghena sevitā bhuvaneśvarī || 3 ||
ṣaḍdīrghayuktabījena kuryādaṅgavikalpanam (kuryādaṅgāni ṣatkramāt) | sārasvatoktamārgeṇa (saṃhārasṛṣṭimārgeṇa) mātṛkānyastavigrahaḥ || 4 ||
mantranyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryāddevatābhāvasiddhaye | hṛllekhāṃ mūrddhni vadane gaganāṃ hṛdayāmbuje || 5 ||
raktāṃ karālikāṃ guhye mahocchuṣmāṃ padadvaye | ūrdhvaprāgdakṣiṇodīcyapaścimeṣu mukheṣu ca || 6 ||
madhyādihrasvabījadyā (sadyādi | sadya okāraḥ tadādayaḥ pañcahrasvā o e u i a ityādyā hṛllekhādyāḥ śaktayo nyastavyā iti) nyastavyā bhūtasaprabhāḥ | brahmāṇaṃ vinyasedbhāle gāyatryā saha saṃyutam || 7 ||
sāvitryā sahitaṃ viṣṇuṃ kapole dakṣaṇe nyaset | vāgīśvaryyā samāyuktaṃ vāmagaṇḍeśvaraṃ tathā (vāmagaṇḍe maheśvaram) || 8 ||
śriyā gaṇapatiṃ nyasya puṣṭyā gaṇapatiṃ tathā (śriyā dhanapatiṃ paścādvāmakarṇāgrike punaḥ | ratyā smaraṃ mukhe nyasyet puṣṭyā gaṇapatiṃ tathā (siṃ siṃ)) | savyakarṇopari siddhiṃ (nidhi) karṇagaṇḍāntarālayoḥ || 9 ||
nyastavyaṃ (nyastavyau) vadane mūlaṃ punaścaitāṃstanau nyaset | kaṇṭhamūle stanadvandve vāmāṃse hṛdayāmbuje || 10 ||
savyāṃse pārśvayugale nābhideśe ca daiśikaḥ | bhālāṃsapārśvajaṭhare pārśvamapakare (pārśvāṃsāparake) hṛdi || 11 ||
brahmāṇyādyāstanau nyasyā vidhinā proktalakṣaṇāḥ | mūlena vyāpakaṃ dehe nyaseddevīṃ vicintayet || 12 ||
udyadinadyutimindukirīṭāṃ tuṅgakucāṃ nayanatrayayuktām | smeramukhīṃ varadāṅkuśaṇaśābhītikarāṃ prabhaje bhuvaneśīm (varadādisthitistu padārthādarśe yathā(-) vāmādhohaste varaṃ dakṣiṇordhve aṃkuśaṃ vāmordhve pāśaṃ dakṣādhobhayamiti sampradāyavidaḥ) || 13 ||
prabhajen (prajapen) mantravinmaṃtraṃ dvātriṃśallakṣamānataḥ | trisvāduyuktairjuhuyādaṣṭadravyairdaśāṃśataḥ (trisvādūktaiḥ prajuhuyādaṣṭadravyairdaśāṃśataḥ | trisvādu ghṛtamadhuśarkarāḥ aṣṭadravyāṇi(-) aśvatthodumbaraplakṣanyagrodhasamidhastitāḥ | siddhārthapāyasājyāni dravyāṇyaṣṭau vidurbudhā iti) || 14 ||
dadyādarghyaṃ dineśāya tatra saṃcintya pārvatīm | padmākāraṃ likhedyantraṃ tatkāle sādhakottamaḥ || 15 ||
padmamaṣṭadalaṃ bāhye padmaṃ ṣoḍaśabhirdalaiḥ | vilikhet karṇikāmadhye ṣaṭkoṇamatisundaram || 16 ||
bindutrikoṇaṃ rasakoṇasaṃyutaṃ vṛttāñcitaṃ nāgadalena maṇḍitam | kalāravṛttatrayabhūgṛhāṅkitaṃ śrīcakrameva navaśaktisamanvitañca || 17 ||
jayākhyā vijayā paścādajitāhvā'parājitā | nityā vilāsinī dogdhrī tvaghorā maṅgalā nava || 18 ||
bījādyamāsanaṃ dattvā mūrtiṃ tenaiva kalpayet | tasyāṃ sampujayeddevīmāvāhyāvaraṇaiḥ kramāt || 19 ||
madhyapradakṣiṇodīcyapaścimeṣu yathākramam (madhyaprāgyāmyasaumyeṣu paścimeṣu yathākramāt) | hṛllekhādyāḥ samabhyarcyāḥ pañcabhūtasamaprabhāḥ || 20 ||
varapāśāṅkuśābhītidhāriṇyo'mitabhūṣaṇāḥ | sthāneṣu pūrvamukteṣu pūjayedaṅgadevatāḥ || 21 ||
ṣaṭkoṇeṣu yajenmantrī paścānmithunadevatāḥ | indrakoṇe lasaddaṇḍakuṇḍikākṣaguṇābhayām || 22 ||
gāyatrīṃ pūjayenmaṃtrī brahmāṇamapi tādṛśam | rakṣakoṇe cakraśaṅkhagadāpaṅkajadhāriṇīm || 23 ||
sāvitrīṃ pītavasanāṃ yajedviṣṇuṃ ca tādṛśam | vāyukoṇe paraśvakṣamālābhayavarānvitam || 24 ||
yajet sarasvatīṃ paścādrudraṃ (acchāṃ rudraṃ) tādṛśalakṣaṇam | vahnikoṇe yajedratnakumbharatnakaraṇḍakam || 25 ||
karābhyāṃ bibhrataṃ pītaṃ tundilaṃ dhananāyakam | āliṅgya savyahastena vāmenāmbujadhāriṇīm || 26 ||
dhanadāṅkasamārūḍhāṃ mahālakṣmīṃ prapūjayet | vāruṇyāṃ (vāruṇe) madanaṃ bāṇapāśāṅkuśaśarāsanam || 27 ||
dhārayantaṃ samāraktaṃ (japāraktaṃ) pūjayedratnabhūṣaṇam | savyena patimāśliṣya vāmenotpaladhāriṇīm | pāṇinā ramaṇāṅkasthāṃ ratiṃ samyak samarcayet || 28 ||
īśāne (aiśānye) pūjayet samyag vighnarājaṃ priyānvitam || 29 ||
sṛṇipāśadharaṃ kāntaṃ (kāntā) varāṅgasṛkkarāṅgulim (spṛk) | mādhvīpūrṇakapālañca (kapālāḍhyaṃ) varṇarājaṃ digambaram || 30 ||
puṣkalaṃ (puṣkare) vigaladratnasphuraccaṣakadhāriṇam | sindūrasadṛśākārāṃ saṃmudāṃ (uddāma) madavibhramām || 31 ||
dhṛtaraktotpalāmanyapāṇinā taddhvajaspṛśām | āśliṣṭakāntāmaruṇāṃ puṣṭimarcceddigambarām || 32 ||
karṇikāyāṃ nidhī pūjyau ṣatkoṇasyātha (ṣaṭkoṇebhaya) pārśvayoḥ | aṅgāni kesareṣvetāḥ paścāt patreṣu pūjayet || 33 ||
anaṅgakusumā paścādanaṅgakusumāruṇā (anaṅgakusumāturā) | anaṅgamadanā tadvadanaṅgamadanāturā || 34 ||
bhuvanapālā gaganavegā caiva tataḥ param | śaśirekhā ca gaganarekhā cetyaṣṭaśaktayaḥ || 35 ||
pāśāṅkuśavarābhītidhāriṇyo'ruṇavigrahāḥ | tataḥ ṣoḍaśapatreṣu karālī vikarālyumā || 36 ||
sarasvatī śrīrdurgoṣā lakṣmīśrutyau smṛtirdhṛtiḥ | śraddhā medhā matiḥ kāntirāryā ṣoḍaśaśaktayaḥ || 37 ||
khaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇyaḥ śyāmāḥ pūjyāśca mātaraḥ | padmādbahiḥ samabhyarcyāḥ śaktayaḥ paricārakāḥ (parivārikāḥ) || 38 ||
prathamānaṅgarūpā syādanaṅgamadanā tathā | madanāturā tu bhavanavegā bhuvanamālikā (bhuvanapālikā) || 39 ||
syātpūrvamadanānaṅgavedanānaṅgamekhalā (syāt sarvaśiśirānaṅgamadanānaṅgamekhalā) | caṣakaṃ tālavṛntaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ chatramujjvalam || 40 ||
cāmare cāṃśukaṃ puṣpaṃ bibhrāṇāṃ karapaṅkajaiḥ | sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktāṃ gurupaṅktitrayaṃ yajet || 41 ||
divyaughāṃścaiva siddhaughān mānavaughān yathākramāt | sarvābharaṇasandīptāṃllokapālān bahiryajet || 42 ||
indrāgniyamanair(-)ṛtyavaruṇā marutastathā | kubera īśapatayaḥ pūrvādīnāṃ diśāṃ kramāt || 43 ||
gajo meṣaśca mahiṣaḥ preto makara eva ca | mṛgo naro vṛṣaścaite pūjyāḥ pūrvāditaḥ kramāt || 44 ||
vajraḥ śaktistathā daṇḍaḥ khaḍgapāśau tathāṅkuśaḥ | gadā triśūla ityete pūrvādyāścāyudhāḥ smṛtāḥ || 45 ||
ūdhrvādhaḥ kramataḥ pūjyau brahmā viṣṇustathaiva ca | haṃsatārkṣyau padmacakre pūrvādīnāṃ samāgamaiḥ || 46 ||
pūjyate sakalairdaivaiḥ kiṃ punarmanujottamaiḥ | mantrī trimadhūpetairhutvā'śvatthasamidvaraiḥ (trimadhuropetaiḥ) || 47 ||
brāhmaṇān vaśayecchīghraṃ pārthivān padmahomataḥ | palāśapuṣpaistatpatnīrmaṃtriṇaḥ kusumairapi (kumudairapi) || 48 ||
pañcaviṃśatisaṃjaptairjalaiḥ snāne (nityaṃ) dine dine | ātmānamabhiṣiñcedyaḥ sarvasaubhāgyavān bhavet || 49 ||
pañcaviṃśatisaṃjaptaṃ jalaṃ prātaḥ pibennaraḥ | avāpya (avaśyaṃ) mahatīṃ prajñāṃ kavīnāmagraṇīrbhavet || 50 ||
karpūrāgarusaṃyuktaṃ kuṃkumaṃ sādhu sādhitam | gṛhītvā tilakaṃ kuryādrājyavaśyamanuttamam (rāja) || 51 ||
śālipiṣṭamayīṃ kṛtvā puttalīṃ madhurānvitāṃ | japtvā (japtāṃ) pratiṣṭhitaprāṇāṃ bhakṣayedravivāsare || 52 ||
vaśaṃ nayati rājānaṃ nārīṃ vā narameva ca | kaṇṭhamātrodake sthitvā vīkṣyeta khagataṃ (vīkṣya toyagataṃ) ravim || 53 ||
triḥsahasraṃ japenmaṃtraṃ iṣṭakanyāṃ labheta saḥ | annaṃ tu maṃtritaṃ mantrī bhuñjīta śrīprasiddhaye || 54 ||
likhitvā (likhitāṃ) bhasmanā'māyāṃ susādhyāṃ phalakādiṣu | tatkālaṃ (tatkāle) ca likhedyaṃtraṃ (darśayedyantraṃ) sukhaṃ sūyati (sūyeta) garbhiṇī || 55 ||
śaktyantaḥsthitasādhyakarma bhuvane (bhavane (siṃ siṃ)) vahnervṛtaṃ vahnibhirbāhye (śaktibhiḥ (siṃ siṃ)) koṇagateyutaṃ (koṇagateyutamiti koṇagatena īkāreṇa yutamityarthaḥ sabinduneti sampradāyaḥ asyārthaḥ(##-) bhuvaneśvarībījaṃ vilikhya tasya rephasthāne sādhyanāma īkārasthāne sādhakanāma tayormadhye karmaṃ ca vilikhya tadbhuvaneśvarībījairāveṣṭya trikoṇasya koṇatrayābhyantare sabindukamīkāraṃ vilikhya trikoṇāgreṣu bhuvaneśvarībījaṃ pratikoṇaṃ vilikhya teṣāṃ trayāṇāmekaikabījasya repheṇa tattadbījaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtyā'nyonyasyekārāgraṃ parasparaṃ badhnīyāt | tataḥ koṇatrayapārśvayoḥ harihara iti varṇacatuṣṭayaṃ vilikhya bahirvṛttatrayaṃ kṛtvā tanmadhyagatavīthīdvaye prathamavīthyāṃ svāgrādiprādakṣiṇena hari ī hara ī iti varṇaiḥ punaḥ punarlikhitairāveṣṭya dvitīyavīthyāṃ akārādikṣakārāntaiḥ sabindukairmātṛkākṣaraiḥ svāgrādiprādakṣiṇyena veṣṭayitvā sarvabāhye caturasraṃ kuryādetadyantramuktaphaladaṃ bhavati tathā ca(-)
atrāpi sampade devīṃ yathāvidhi samāhitaḥ | hṛllekhādyāḥ samabhyarcya pūrvavat sādhakaḥ svayam ||
aṅgāni pūjayet paścād gāyatryādyāḥ prapūjayet | prāgagrabīje gāyatrīṃ sāvitrīṃ dakṣiṇāsrage | sarasvatīṃ mārutasthe brahmāṇaṃ bahnige tathā || vāruṇe viṣṇumīśaṃ ca yajedīśe tato bahiḥ | brahmāṇyādyā lokapālāstadubāhye kuliśādayaḥ || evaṃ triguṇitaiḥ devīṃ pūjayet sādhakotāmaḥ || (siṃ siṃ patra 414) hariharaivarṇaiḥ kapolārpitaiḥ | paścāt taiḥ punarīyutairlipibhirapyāvītamiṣṭākṣaraṃ (miṣṭārthadaṃ) (siṃ siṃ) yaṃtraṃ bhūpuramadhyagaṃ triguṇitaṃ saubhāgyasampatpradam || 56 ||
bījāntaḥsthitasādhyanāma śaraśo māyāramāmanmathai(-) rvītaṃ vahnipuradvaye rasapuṭeṣvāṣāḍhabījatrayam (ālikhya bījatrayam) | svātmā (sātmā) nātmakamīṣase (mīśikhaṃ) hariharairābaddhagaṇḍaṃ bahiḥ ṣaḍbījairanubaddhasandhilipibhirvītaṃ gṛhābhyāṃ tu vaḥ (bhuvaḥ) || 57 ||
cintāmaṇinṛsiṃhābhyāṃ lasatkoṇamidaṃ likhet | yantraṃ ṣaḍguṇitaṃ divyaṃ vahatāṃ sarvasiddhidaṃ (bahiḥ ṣoḍaśaśūlāṅkamatīva ca manoramam | etat ṣaḍguṇitaṃ yantraṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ param || 1 ||
atra devīṃ yajenmaṃtrī yadyasyopariśobhanam | padmaṃ dvādaśapatraṃ ca ṣaḍviṃśatkesarānvitam || 2 ||
bahiśca rāśyādikena yuktaṃ kuryānmanoharam | navaśaktiyutaṃ pīṭhaṃ saṃpūjyāvāhya devatām || 3 ||
saṃpūjayet candanādairupacāraiśca pūrvavat | proktavacca ṣaḍaṅgāni mithunāni ca saṃyajet || 4 ||
bahirdvādaśaśaktīśca raktādyāḥ saṃyajet kramāt | raktā cānaṅgakusumā nityā ca kusumāturā || 5 ||
anaṅgamadanā tadvad bhavecca madanāturā | gaurī ca gaganā tadvad rekhāntaṃ gaganaṃ padam || 6 ||
anena vidhinā maṃtrī yo'rcayedbhuvaneśvarīm | sa lakṣmīnilayo bhūyāt tridaśaiścābhivanditaḥ || 7 ||
dehānte śivasāyujyaṃ sa prāpnoti suniścitam | iti siṃhasiddhāntasindhau viśeṣaḥ ||) || 58 || (asyārthaḥ(-) tatra sveṣṭamānabhrameṇa vṛttaṃ kṛtvā tatra prāk pratyagbrahmasūtramāsphālya tadagrayoḥ sandhimavaṣṭabhya vṛttārdhaparimāṇena sūtreṇa vṛttasaṃdaṣṭaṃ matsyadvayaṃ matsyadvayaṃ dakṣinottarayoḥ kuryāt | evaṃkṛte matsyacatuṣkaṃ saṃpannaṃ bhavati tataḥ pūrvamatsyadvaye ca dakṣiṇottaraṃ tiryaksūtradvayamāsphālya brahmasūtrasya prāgagre vidhāya paścimamatsyadvayayostiryaksūtradvayamāsphālya punarbrahmasūtrasya paścimāgre nidhāya pūrvadiṅmatsyodarayoḥ sūtradvayamāsphālayet | evaṃ kṛte vahnimaṇḍaladvayaṃ jāyate tato vṛttaṃ prācīsūtraṃ ca mārjayedityevaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ kṛtvā tanmadhye śaktibījamālikhya tasya rephabhāge sādhyanāmālikhya tasyekārasvarabhāge sādhakanāmālikhya rephekārayorantarālaṃ sādhakāṃśe karma likhedityevaṃ svābhimataṃ vilikhya madhyasthabījoparito veṣṭanaprakāreṇa pañcadhāśaktibījaṃ vilikhya tadbahiḥ pañcadhā śrībījaṃ punastadbahiḥ pañcadhā kāmabījaṃ vilikhya ṣaṭkoṇasyodhrvagatakoṇatraye uttaramadhyadakṣiṇakrameṇa śaktiśrīkāmabījāni pratitrikoṇamekaikaṃ bījaṃ sādhakanāmayutaṃ vilikhyādhogatatrikoṇatraye tānyeva bījāni visargayuktāni sasādhyanāmāni dakṣiṇamadhyottarakrameṇa vilikhya ṣaṭsvapi trikoṇodareṣu sabinduṃ caturthasvaramīkāramālikhya ṣaṭkoṇasya pratikoṇapārśvayoḥ harihara iti dvādaśadhā vilikhya ṣaṭsu trikoṇāgreṣu pratitrikoṇāgramekamekaṃ śaktibījaṃ vilikhya pūrvavadekaikāntaritaṃ badhnīyāt uktaṃ cācāryacaraṇaiḥ ekaikāntaritāstāstu sambaddhyuritaretaramiti tato bahirvṛttatrayaṃ kṛtvā vīthīdvayaṃ niṣpādya tatrābhyantaravīthyāṃ svāgrādi prādakṣiṇyena sabindūnakārādikṣakārāntān mātṛkāvarṇān vilikhya bahirvīthyāṃ tāneva kṣakārādyakārāntakrameṇa prādakṣiṇyena vilikhet uktaṃ ca ācāryacaraṇaiḥ(-)
bāhye rekhāmantarāḥ syurvarṇāḥ kramagatāḥ śubhāḥ | tadbahiḥ pratilomāśca te syurlekhakapāṭavāt || iti
tato bahiraṣṭakoṇaṃ vidhāya tasya diggatakrameṇa catuṣke vakṣyamāṇaṃ nṛsiṃhabījaṃ vilikhya vidiggate koṇacatuṣke vakṣyamāṇaṃ cintāmaṇibījaṃ vilikhyāṣṭakoṇastharekhāṣṭakaprāntaṣoḍaśake ṣoḍaśatriśūlāni kuryāt uktañcācāryacaraṇaiḥ(-)
bahiḥ ṣoḍaśaśūlāṅkaṃ śobhanaṃ vyaktavarṇavat iti etat ṣaḍguṇitaṃ yantramuktaphaladaṃ bhavati || (siṃ siṃ patra 415)
bījaṃ vyāhṛtibhiryutaṃ (vṛtaṃ) gṛhayugadvandve vasoḥ koṇagaṃ daurgaṃ bījamanantare lipiyutairābaddhagaṇḍaṃ likhet | gāyatryā raviśaktibaddhavivaraṃ triṣṭubyutaṃ tat tato bījaṃ mātṛkayā dharāpurayuge satsiṃhacintāmaṇiḥ || 59 ||
yaṃtraṃ dineśaguṇitaṃ proktai rakṣāprasiddhidam | sarvasaubhāgyajananaṃ sarvaśatrunivāraṇam asyārthaḥ- tatra prāgvat ṣaṭkoṇamālikhya tasya sandhiṣaṭke trikoṇaṣaṭkaṃ yathā vyaktaṃ bhavati tathā gurūktayuktyā ṣaṭkoṇāntaraṃ vilikhya tanmadhye prāgvat sādhyasādhakakarmayuktaṃ śaktibījamālikhya tatpratilomena vyāhṛtibhirveṣṭayet taduktamācāryaiḥ(-)
śaktiṃ praveṣṭayecca pratilomavyāhṛtibhirantasthāmiti tato dvādaśatrikoṇodareṣu duṃ iti durgābījaṃ volikhya teṣveva sānusvāraṃ caturthasvaraṃ likhet taduktamācāryacaraṇaiḥ(-)
ravikoṇeṣu durantāṃ māyāṃ likhedadyātra bindumatīmiti tato dvādaśatrikoṇapārśvadvaye pratipārśvamekamiti krameṇa vaidikagāyatryāścaturviṃśativarṇān sabindūn prādakṣiṇyena pratilomagatān vilikhet uktañcācāryacaraṇaiḥ(-) gāyatrīṃ pratilomataḥ pravilikhedagneḥ kapolamiti tataḥ pūrvavaddvādaśa trikoṇāgreṣu śaktibījāni vilikhya tāni parasparaṃ pūrvavadekāntaritaṃ badhnīyāt tadbahirvṛttadvayaṃ vidhāya tayorantarālagatavīthyām(-)
jātavedase sunavāma somamarātīyato ni dahāti vedaḥ | sa naḥ parṣadati durgāṇi viśvā nāveva sindhuṃ duritātyagniḥ | ṛgvedaḥ 1|7|7|1
iti triṣṭubhmaṃtrasya sabindubhirvarṇaiḥ pratilomena veṣṭayet uktañcācāryacaraṇaiḥ(-)
bahiśca racayedbhūyastathā triṣṭubhamiti
tatra śrīpadmapādācāryavyākhyā(-) tathā triṣṭubhamiti pratilomenetyarthaḥ | tataḥ prāgvadanulomamātṛkayā vilomamātṛkayā ca saṃveṣṭya tadbahiraṣṭakoṇaṃ kṛtvā prāgvattattatkoṇeṣu nṛsiṃhabījaṃ cintāmaṇibījaṃ ca vilikhya tathaiva ṣoḍaśaśūlayuktaṃ kuryādityetadyantramuktaphaladaṃ bhavati | (siṃ siṃ pṛ 416) ||60 ||
likhet sarojaṃ rasapatrayuktaṃ madhye daleṣvapyabhilikhya māyām | svarāvṛtaṃ yaṃtramidaṃ vadhūnāṃ putrapradaṃ bhūmigṛhāntarastham (asyārthaḥ(-) bhūrjādau ṣaḍdalakamalaṃ vidhāya tanmadhye sasādhyaṃ śaktibījamālikhya ṣaṭsu daleṣvapi śaktibījamevālikhya tadbahirvṛttadvayaṃ vidhāya tayorantarāle sabindubhiḥ ṣoḍaśasvarairāveṣṭya tadbahiścaturasraṃ kuryāt | etadyaṃtramuktaphalam | (siṃ siṃ pṛ 416) || 61 ||
ṣaṭkoṇamadhye pravilikhya śaktiṃ koṇeṣu nāmaiva vilikhya bhūyaḥ | sa sādhyagarbhaṃ vasudhāpurasthaṃ yaṃtraṃ bhavedvaśyakaraṃ narāṇām (asyārthaḥ prāgvat ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vidhāya tanmadhye tatkoṇeṣu ca sasādhyaṃ śaktibījamālikhya tadbahiścaturasraṃ kuryāt etadyaṃtramuktaphaladam | (siṃ siṃ pṛ 416) || 62 ||
vāgbhavaṃ śambhuvanitāramābījatrayātmakam | maṃtraṃ samuddharenmaṃtrī trivargaphalasādhanam (vāgbhavaṃ eṃ śambhuvanitā hrīṃ ramābījaṃ śrīṃ iti) || 63 ||
ṣaḍdīrghabhāgbījena vāgbhavādyena kalpayet | ṣaḍaṅgāni manorasya jātiyuktāni maṃtravit || 64 ||
kuryāt pūrvoditān nyāsān cintayedapi sādhakaḥ | sindūrāruṇavigrahāṃ trinayanāṃ māṇikyamaulisphurat(-) tārānāyakaśekharāṃ smitamukhīmāpīnavakṣoruhām | pāṇibhyāṃ maṇipūrṇaratnacaṣakaṃ raktotpalaṃ bibhratīṃ saumyāṃ raktaghaṭasthasavyacaraṇāṃ dhyāyet parāmambikām || 65 ||
ravilakṣaṃ japenmaṃtraṃ pāyasairmadhurāplutaiḥ | daśāṃśaṃ juhuyānmaṃtrī pīṭhe prāgīrite yajet || 66 ||
devīṃ prāguktamārgeṇa gandhādyairatiśobhanaiḥ | hutvā palāśakusumaiḥ vākśriyaṃ mahatīṃ vrajet || 67 ||
brāhmīghṛtaṃ pibejjaptaṃ kavittvaṃ vatsarādbhavet | siddhārthaṃ lavaṇopetaṃ hutvā maṃtrī vaśaṃ nayet || 68 ||
naraṃ nārīṃ narapatiṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā | caturaṅgulajaiḥ puṣpaiścandanādbhasmasūkṣitaiḥ (candanāmbhaḥ samukṣitaiḥ) || 69 ||
hutvā vaśīkarotyāśu trailokyamapi sādhakaḥ | juhuyādaruṇāmbhojairayutaṃ madhurāplutaiḥ || 70 ||
rājā śriyamavāpnoti śālijaistandulaistathā (rājyaśriyamavāpnoti satilaistaṇḍulaistathā) | prāguktānyapi karmāṇi maṃtreṇānena sādhayet || 71 ||
vāgbījapuṭitā māyā vidyeyaṃ tryakṣarī matā | madhyena dīrghayuktena vākpuṭitena (vākpuṭena prakalpayet) kalpayet || 72 ||
aṅgāni jātiyuktāni krameṇa maṃtravittamaḥ | yathā purā samuddiṣṭaṃ nyāsaṃ kurvīta mantravit || 73 ||
śyāmāṅgīṃ śaśiśekharāṃ nijakarairdānaṃ ca raktotpalaṃ raktāḍhyaṃ caṣakaṃ varaṃ (paraṃ) bhayaharaṃ saṃbibhratīṃ śāśvatīm | muktāhāralasatpayodharanatāṃ netratrayollāsinīṃ vande'haṃ surapūjitāṃ haravadhūṃ raktāravindasthitām || 74 ||
tatvalakṣaṃ japenmaṃtraṃ juhuyāttaddaśāṃśataḥ | palāśapuṣpaistadvaktraiḥ (svādvaktaiḥ) puṣpairvā rājavṛkṣakaiḥ || 75 ||
hṛllekhāvihite pīṭhe pūjayet parameśvarīṃ | madhyādi pūjayenmantrī hṛllekhādyāḥ puroditāḥ || 76 ||
mithunāni yajenmantrī ṣaṭkoṇeṣu yathā purā | aṃgapūjā kesareṣu pūjyāḥ patreṣu mātaraḥ || 77 ||
bhairavāṅkasamārūḍhāḥ smeravaktrā madālasāḥ | asitāṅgo ruruścaṇḍaḥkrodhaśconmattasaṃjñakaḥ || 78 ||
kapālibhiṣaṇau paścāt saṃhārāścāṣṭabhairavāḥ | śūlaṃ kapālaṃ bhītiṃ (pretaṃ) ca bibhrāṇāḥ kṣudradundubhim || 79 ||
gajatvagambarā bhīmāḥ kuṭilālakaśobhitāḥ (śobhinaḥ) | dīrghādyā mātaraḥ proktā hrasvādyā bhairavāḥ smṛtāḥ || 80 ||
pūjyāḥ ṣoḍaśapatreṣu karālyādyāḥ puroditāḥ | tadbāhye'naṅgarūpādyā lokeśāstrāṇi tadbahiḥ || 81 ||
evamārādhayeddevīṃ śāstroktenaiva vartmanā | vaśaṃ nayati rājānaṃ vanitāśca madālasāḥ || 82 ||
annamājyena juhuyāllabhate vasu vāñchitam | sugandhaiḥ kusumairhutvā śriyamāpnoti vāñchitām || 83 ||
mantreṇānena saṃjaptamaśnīyādannamanvaham | bhavedarogī (bhavedarogo) niyataṃ dīrghamāyuravāpnuyāt || 84 ||
ananto bindusaṃyukto māyā brahmāgnitāravān | pāśāditryakṣaro mantraḥ sarvavaśyaphalapradaḥ (spaṣṭārthaḥ(-) ananta ākāraḥ bindusaṃyuktastena āṃ māyā bhuvaneśī brahmā kakāraḥ agni rephaḥ tāraḥ praṇavastābhyāṃ yuktastena kroṃ | atra prathamabījasya pāśa iti saṃjñā antyasyāṅkuśa iti saṃjñā) || 85 ||
ṛṣyādyāḥ pūrvamuktāḥ syurbījenāṅgakriyā matā || 86 ||
varāṅkuśau pāśamabhītimudrāṃ karairvahantīṃ kamalāsanasthām | bālārkakoṭipratimāṃ trinetrāṃ bhaje'hamādyāṃ bhuvaneśvarīṃ tām || 87 ||
haviṣyabhug japenmaṃtraṃ tattvalakṣaṃ (caturviṃśatilakṣamityarthaḥ) jitendriyaḥ | tatsahasraṃ prajuhuyājjapānte mantravittamaḥ || 88 ||
dadhikṣaudraghṛtāktābhiḥ (madhu kṣaudramityamaraḥ) samidbhiḥ kṣīrabhūruhām | tatsaṃkhyeyatilaiḥ śuddhaiḥ payoktairjuhuyāttataḥ || 89 ||
hṛllekhāvihite pīṭhe navaśaktisamanvite | arcayet parameśāni vakṣyamāṇakrameṇa tām || 90 ||
hṛllekhādyā yajedādau karṇikāyāṃ yathāvidhi | aṅgāni keśareṣu syuḥ patrasthā mātaraḥ kramāt || 91 ||
indrādayaḥ punaḥ pūjyāsteṣāmastrāṇi tadbahiḥ | evaṃ sampūjayeddevīṃ sākṣādvaiśravaṇo bhavet || 92 ||
rajyate sakalairlokaistejasā bhāskaropamaḥ | anenādhiṣṭhitaṃ gehaṃ niśi dīpaśikhākulam || 93 ||
dṛśyate prāṇibhiḥ sarvairmantrasyāsya prabhāvataḥ | sarṣapairlājasaṃmiśrai rājyārthe juhuyānniśi || 94 ||
rājānaṃ vaśayet sadyastatpatnīmapi sādhakaḥ | annavānannahomena śrīmān padmahutādbhavet || 95 ||
rājavṛkṣasamudbhūtaiḥ puṣpairhutvā kavirbhavet | arogo tilahomena ghṛtenāyuravāpnuyāt || 96 ||
prākproktānyapi karmāṇi sādhayet sādhakottamaḥ | ālikhyāṣṭadigargalānyudaragaṃ pāśādikaṃ tryakṣaraṃ koṣṭheṣvaṅgamanūdareṣu (manūn pareṣu) vilikhedaṣṭārṇamantradvayam | acpūrvāparaṣaṭkayuglayavarān vyomāsanāmargale(##-) ṣvālikhyendrajalādhipādiguṇaśaḥ paṃktidvayaṃ tatparam (atra viṣamapadavyākhyā acpūrveti(-) acāṃ svarāṇāṃ napuṃsakavyatiriktānām | pūrvaṣaṭkaṃ a ā i ī u ū | aparaṣaṭkaṃ e ai o au aṃ aḥ | etadyuktān layavarān | vyomāsanān vyoma hakārastatrāsanā sthitiryeṣāṃ tādṛśām | indrajalādhipādi pūrvapaścimādi | guṇaśaḥ akṣaratritayakrameṇa | aṣṭayugārṇaṃ ṣoḍaśārṇam | ātmasahitāṃ yugmasvarāntargatāṃ māyāmiti | ātmā haṃsaḥ māyāśabdenātra caturthasvaro jñeyaḥ | tathā ca nighaṇṭumātṛkāyāṃ(-)
īstrimūrtirvāmanetraṃ śekharaḥ kauṭilastathā | vāgmī śuddhaśca jihvākhyo māyāviṣṇuḥ prakāśitaḥ || ityukteḥ |
ātmasahitayugmasvarāntargatamāyālekhanakramastu dakṣiṇāmurtisaṃhitāyām(##-)
haṃsaḥ padaṃ vāmanetraṃ bindvinduparibhūṣitaṃ | punarhaṃsaḥ padaṃ caitat pañcārṇammanumālikhet ||
svaradvandvodaragataṃ saptārṇaṃ cāṣṭadhā bhavet | iti ||
tena aṃ haṃsaḥ īṃ haṃsaḥ āṃ ityādikrameṇa kesareṣu sapta sapta varṇā lekhyāḥ |
prapañcasārepyetad yantranirmāṇamuktaṃ yathā(-)
aṣṭāśāntargatāvirhalayavarayutācpūrvapāścātyaṣaṭkaṃ koṇodyatsvāṅgasāṣṭākṣarayugayugalāṣṭākṣarākhyaṃ bahiśca | māyopetāt sayugmasvaramilitalasatkesaraṃ sāṣṭapatraṃ padmaṃ tanmadhyapaṅktitritayaparilasatpāśaśaktyaṅkuśārṇam || 1 ||
pāśāṅkuśāvṛtamanupratilomagaiśca varṇaiḥ sarojapuṭitena ghaṭena cāpi | āvītamiṣṭaphalabhadraghaṭaṃ tadetadyantrottamantviti ghaṭārgalanāmadheym ||2||
prākpratyagargale halamatha punarāgneyamārute ca hayam | dakṣottare havārṇaṃ nair(-)ṛtaśaive dvipaṅktiśo vilikhet || 3 ||
vilikhecca karṇikāyāṃ pāśāṅkuśasādhyasaṃyutāṃ śaktim | abhyantarasthakoṣṭhesvaṅgānyavaśeṣiteṣu cāṣṭārṇe || 4 ||
koṣṭheṣu ṣoḍaśasvatha ṣoḍaṣavarṇaṃ manuṃ tathā mantrī | padmasya kesareṣu ca yugasvarātmānivitāṃ tathā māyām || 5 ||
ekaikeṣu daleṣu triśastriśaḥ karṇikāgatān maṃtrān | pāśāṅkuśabījābhyāṃ praveṣṭayedbāhyataśca nalinasya || 6 ||
anulomavilomagataiḥ praveṣṭayedakṣaraiśca tadbāhye | tadanu ghaṭena sarojasthitena tadvaktrake'bujaṃ vilikhet || 7 ||
sārasaṃgrahe(-)
ghaṭārgalābhidhaṃ yaṃtraṃ sarvasampatkaraṃ param |) || 97 ||
kośeṣvaṣṭayugārṇamātmasadṛśāṃ (sahitāṃ) yugmasvarāntargatāṃ māyāṃ kesaragāṃ daleṣu vilikhen mūlaṃ tripaṅktiḥ kramāt | triḥpāśāṅkuśaveṣṭitaṃ lipibhirāvītaṃ kramādvyutkramāt padmasthena ghaṭena paṅkajamukhenāveṣṭitaṃ tadbahiḥ || 98 ||
ghaṭārgalamidaṃ yaṃtraṃ mantriṇāṃ prābhṛtaṃ matam | pāśaśrīśaktikandarpakāmaśaktyādiraṅkuśaḥ (śaktīndirāṅkuśāḥ) || 99 ||
prathamo'ṣṭākṣaro mantrastataḥ kāmini rañjini | svāhāṃtoṣṭākṣaraḥ sadbhiraparaḥ kīrtito manuḥ || 100 ||
hrīṃ gauri rudradayite yogeśvari savarma phaṭ | dviṭhāntaḥ ṣoḍaśārṇo'yaṃ mantraḥ sadbhirudīritaḥ || 101 ||
likhitvā bhūrjapatrādau yantramadhye (mantrametat) yathāvidhi | dhāryedvāmabāhau vā kaṇṭhe vā nijamūrddhani || 102 ||
vaśayet sakalān devān (martyān) viśeṣeṇa mahīpatīn | nīlapaṭṭe vilikhyaitadguṭikīkṛtya tatpunaḥ (sādhyapratikṛtau sikthanirmitāyāṃ hṛdi nyaset | pātre trimadhurāpūrṇe nikṣipyaināṃ vidhānataḥ ||
sampūjya gandhapuṣpādyairbaliṃ nikṣipya rātriṣu | mūlamaṃtraṃ japenmantrī nityamaṣṭasahasrakam ||
saptāhād vāñchitāṃ nārīmāharetsmaravihvalām | bhūrjapatre vilikhyaitad guṭikīkṛtya tatpunaḥ || iti śāradātilake viśeṣaḥ) || 103 ||
lākṣayā tāmrarajatakāñcanairveṣṭayet kramāt | tatkumbhe nyasya sampūjya yathāvad bhuvaneśvarīm || 104 ||
saṃspṛśya tajjapenmantraṃ yathāvidhi (divākara) sahasrakam | abhiṣicya priyaṃ sādhyaṃ badhnīyādghaṭamāśikham (yantra) || 105 ||
