kāntiṃ puṣṭiṃ dhanā (dharā) rogyaśreyāṃsi (yaśāṃsi) labhate naraḥ | vākkāyamanasā kṛtya (bhittau vilikhya tadyantraṃ) pūjayennityamādarāt || 106 ||
bhūtapretapiśācāśca na vīkṣitumapi kṣamāḥ | tadvilikhya śirastrāṇe sādhayeddhāritaṃ bhaṭaḥ || 107 ||
yuddhe bahūn ripūn hatvā jayamāpnoti pārthivaḥ | vajrāṅkite vahnipuradvaye tāṃ pāśāṅkuśābhītisadasti (pāśāṅkuśābhyāmudarastha) sādhyām | madhye'ṣṭakoṇe purabāhupadme (madhye'thakoṇeṣvatha bāhyavṛtte) punaḥ punastāṃ vilikhet samantāt || 108 ||
bhūrje likhitametatsyādbhuktimuktiphalapradam (sarvavaśyakaraṃ nṛṇām (śā0 ti0) | ārogyaiśvaryajananaṃ yuddheṣu vijayapradam || 109 ||
likhet saroje (bhūrje saroje ityapi kvacit pāṭhaḥ) sakale'marāḍhyo (svarakesarāḍhye (śā0 ti0) vasvaśrapatre (vargāṣṭapatre (śā0 ti0) vasudhāpurasthe | pāśāṅkuśābhyāṃ guṇaśaḥ prabodhaṃ (prabaddhāṃ (śā0 ti0) māyāṃ likhenmadhyagatāṃ sasādhyām || 110 ||
sarveṣāṃ candradaṃ yantraṃ (sarvottamamidaṃ yaṃtraṃ) dhāritaṃ kurute'rpaṇaṃ (nṛṇāṃ) | ārogyaiśvaryasaubhāgyaṃ vijayādīnanāratam || 111 || iti ||
[śrīrudrayāmale daśavidyārahasye śrībhuvaneśvarīpaṭalaṃ sampūrṇam] ||
[atha bhuvaneśvarīpūjāpaddhatiḥ]
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
atha pūjāvidhiṃ vakṣye sarvakāmārthasiddhaye | yāmajñāttvā na jānāti padamavyayamātmanaḥ || 1 ||
tatra śrīmān sādhako brāhme muhūrte śayanatalādutthāya karacaraṇau prakṣālya nijāsane samupaviśya nijaśirasi śvetavarṇādhomukhasahasradalakamalakarṇikāntargatacandramaṇḍala(##-) jñānānandamuditamānasaṃ trinayanaṃ caturbhujaṃ jñānamudrāpustakavarābhayakaraṃ vāmāṅge vāmahastadhṛtakamalayā raktavasanābharaṇayā svapriyayā dakṣabhujenāliṅgitaṃ sarvadevadevaṃ sarvatīrthatīrthaṃ sarvamaṅgalamāṅgalyaṃ paramaśivasvarūpaṃ dhyātvā taccaraṇayugalavigaladamṛtadhārayā svātmānaṃ plutaṃ vibhāvya mānasopacārairādhya maṃtraṃ japet oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ ha sa kha phreṃ ha sa kṣa ma la va ra yūṃ hsauṃḥ śauṃḥ śrīmadamukānandanāthaśrīpādukāṃ śrī(##-) daśadhā vimṛśya daṇḍavat praṇāmaṃ manasā kuryāt tadyathā(-)
namāmi sadguruṃ śāṃtaṃ pratyakṣaṃ śivarūpiṇaṃ | śirasā yogapīṭhasthaṃ muktikāmārthasiddhaye || 1 ||
śrīguruṃ paramānandaṃ vandāmyānandavigraham | yasya sānnidhyamātreṇa cidānandāyate varam || 2 ||
akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākāraṃ vyāptaṃ yena carācaram | tatpadaṃ darśitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || 3 ||
ajñānatimirāndhasya jñānāñjanaśalākayā | cakṣurunmīlitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || 4 ||
gururbrahmā gururviṣṇurgururdevo maheśvaraḥ | gurureva jagat sarvaṃ tasmai śrīguruve namaḥ || 5 ||
namaste nātha bhagavan śivāya gururūpiṇe | vidyāvatārasaṃsiddhai svīkṛtānekavigraha (!) || 6 ||
navāya navarūpāya paramārthaikarūpiṇe | sarvājñānatamobhedabhānave cidghanāya te || 7 ||
svatantrāya dayākḷptavigrahāya parātmane | paratantrāya bhaktānāṃ bhavyānāṃ bhavyarūpiṇe || 8 ||
jñānināṃ jñānarūpāya prakāśāya prakāśinām | vivekināṃ vivekāya vimarśāya vimarśiṇām || 9 ||
purastāt pārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhe namaskuryāmuparyadhaḥ | sadā maccittarūpeṇa (hyacintyarūpeṇa) vidhehi bhavadāsanam || 10 ||
iti śrīguruṃ praṇamya suprasannaṃ vibhāvya manasā tadājñāṃ gṛhītvā mūlādhāre liṅgaguhāmadhye yonisthāne svarṇavarṇe caturdalakamalāntargatatrikoṇāntargataśṛṅgāṭakapīṭhopari parāṃ śaktiṃ kuṇḍalinīṃ sarpākārāmūrdhvamukhīṃ sārddhatrivalayāṃ bisatantutanīyasīmudyaddinakarasahasrabhāsvarāṃ vidyutkoṭisannibhāṃ pañcāśadvarṇavigrahāmaṣṭātriṃśatkalārūpiṇīṃ tridhāmadhāmānaṃ sarvadevadevīṃ sakalamaṃtrāntassuptāṃ vibhāvya gurūpadiṣṭanijasahajanādena sacaitanyāṃ vidhāya humiti śabdadaṇḍena prabodhayitvā (yadyapi prabodhya ityeva śuddhastato'pi tantraśāstrācārād yathāsthitaṃ gṛhītaḥ) tatra caturdaleṣu vaṃ namaḥ śaṃ namaḥ ṣaṃ namaḥ saṃ namaḥ iti patreṣu prādakṣiṇyena prapūjya madhye mūlena ca sampūjya haṃsa iti maṃtreṇa sarvatrotthāpya kamalāt kamalaṃ nītvā svādhiṣṭhāne ṣaḍdale kamale liṅgamūle vidrumavarṇe tāmārohya tatra vaṃ namaḥ bhaṃ namaḥ maṃ namaḥ yaṃ namaḥ raṃ namaḥ laṃ namaḥ iti patreṣu madhye mūlena ca sampūjya tato haṃsa iti anena sarvatrotthāpya nābhau maṇipūrake nīlavarṇe daśadale kamale tāṃ nītvā tatra ḍaṃ namaḥ ḍhaṃ namaḥ ṇaṃ namaḥ taṃ namaḥ thaṃ namaḥ daṃ namaḥ dhaṃ namaḥ paṃ namaḥ phaṃ namaḥ iti patreṣu madhye mūlena ca sampūjya tato vakṣasyanāhate piṅgalavarṇe dvādaśadalakamale tāṃ nītvā tatra kaṃ namaḥ khaṃ namaḥ gaṃ namaḥ ghaṃ namaḥ ṅaṃ namaḥ caṃ namaḥ chaṃ namaḥ jaṃ namaḥ jhaṃ namaḥ ñaṃ namaḥ ṭaṃ namaḥ ṭhaṃ namaḥ iti patreṣu madhye mūlena ca sampūjya tato viśuddhau kaṇṭhe dhūmravarṇe ṣoḍaśadalakamale tāṃ nītvā tatra aṃ namaḥ āṃ namaḥ iṃ namaḥ īṃ namaḥ uṃ namaḥ ūṃ namaḥ ṛ namaḥ ṝ namaḥ ḷṃ namaḥ ḹṃ namaḥ eṃ namaḥ aiṃ namaḥ oṃ namaḥ auṃ namaḥ aḥ namaḥ aṃ namaḥ iti patreṣu madhye mūlena ca sampūjya tato bhrūmadhye ājñācakre vidyudvarṇe dvidalakamale tāṃ nītvā tatra haṃ namaḥ kṣaṃ namaḥ iti patrayormadhye mūlena ca sampūjya tato brahmaraṃdhragatasahasradalakamalakarṇikāmadhyagatatrikoṇāntargataparama(##-) paramāmṛtena tāṃ saṃtarpya tato nādaśravaṇatatparo muhūrtamekaṃ layaṃ vibhāvya avarohasamaye sarvatra sohamiti maṃtreṇa kamalāt kamale'vārohya manasājñācakrādikrameṇa teṣu teṣu kamaleṣu taistairakṣaraiḥ sampūjya tattadādhāratattadvaṇatattadadhidevatāstenāmṛtena santarpya tathaiva svasthāne mūlādhāre saṃsthāpya praṇamet(-)
prakāśamānā prathame prayāṇe pratiprayāṇe'pyamṛtāyamānām | antaḥ padavyāmanusañcarantīmānandarūpāmabalāṃ prapadye ||
iti devīrūpaṃ dhyātvā vakṣyamāṇavidhānena prāṇāyāma(##-) punarapi ṛṣyādikaraṣaḍaṅganyāsān vidhāya japaṃ samarpya nijakṛtyaṃ samarpayet(-)
ahaṃ devī na cānyo'smi brahmaivāhaṃ na śokabhāk | saccidānandarūpo'haṃ svātmānamiti cintayet ||
prātaḥ prabhṛti sāyāntaṃ sāyādi prātarantataḥ | yatkaromi jagadyone tadastu tava pūjanam ||
iti samarpya svakāryānuṣṭhānāya(-)
trailokyacaitanyamaye pareśi bhuvaneśvari tvaccaraṇājñayaiva | prātaḥ samutthāya tava priyārthaṃ saṃsārayātrāmanurvatayiṣye || 1 ||
saṃsārayātrāmanuvarttamānaṃ tvadājñayā śrībhuvaneśvarīśi | sparddhātiraskāraka (*?) pramādabhayāni māṃ mābhibhavantu mātaḥ || 2 ||
jānāmi dharmaṃ na ca me pravṛttirjānāmyadharmaṃ na ca me nivṛttiḥ | tvayā hṛṣīkeśi hṛdisthayā'haṃ yathā niyuktosmi tathā'carāmi || 3 ||
iti devyājñāṃ prārthya ajapājapaṃ sahajasiddhaṃ tattaddevatābhyaḥ saṃkalpaṃ samarpayet | adya pūrvedyurahorātrācaritamucchvāsaniḥśvāsātmakaṃ ṣaṭśatādhikameka(-)viṃśatisahasrasaṃkhyākamajapājapaṃ
mūlādhārasvādhiṣṭhanamaṇipūrakānāhataviśuddhājñābrahmaraṃdhreṣu caturdalaṣaḍdaladaśadaladvādaśadalaṣoḍaśadaladvidalasahasradaleṣu svarṇavidrumanīlapiṅgaladhūmravidyutkarpūravarṇeṣu sthitābhyo gaṇapatibrahmaviṣṇurudrajīvātmaparamātmaśrīgurupādukābhyo yathābhāgaśaḥ samarpayāmi namaḥ |
ṣaṭśataṃ gaṇanāthasya ṣaṭsahasraṃ pitāmahe | śaṭsahasraṃ gadāpāṇau ṣaṭsahasraṃ pinākine || 1 ||
sahasramātmane dadyāt sahasraṃ paramātmane | sahasraṃ gurave dadyād etat saṃkhyāsamarpaṇam || 2 ||
iti saṃkalpaṃ kṛtvā samarpayet yathā(-) oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ mūlādhāracakrasthāya mahāgaṇapataye ajapājapānāṃ ṣaṭśatāni samarpayāmi namaḥ | oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ svādhiṣṭhānacakrasthāya brahmaṇe ajapājapānāṃ ṣaṭsahasrāṇi samarpayāmi namaḥ | oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ maṇipūracakrasthāya viṣṇave ajapājapānāṃ ṣaṭsahasrāṇi samarpayāmi namaḥ | oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ anāhatacakrasthāya rudrāya ajapājapānāṃ ṣaṭsahasrāṇi samarpayāmi namaḥ | oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ viśuddhicakrasthāya jīvātmane ajapājapānāṃ sahasramekaṃ samarpayāmi namaḥ | oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ ājñācakrasthāya paramātmane ajapājapānāṃ sahasramekaṃ samarpayāmi namaḥ | oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ sahasradalakamalakarṇikāmadhye vartinyai śrīgurupādukāyai ajapājapānāṃ sahasramekaṃ samarpayāmi namaḥ | ityajapājapaṃ samarpya ajapāmantreṇa prāṇāyāmaṃ vidhāya saṃkalpaṃ kuryāt oṃ asya śrī(##-) śrīparamahaṃso devatā haṃ bījaṃ saḥ śaktiḥ sohaṃ kīlakaṃ oṃkāratatvaṃ namaḥ sthānaṃ haimo varṇa udāttasvaro mama mokṣārthe jape viniyogaḥ | iti kṛtāñjaliḥ smṛtvā nyāsaṃ kuryāt aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ haṃsātmane ṛṣaye namaḥ śirasi avyaktagāyatrīchandase namo mukhe śrīparamahaṃsadevatāyai namo hṛdi haṃ bījāya namo guhye saḥ śaktaye namaḥ pādayoḥ sohaṃ kīlakāya namo nābhau oṃ kāra tattvāya namo hṛdaye udāttasvarāya namaḥ kaṇṭhe nabhase sthānāya namo mūrddhni hemāya varṇāya hamaḥ sarvāṅge iti vinyasya karaṣaḍaṅganyāsau ca kuryāt oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hsāṃ sūryātmane aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hsīṃ somātmane tarjanībhyāṃ svāhā oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hsūṃ nirañjanātmane madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ vaṣaṭ oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hsaiṃ nirābhāsātmane anāmikābhyāṃ huṃ oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hsauṃ tanusūkṣmāpracodayātmane kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ vauṣaṭ oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hsaṃḥ avyaktabodhātmane karatala karapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ phaṭ
oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hsāṃ sūryātmane hṛdayāya namaḥ oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hsīṃ somātmane śirase svāhā oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hsūṃ nirañjanātmane śikhāyai vaṣat oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hsaiṃ nirābhāsātmane kavacāya huṃ oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hsauṃ tanusūkṣmāpracodayātmane netratrayāya vauṣaṭ oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hsaṃḥ avyaktabodhātmane astrāya phaṭ iti karaṣaḍaṅganyāsau ca kṛtvā dhyānaṃ kuryāt(-)
dyāṃ mūrdhānaṃ yasya viprā vadaṃti khaṃ vai nābhiṃ caṃndrasūryau ca netre | digbhiḥ śrotre yasya pādau kṣitiśca dhyātavyo'sau sarvabhūtāntarātmā ||
iti virāṭsvarūpaṃ dhyātvā prāṇavāyornirgamapraveśātmakaṃ hsaṃḥ padaṃ pañcaviṃśativāraṃ tadanusaṃdhāya japtvā samarpya gurūpadiṣṭamārgeṇa nādānusaṃdhānapūrvakaṃ nirastasamastopādhinā kenāpi cidvilāsena pravartamāno'smīti vibhāvya svakāryānuṣṭhānāya(-)
samudramekhale devi parvatastanamaṇḍale | viṣṇupatni namastubhyaṃ pādasparśaṃ kṣamasva me ||

oṃ gaṅge ca yamune caiva godāvari sarasvati | narmade sindhu kāveri jale'smin sannidhiṃ kuru ||
ityanenā"akuśamudrayā tīrthamāvāhya puraḥ kalpitatīrthe saṃyojyācamya mūlenātmānaṃ saṃprokṣya mūlaṃ paṭhan hṛdayakamalamadhyād devīṃ tīrthamadhye samāvāhya dhyātvā tatra kumbhamudrayā devīṃ tribhirabhiṣiñcya svahṛdi saṃsthāpya saptachidrāṇi niruddhya tribhirnimajyonmajjet || iti snānam ||
atha saṃdhyā || tīropari pūrvavadācamya svamūlaprāṇāyāma(##-) tīrthamāvāhya vāmahaste jalaṃ nidhāya dakṣahastenācchādya laṃ vaṃ raṃ yaṃ haṃ ityanena trirabhimantrya mūlamuccaraṃstattvamudrayā mūrddhni saptadhā mūlena cābhyukṣya śeṣajalaṃ dakṣahastena nidhāya tejorūpaṃ dhyātvā iḍayā'kṛṣya dehāntaḥpāpaṃ prakṣālya kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ tajjalaṃ pāparūpaṃ vicintya piṅgalayā virecya puraḥ kalpitavajraśilāyāṃ phaḍiti maṃtreṇa nikṣipet | tato'rghyapātramuddhṛtya oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ haṃ saḥ śrī (kula) mārtaṇḍabhairavāya prakāśaśaktisahitāya idamarghyaṃ parikalpayāmi namaḥ ityanena kulasūryāya trirarghyaṃ datvā svahṛdayakamale devīṃ sūryamaṇḍale nītvā tatra vidhivaddhyātvā mūlagāyatrīṃ paṭhet dhanadāyai vidmahe ratipriyāyai dhīmahi hrīṃ tannaḥ svāhā pracodayāt iti trirjaptvā gāyatrīmūlaṃ ca japan sāṅgāyai saparivārāyai savāhanāyai śaktisahitāyai śrībhuvaneśvaryai idamarghyaṃ parikalpayāmi namaḥ svāhā ityanena mūladevyai arghyaṃ dattvā yathāśakti mūlaṃ ca japtvā tataḥ prāṇāyāma(##-) svasthāne samānayet || iti sandhyā ||
athatarpaṇaṃ || pūrvavadācamya prāṇāyāma(-)ṛṣyādikaraṣaḍaṅganyāsān vidhāya punastīrthamāvāhya mūlena jalaṃ saptadhā'mṛtamudrayā'mṛtīkṛtya tatrajale mūlayantraṃ saṃsthāpya likhitvā tatra devīṃ svahṛdayāt saparivārāmānīya ṣaḍaṅgamaṃtrayogena sakalīkṛtya kuṇḍalinyāḥ prayogeṇāmṛtenābhiṣiñcya vidhivadgandhādibhiḥ sampūjya guruṃ tarpayet aiśānyāṃ oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ śrīmachrī amukānaṃdanāthastṛpyatāmityanena triḥsantarpya āgneyyāṃ oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ paramagurustṛpyatāmiti trirnair(##-) hrīṃ śrīṃ parameṣṭhigurustṛpyatāmiti triḥparitaḥ oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ divyaughā guravastṛpyantāmiti triḥ oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ siddhaughā guravastṛpyantāmiti triḥ oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ mānavaughā guravastṛpyatāmiti triḥ santarpya punarapi pūrvoktaprakāreṇa mūladevīṃ tridhā saṃtarpya yaṃtro ktaparivārān krameṇa saṃtarpya prāṇāyama(-)ṛṣyādikaraṣaḍaṅganyāsān vidhāya mūladevīṃ visṛjya svahṛdi saṃsthāpya tīrthaṃ ca svasthāne sūryamaṇḍale visarjayet || iti tarpaṇam ||
atha gṛhāgamanam || yāgagehamāgatya jalādinā dvāradevatāḥ prokṣya gandhākṣatādibhiḥ pūjayet dakṣe oṃ dhaṃ dhātre namaḥ vāme oṃ viṃ vidhātre namaḥ dakṣe oṃ gaṃ gaṅgāyai namaḥ vāme oṃ yaṃ yamunāyai namaḥ ūrddhve oṃ glauṃ gaṇapataye namaḥ oṃ śrīṃ dvāraśriyai namaḥ
adhaḥ oṃ daṃ dehalyai namaḥ ūrddhve oṃ vaṃ vāstupuruṣāya namaḥ adhaḥ anantāya namaḥ iti dvāraṃ saṃpujya yāgagehāntare akṣatān vikīrya añjaliṃ kṛtvā(-)

nai(-)ṛte tailadīpaṃ prajvālya iti saṃprārthya pūjāsthānaṃ dvidhā vibhāvya svāsanasthānāya namaḥ devyāsanasthānaṃ dvidhā vibhāvya devyāsanasthānāya namaḥ iti sthānaṃ saṃpujya | athāsana prakāraḥ oṃ kūrmāsanāya namaḥ huṃ ādhāraśaktaye namaḥ oṃ brahmāsanāya namaḥ oṃ kamalāsanāya namaḥ oṃ vimalāsanāya namaḥ oṃ anantāsanāya namaḥ oṃ brahmapadmāsanāya namaḥ oṃ garuḍāsanāya namaḥ oṃ yogāsanāya namaḥ oṃ śrīparaparātparasiṃhāsanāya namaḥ iti gandhākṣataiḥ saṃpūjya oṃ pṛthivīti mantrasya merupṛṣṭha ṛṣiḥ kūrmo devatā sutalaṃ chanda āsane viniyogaḥ iti saṃkalpya bhumau hastaṃ dattvā maṃtraṃ paṭhet(-)
oṃ pṛthvi tvayā dhṛtā lokā devi tvaṃ viṣṇunā dhṛtā | tvaṃ ca dhāraya māṃ devi pavitraṃ kuru cāsanam || iti

iti vacanāt | sa cāha yaṃ bījena ṣoḍaśavāraṃ pūrakeṇa saṃśoṣya raṃ (64) catuḥṣaṣṭivāraṃ kumbhakena saṃdahya vaṃ (32) dvātriṃśadvāraṃ recakena bhasma niḥsārayet vaṃ (16) ṣoḍaśavāraṃ pūrakeṇa saṃsnāpya laṃ (64) catuḥṣaṣṭivāraṃ kumbhakena piṇḍīkaraṇaṃ haṃ (32) dvātriṃśadvāraṃ recakena prāṇasthāpanaṃ āṃ (16) ṣoḍaśavāraṃ pūrakeṇa dṛḍhikṛtya hrīṃ (64) catuṣaṣṭivāraṃ kumbhakena śuddhikaraṇaṃ kroṃbījena (32) dvātriṃśadvāraṃ recakeṇa pratiṣṭhāpya iti kramaḥ || evaṃ prāṇāyāmaḥ vaṃ saṃplāvya laṃ ghanīkṛtya haṃ iti dehāvayavān dhyātvā jīvaṃ pūrṇātmabhāvaṃ hrīṃ sohaṃ haṃsaḥ paramātmani svasthāne saṃsthāpya paramātmanaḥ sakāśāt prakṛtiḥ prakṛtermahattattvaṃ mahattattvadahaṅkārstasmādākāśaḥ ākāśādvāyurvāyoragniragnerāpaḥ adbhyaḥ pṛthvī iti krameṇa yathāsthāne bhūtāni saṃsthāpya sohamiti maṃtreṇa kuṇḍalinīmamṛtalolībhūtāṃ pañcabhūtāni jīvātmānañca brahmapathe svasvasthāne sthāpayet | iti bhūtaśuddhiḥ ||
atha prāṇapratiṣṭhāpanam || tato devīrūpamātmānaṃ vicintya hṛdi hastaṃ nidhāya prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ kuryāt oṃ āṁ hrīṃ kroṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ haṃ saḥ mama prāṇā iha prāṇā iha || 12 || mama jīva iha sthita iha sthitaḥ || 12 || mama sarvendriyāṇi iha sthitāni iha sthitāni || 12 || mama vāṅmanastvakcakṣuḥśrotrajihvāghrāṇaprāṇā ihaivāgatya sukhaṃ ciraṃ tiṣṭhantu svāhā iti prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ vidhāya svamulamantra(##-)
oṃ asya śrībhuvaneśvarīmantrasya śrīśaktir(-)ṛṣirgāyatrī chandaḥ śrībhuvaneśvarī devatā hrīṃ bījaṃ śrīṃ śaktiḥ klīṃ kīlakaṃ mamābhiṣṭasiddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliḥ smṛtvā śakti(##-) namo hṛdi hrīṃ bījāya namo guhye śrīṃ śaktaye namaḥ pādayoḥ klīṃ kīlakāya namo nābhau jape viniyogaḥ | sarvāṅge mūlena navadhāvyāpakaṃ nyaset |
atha maṃtranyāsaḥ || oṃ hṛllekhāyai namaḥ śirasi oṃ aiṃ gaganāyai namo mukhe oṃ raktāyai namo hṛdaye oṃ iṃ karālikāyai namo guhye oṃ mahocchuṣmāyai namaḥ padadvaye oṃ aiṃ juṃ uṃ hṛllekhāyai namaḥ sarvāṅge iti vinyasya oṃ hṛllekhāyai nama ūrddhvamukhe oṃ aiṃ gaganāyai namaḥ pūrvamukhe oṃ juṃ raktāyai namo dakṣiṇamukhe oṃ iṃ karālikāyai namaḥ uttaramukhe oṃ mahocchuṣmāyai namaḥ paścimamukhe iti vinyasya karaṣaḍaṅanyāsān kuryāt | oṃ hrāṃ aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ oṃ hrīṃ tarjanībhyāṃ oṃ hrūṃ madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ oṃ hraiṃ anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ oṃ hrauṃ kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ oṃ hraḥ karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ oṃ hrīṃ śirase svāhā oṃ hrūṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ oṃ hraiṃ kavacāya huṃ oṃ hrauṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ oṃ hraḥ astrāya phaṭ ityūrdhvordhvatālatrayaṃ dattvā pūrvavaddigbandhanaṃ kṛtvā bhāle oṃ brahmagāyatrībhyāṃ namaḥ dakṣakapole sāvitrīviṣṇubhyāṃ namaḥ vāmagaṇḍe vāgīśvarābhyāṃ namaḥ vāmakarṇe oṃ śrīsahitadhanapataye namaḥ mukhe oṃ ratisahitamadanāya namaḥ savyakarṇe oṃ puṣṭisahitagaṇapataye namaḥ dakṣakarṇe oṃ śaṅkhanidhaye namaḥ vāmakarṇe oṃ padmanidhaye namaḥ mukhe mūlaṃ nyaset kaṇṭhamūle oṃ gāyatrīsahitabrahmaṇe namaḥ dakṣastane oṃ sāvitrīsahitaviṣṇave namaḥ vāmastane oṃ vāgīśvarīsahitamaheśvarāya namaḥ dakṣāṃse oṃ śrīsahitadhanapataye namaḥ vāmāṃse oṃ ratisahitamanmathāya namaḥ pādayoḥ oṃ śaṅkhanidhaye namaḥ oṃ padmanidhaye namaḥ nābhau mūlaṃ nyaset bhāle oṃ brāhmyai namaḥ vāmāṃse oṃ māheśvaryyai namaḥ vāmapārśve oṃ kaumāryyai namaḥ udare oṃ vaiṣṇavyai namaḥ dakṣapārśve oṃ vārāhyai namaḥ dakṣāṃse oṃ indrāṇyai namaḥ galapṛṣṭhe oṃ cāmuṇḍāyai namaḥ hṛdi oṃ mahālakṣmyai namaḥ mūlena navadhā vyāpakaṃ nyaset |
atha mātṛkānyāsaḥ || oṃ asya śrīmātṛkānyāsasya brahmā ṛṣiḥ gāyatrī chandaḥ śrīmātṛkā sarasvatī devatā halo bījāni svarāḥ śaktayaḥ avyaktaṃ kīlakaṃ mama śrībhuvaneśvaryyaṅgatvena nyāse viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliḥ smṛtvā nyaset | oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ brahmaṇe ṛṣaye namaḥ śirasi gāyatrīchandase namo mukhe śrīmātṛkāsarasvatīdevatāyai namo hṛdi halbhyo bījebhyo namo guhye svarebhyaḥ śaktibhyo namaḥ pādayoḥ avyaktāya kīlakāya namo nābhau mama śrībhuvaneśvaryaṅgatvena nyāse viniyogaḥ sarvāṅge | iti ṛṣyādinyāsaḥ | atha karaṣaḍaṅganyāsau kuryāt oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ aṃ kaṃ (5) āṃ aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ iṃ caṃ (5) iṃ tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ ūṃ ṭaṃ (5) ūṃ madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ
oṃ aiṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ aiṃ taṃ (5) aiṃ anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ ūṃ paṃ (5) ūṃ kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ oṃ aiṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ aṃ yaṃ (10) aṃ karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ nama iti karanyāsaḥ || atha ṣaḍaṅganyāsaḥ || oṃ aiṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ aṃ kaṃ (5) āṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ iṃ caṃ (5) iṃ śirase svāhā oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ ūṃ ṭaṃ (5) ūṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ aiṃ taṃ (5) aiṃ kavacāya huṃ oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ ūṃ paṃ (5) ūṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ aṃ yaṃ 10 aṃ aḥ astrāya phaṭ iti ṣaḍaṅganyāsaḥ | dhyānam(-)
oṃ vyomendvau rasanārṇakarṇikamacāṃ dvandvaiḥ sphuratkeśaraṃ patrāntargatapañcavargayaśalārṇāditrivargaṃ kramāt | āśāsvastriṣu lāntalāṅgaliyujā kṣoṇīpureṇāvṛtaṃ padyaṃ kalpitamatra pūjayatu tāṃ varṇātmikāṃ devatām (vyoma haḥ | induḥ saḥ | auḥ svarūpam | rasanārṇo visargaḥ | vyomādiḥ sacaturdaśasvaravisargāntaḥ(-) sphuratkarṇikamityukteḥ | acāṃ svarāṇām | atra kesareṣu svaralikhanañca | agrapatrādikarṇikābhimukhatvena veti jñeyam | āśāsu dikṣu | asriṣu koṇeṣu lānto vaḥ | lāṅgulī ṭhaḥ | anayo rekhā saṁllagnatayā likhanaṃ jñeyaṃ taduktaṃ dakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃhitāyām(-) (sarasvatībhavanaprakāśitāyām)
