atha ṛṣyādikaraṣaḍaṅganyāsān pūrvavat kṛtvā nyaset aṃ namaḥ āṃ namaḥ iṃ namaḥ īṃ namaḥ uṃ namaḥ ūṃ namaḥ ṛṃ namaḥ ṝṃ namaḥ ḷṃ namaḥ ḹṃ namaḥ eṃ namaḥ aiṃ namaḥ oṃ namaḥ auṃ namaḥ aṃ namaḥ aḥ namaḥ iti kaṇṭhasthāne ṣoḍaśadale | kaṃ namaḥ khaṃ namaḥ gaṃ namaḥ ghaṃ namaḥ ṅaṃ namaḥ caṃ namaḥ chaṃ namaḥ jaṃ namaḥ jhaṃ namaḥ ñaṃ namaḥ ṭaṃ namaḥ ṭhaṃ namaḥ ityanāhate dvādaśadale | ḍaṃ namaḥ ḍhaṃ namaḥ ṇaṃ namaḥ taṃ namaḥ thaṃ namaḥ daṃ namaḥ dhaṃ namaḥ naṃ namaḥ paṃ namaḥ phaṃ namaḥ iti maṇipūrake daśadale |
baṃ namaḥ bhaṃ namaḥ maṃ namaḥ yaṃ namaḥ raṃ namaḥ laṃ namaḥ iti svādhiṣṭhāne ṣaḍdale | vaṃ namaḥ śaṃ namaḥ saṃ namaḥ iti mūlādhāre caturdale | haṃ namaḥ kṣaṃ namaḥ ityājñācakre dvidale || ityantarmātṛkānyāsaḥ ||
atha bahirmātṛkānyāsaḥ || oṃ asya śrībahirmātṛkānyāsasya brahmā ṛṣirgāyatrī chandaḥ śrībahirmātṛkā sarasvatī devatā halo bījāni svarāḥ śaktayaḥ avyaktaṃ kīlakaṃ mama śrībhuvaneśvaryaṅgatvena bahirmātṛkānyāse viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliḥ smṛtvā ṛṣyādikaraṣaḍaṅganyāsān pūrvavat kṛtvā nyaset oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ aṃ namaḥ śirasi (4) āṃ namo mukhavṛtte (4) īṃ namo dakṣanetre (4) īṃ namo vāmanetre (4) uṃ namo dakṣakarṇe (4) ūṃ namo vāmakarṇe (4) ṛṃ namo dakṣanāsikāyāṃ (4) ṝṃ namo vāmanāsikāyāṃ (4) ḷ namo dakṣakapole (4) ḹ namo vāmakapole (4) eṃ nama ūrddhvoṣṭhe (4) aiṃ namaḥ adharoṣṭhe (4) oṃ namaḥ ūrddhvadanteṣu (4) auṃ namaḥ adhodanteṣu (4) aṃ namo mūrdhni (4) aḥ namo lalāṭe (4) kaṃ namo dakṣaskandhe (4) khaṃ namaḥ kūrpare (4) gaṃ namo maṇibandhe (4) ghaṃ namo'ṅgulīmūle (4) ṅaṃ namo'ṅgulyagre (4) caṃ namo vāmaskandhe (4) chaṃ kūrpare jaṃ namo maṇibandhe (4) jhaṃ namo'ṅgulīmūle (4) ñaṃ namo'ṅgulyagre (4) ṭaṃ namo dakṣajaṅghāyāṃ (4) ṭhaṃ namo jānuni (4) ḍaṃ namo gulphe (4) ḍhaṃ namo'ṅgulīmūle (4) ṇaṃ namo'ṅgulyagre (4) taṃ namo vāmajaṅghāyāṃ (4) thaṃ namo jānuni (4) daṃ namo gulphe (4) dhaṃ namo'ṅgulīmūle (4) naṃ namo'ṅgulyagre (4) paṃ namo dakṣapārśve (4) phaṃ namo vāmapārśve (4) baṃ namaḥ pṛṣṭhe (4) bhaṃ namo nābhau (4) maṃ nama udare (4) yaṃ tvagātmane namo hṛdaye (4) raṃ asṛgātmane namo dakṣāṃse (4) laṃ māṃsātmane namaḥ kakudi (4) vaṃ meda(-)ātmane namo vāmāṃse (4) śaṃ asthyātmane namo hṛdādidakṣakarāntaṃ (4) ṣaṃ majjātmane namo hṛdādivāmakarāntaṃ (4) saṃ śukrātmane namo hṛdādidakṣapādāntaṃ (4) haṃ prāṇātmane namo hṛdādivāmapādāntaṃ (4) laṃ jīvātmane namaḥ pādādihṛdantaṃ (4) kṣaṃ paramātmane namo hṛdādimūrddhāntaṃ iti bahirmātṛkānyāsaḥ (stotre 17 pṛṣṭhe 23 24 ślokau draṣṭavyau) || atha mātṛkādhyānam(-)
pañcāśadvarṇarūpāñca kapardaśaśibhūṣaṇām | śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśāṃ śuddhakṣaumavirājitām ||
muktāratnasphuradbhūṣāṃ japamālāṃ kamaṇḍalum | pustakaṃ varadānañca bibhratīṃ parameśvarīm ||
evaṃ mātṛkāṃ dhyātvā vidyānyāsaṃ kuryāt aiṃ namo maṇibandhe klīṃ namastale sauṃ namo'ṅgulyagre iti dakṣakare | aiṃ namo maṇibandhe klīṃ namastale sauṃ namo'ṅgulyagre iti vāmakare | aiṃ namo dakṣaskaṃdhe klīṃ namaḥ kūrpare sauṃ namaḥ pāṇau aiṃ namo dakṣajaṅghāyāṃ klīṃ namo jānuni sauṃ namaḥ pādāgre aiṃ namo vāmajaṅghāyāṃ klīṃ namo jānuni sauṃ namaḥ pādāgre || iti vidyānyāsaḥ ||
athāntaryajanaṃ (-)
mūlādhāre mūlavidyāṃ vidyutkoṭisamaprabhām | sūryakoṭipratīkāśāṃ candrakoṭisuśītalām ||
bisatantusvarūpāṃ tāṃ bindutrivalayāṃ priye | ūrddhvaśaktinipātena sahajena varānane ||
mūlaśaktidṛḍhatvena madhyaśaktiprabodhataḥ | paramānandasandohāmātmānamiti cintayet ||
ityādyantaryajanaṃ kṛttvā(-)
atha pīṭhanyāsaṃ kuryāt oṃ aiṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ ādhāraśaktaye namaḥ prakṛtyai namaḥ maṇḍukāya namaḥ kamaṭhāya namaḥ pṛthivyai namaḥ sudhāmbudhaye namaḥ maṇidvīpāya namaḥ cintāmaṇigṛhāya namaḥ ratnavedikāyai namaḥ maṇidvīpāya namaḥ ityuparyupari dikṣu nānāmunigaṇebhyo namaḥ nānāvedebhyo namaḥ dakṣāṃse dharmāya namaḥ vāmāṃse jñānāya namaḥ vāmorau vairāgyāya namaḥ dakṣorau aiśvaryāya namaḥ dakṣakukṣau adharmāya namaḥ dakṣapṛṣṭhe ajñānāya namaḥ vāmapṛṣṭhe avairāgyāya namaḥ vāmakukṣau anaiśvaryāya nanaḥ punaruparyupari śeṣāya namaḥ hṛdi padmāya namaḥ prakṛtimayapatrebhyo namaḥ vikṛtimayakeśarebhyo namaḥ pañcāśadbījabhūṣitakarṇikāyai namaḥ tadupari sūryamaṇḍalāya namaḥ somamaṇḍalāya namaḥ vaiśvānaramaṇḍalāya namaḥ saṃ sattvāya namaḥ raṃ rajase namaḥ taṃ tamase namaḥ āṃ ātmane namaḥ aṃ antarātmane namaḥ paṃ paramātmane namaḥ hrīṃ jñānātmane namaḥ | patreṣu vāmāyai namaḥ jyeṣṭhāyai namaḥ raudrāyai namaḥ ambikāyai namaḥ icchāyai namaḥ jñānāyai namaḥ kriyāyai namaḥ kubjikāyai namaḥ citrāyai namaḥ viṣaghnikāyai namaḥ aiṃ aparāyai namaḥ aiṃ aiṃ parāyai namaḥ hasauṃḥ sadāśivamahāpretapadmāsanāya namaḥ śivamañcāya namaḥ || iti pīṭhanyāsaḥ ||
atha svahṛdayakamalamadhye mūladevīṃ dhyāyet (-)
oṃ udyadinadyutimindukirīṭāṃ tuṅgakucāṃ nayanatrayayuktāṃ | smeramukhīṃ varadābhayadānābhītikarāṃ (varadāṅkuśapāśābhītikarāṃ) prabhaje bhuvaneśīṃ ||
iti mūladevīsvarūpaṃ dhyātvā mānasopacārairārādhya yathāśaktito homādikaṃ ca kṛtvā kāmakalāṃ ca vicintya tadupari śrībhuvaneśvarīṃ yathoktarūpāṃ dhyātvā svavāmabhāge niveśya |
athārghyapātrasthāpanaṃ(-) svavāmabhāge ṣaṭkoṇāntargatatrikoṇāntargatabindubāhyavṛttacaturasrarūpaṃ maṇḍalaṃ vidhāya punaḥ svadakṣe trikoṇavṛttabindumaṇḍalaṃ kṛttvā bhūmau viracya tatrādhāraśaktiṃ prapūjya tatrādhāraṃ saṃsthāpya tadupari astramaṃtreṇaśodhitaṃ hṛnmaṃtreṇa pūritaṃ pātraṃ śaṅkhādikaṃ vā saṃsthāpya tatra tīrthamāvāhya gandhādibhiḥ praṇavena sampūjya sūryasomāgnikalābhiḥ sampūjya iti dhenumudrāṃ pradarśya svamantreṇa ca pūjayet iti sāmānyavidhiḥ | tena sāmānyārghyajalena svavāmabhāge kṛtamaṇḍalamabhyukṣya tatrādhāraśaktyādikrameṇa pīṭhapūjāṃ kṛtvā nama ityādhāraṃ prakṣālya maṇḍalopari saṃsthāpya raṃ vahnimaṇḍalāya daśakalātmane namaḥ iti sampūjya phaḍiti maṃtreṇa kalaśaṃ prakṣālya kāraṇena prapūrya raktamālyādinā saṃbhūṣya devībuddhyā saṃsthāpya aṃ arkamaṇḍalāya dvādaśakalātmane nama iti saṃpūjya oṃ saḥ candramaṇḍalāya ṣoḍaśakalātmane nama iti dravyamadhye sampūjya phaḍiti saṃrakṣya huṃ ityavaguṇṭhya mūlena dravyaṃ saṃvīkṣya nama ityabhyukṣya mūlena dravyagandhamāghrāya kumbhe puṣpaṃ dattvā śāpaharīṃ vidyāṃ japet(-)
ekameva paraṃ barhma sthūlasūkṣmamayaṃ dhruvam | kacodbhavāṃ brahmahatyāṃ tena te nāśayāmyaham || 1 ||
sūryamaṇḍalasaṃbhūte varuṇālayasambhave | amābījamaye devi śukraśāpādvimucyatām || 2 ||
vedānāṃ praṇavo bījaṃ brahmānandamayaṃ yadi | tena satyena te devi brahmahatyāṃ vyapohatu || 3 ||
iti triḥpaṭhet oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ vrāṃ vrīṃ vrūṃ vraiṃ vrauṃ vraḥ brahmaśāpavimocitāyai surādevyai namaḥ svadhā iti triḥ oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ krāṃ krīṃ krūṃ kraiṃ krauṃ kraḥ sure kṛṣṇaśāpaṃ mocaya
mocaya amṛtaṃ srāvaya srāvaya svāhā iti triḥ oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ śāṃ śīṃ śūṃ śaiṃ śauṃ śaḥ sure śukraśāpaṃ mocaya mocaya amṛtaṃ srāvaya srāvaya svāhā iti triḥ oṃ haṃsaḥ śuciṣadvasuraṃtarikṣa guṃ saddhotāvediṣadatithirduroṇasat nṛṣadvarasadṛtasadvyoma sadabjā gojā ṛtajā adrijā ṛtaṃ bṛhat iti triḥ | ityetān maṃtrān hastena ghaṭaṃ dhṛtvā paṭhet ||
atha'nandabhairavaṃ svarāṃśca yathoktaprakāreṇa tatra dhyātvā svasvamaṃtreṇa pūjayet(-) oṃ ha sa kṣa ma la va ra yūṃ ānandabhairavāya vauṣaṭ oṃ sa ha kṣa ma la va ra yīṃ surādevyai vauṣaṭ ityābhyāṃ maṃtrābhyāṃ pṛthak saṃpūjya saṃtarpya | atha dravyamadhye dakṣiṇāvartena triḥpaṃktyā mātṛkācakraṃ vilikhet(-) aṃ (16) kaṃ (16) thaṃ (16) iti śakticakraṃ vilikhya tanmadhye haṃ kṣaṃ ca vilikhya tatsamāveśād dravyamadhye'mṛtaṃ vicintya dhenumudrayā'mṛtīkṛtya vamiti sudhābījaṃ mūlamaṃtramapyaṣṭadhā ghaṭe dhṛtvā paṭhitvā athātmaśricakrayormadhye trikoṇaṣaṭkoṇavṛttacaturasrātmakaṃ maṇḍalaṃ vilikhya pūjayet caturasre pūrṇagiripīṭhāya namaḥ oṃ uḍḍīyānapīṭhāyanamaḥ kāmarūpapīṭhāya namaḥ jālaṃdharapīṭhāya nama iti sampūjya | ṣaṭkoṇe ṣaḍaṅgāni prapūjya mūlakhaṇḍatrayeṇa trikoṇasyāgradakṣottaraṃ sampūjya | madhye ādhāraśaktyādi sampūjya trikoṇagarbhe tripadikāṃ saṃsthāpya nama iti samānyārghyajalenābhyukṣya gandhākṣatahastena pūjayet | oṃ raṃ vahnimaṇḍalāya daśakalātmane nama iti sampūjya yaṃ dhūmrārciṣe namaḥ raṃ ūṣmāyai namaḥ laṃ jvalinyai namaḥ vaṃ jvālinyai namaḥ śaṃ visphulliṃginyai namaḥ ṣaṃ suśriyai namaḥ saṃ surūpāyai namaḥ haṃ kapilāyai nama laṃ havyavāhāyai namaḥ kṣaṃ kavyavāhāyai nama iti sampūjya | tataḥ pātraṃ phaḍiti maṃtreṇa prakṣālya trikoṇopari saṃsthāpya aṃ arkamaṇḍalāya dvādaśakalātmane namaḥ iti sampūjya kaṃ bhaṃ tapinyai namaḥ khaṃ baṃ tāpinyai namaḥ gaṃ phaṃ dhūmrāyai namaḥ ghaṃ paṃ marīcyai namaḥ ḍaṃ naṃ jvalinyai namaḥ caṃ dhaṃ rucyai namaḥ chaṃ daṃ suṣumṇāyai namaḥ jaṃ thaṃ bhogadāyai namaḥ jhaṃ taṃ viśvāyai namaḥ ñaṃ ṇaṃ bodhinyai namaḥ ṭaṃ ḍhaṃ dhāriṇyai namaḥ ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ kṣamāyai nama iti sampūjya trikoṇavṛttaṣaṭkoṇaṃ vilikhya samastena vyastena ca maṃtreṇa sampūjya vaṃ varuṇabījaṃ mūlaṃ vilomamātṛkāṃ ca paṭhan dravyeṇa tribhāgaṃ jalena ca bhāgamekaṃ prapūryya tatra gandhādīni nikṣipya oṃ saḥ somamaṇḍalāya ṣoḍaśakalātmane nama iti sampūjya aṃ amṛtāyai namaḥ āṃ mānadāyai namaḥ iṃ pūṣāyai namaḥ īṃ tuṣṭyai namaḥ uṃ puṣṭyai namaḥ ūṃ ratyai namaḥ ṛṃ dhṛtyai namaḥ ṝṃ śaśinyai namaḥ ḷṃ caṃdrikāyai namaḥ ḹ kāntyai namaḥ eṃ jyotsnāyai namaḥ
aiṃ śriyai namaḥ oṃ prītyai namaḥ auṃ aṅgadāyai namaḥ aṃ pūrṇāyai namaḥ aḥ pūrṇāmṛtāyai nama iti sampūjya | pūrvavad dravye akathāditrikoṇacakraṃ vilikhya mūlakhaṇḍatrayeṇa trikoṇaṃ sampūjya ṣaṭkoṇe ṣaḍaṅgaṃ ca sampūjya gaṅge ca yamune tyādinā tīrthamāvāhya ānandabhairavabhairavyau svasvamaṃtreṇa sampūjya pañcaratnāni pūjayet | glūṃ gaganaratnebhyo namaḥ pūrve slūṃ svargaratnebhyo namo dakṣiṇe glūṃ martyaratnebhyo namaḥ paścime plūṃ pātālaratnebhyo nama uttare nlūṃ nāgaratnebhyo namaḥ pūrve iti prathamapātraṃ sampūjya | atha dvitīyādīnāṃ pātrāṇi purato maṇḍaleṣu saṃsthāpya huṃ ityavaguṇṭhya vaṃ iti dhenumudrayāmṛtīkṛtya tālatrayaṃ choṭikābhidarśadigbandhanaṃ ca kṛtvā matsyamudrayā pātramāchādya tadupari mūlaṃ saptadhā saṃjapya dvitīyādīnāṃ svasvamaṃtreṇa saṃskṛtapātraṃ devīrūpaṃ vibhāvayet | atha devyājñāmādāya ghaṭasamīpe ekādaśapātrāṇi sthāpayeyuḥ gurupātraṃ śaktipātraṃ bhogapātraṃ svapātraṃ yoginīpātraṃ baṭukapātraṃ vīrapātraṃ balipātraṃ pādyapātraṃ arghyapātraṃ ācamanīyapātraṃ ityetāni pātrāṇi saṃsthāpya carvaṇayutakāraṇena prapūrya tattvamudrayā śrīpātrādbindumuddhṛtya ha sa kṣa ma la va ra yūṃ ānandabhairavaṃ tarpayāmi namaḥ iti triḥ saṃtarpya | pādukāmantrānte śrīmacchrī(-)amukānandanātha śrīpādukāṃ tarpayāmi nama iti triḥsantarpya evaṃ paramaguruṃ paramācāryaṃ parameṣṭhinaṃ ca saṃtarpya tataḥ śrīpātrāmṛtena mūlānte sāyudhāṃ savāhanāṃ saparivārāṃ samudrāṃ saparicchadāṃ śrībhuvaneśvarīṃ tarpayāmi nama iti triḥsaṃtarpya punarapi gandhamālyādinā kalaśaṃ saṃbhūṣya devīrūpaṃ dhyātvā amṛtamayaṃ ghaṭaṃ vibhāvayet || iti kalaśapūjāvidhānam ||
atha siṃhāsanopari racitapīṭhe pūrvavat pīṭhapūjāṃ kuryāt(-) oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ ādhāraśaktaye namaḥ mūlaprakṛtyai namaḥ maṇḍukāya namaḥ kamaṭhāya namaḥ śeṣāya namaḥ pṛthivyai namaḥ sudhāmbudhaye namaḥ maṇidvīpāya namaḥ kalpavanāya namaḥ cintāmaṇigṛhāya namaḥ ratnavaidikāyai namaḥ nānāmaṇikhacitapīṭhāya namaḥ dikṣu nānāmunigaṇebhyo namaḥ nānāsiddhagaṇebhyo namaḥ dharmāya namaḥ jñānāya namaḥ vairāgyāya namaḥ aiśvaryāya namaḥ anaiśvaryāya namaḥ madhye(-)kandāya namaḥ nālāya namaḥ padmāya namaḥ prakṛtimayapatrebhyo namaḥ vikṛtimayakeśarebhyo namaḥ pañcāśanmātṛkābījabhūṣitakarṇikāyai namaḥ tanmadhye aṃ sūryamaṇḍalāya namaḥ saḥ somamaṇḍalāya namaḥ raṃ vaiśvānaramaṇḍalāya namaḥ saṃ satvāya namaḥ raṃ rajase namaḥ taṃ tamase namaḥ āṃ ātmane namaḥ aṃ antarātmane namaḥ paṃ paramātmane namaḥ hrīṃ jñānātmane namaḥ punaḥ patreṣu(-)vāmāyai namaḥ jyeṣṭhāyai namaḥ raudryai namaḥ
ambikāyai namaḥ icchāyai namaḥ jñānāyai namaḥ kriyāyai namaḥ kubjikāyai namaḥ citrāyai namaḥ viṣaghnikāyai namaḥ aiṃ aparāyai namaḥ aiṃ parāyai namaḥ sarvatra(-)hsauṃḥ sadāśivamahāpretapatmāsanāya namaḥ śivamañcāya nama iti pīṭhaṃ saṃpūjya pīṭhopari śrīcakraṃ saṃsthāpayet (-)
padmamaṣṭadalaṃ bāhye vṛtaṃ ṣoḍaśabhirdalaiḥ | vilikhet karṇikāmadhye ṣaṭkoṇamatisundaram || ācaredbhūgṛhaṃ tadvaditi cakraṃ samuddharet |
matāntare ca(-)
bindutrikoṇaṃ rasakoṇasaṃyutaṃ vṛttāñcitaṃ nāgadalena maṇḍitam | kalāravṛttatrayabhūgṛhāṅkitaṃ śrīcakrametad bhuvaneśvarīpriyām ||
ityevaṃ śrīcakraṃ saṃsthāpya tasyopari raktapuṣpaṃ kiñcijjalaṃ ca dattvā pīṭhaśaktīḥ pūjayet | dikṣu āṃ ajayāyai namaḥ īṃ vijayāyai namaḥ ūṃ ajitāyai namaḥ ṝṃ aparājitāyai namaḥ ḹṃ nityāyai namaḥ aiṃ vilāsinyai namaḥ auṃ dogdhrai namaḥ aḥ aghorāyai namaḥ | madhye hrīṃ maṅgalāyai namaḥ iti pīṭhaṃ sampūjya yathoktāṃ śrībhuvaneśvarīṃ dhyāyet (-)
oṃ udyadinadyutimindukirīṭāṃ tuṅgakucāṃ nayanatrayayuktām | smeranmukhīṃ varadābhayadānābhītikarāṃ prabhaje bhuvaneśīm ||
iti dhyātvā yamiti vāyubījena vāmanāsāpuṭena devīṃ svahṛdayāt kusumāñjalāvānīya tatrāvāhya prārthayet(-)
oṃ deveśi bhaktisulabhe parivārasamanvite | yāvattvāṃ pūjayiṣyāmi tāvaddevi ihāvaha || 1 ||
mūlānte savāhanasaparivārasāyudhasamudrasaparichadaśrīmacchrīmaheśvara(##-) evaṃ iha sannidhehi iha sannidhehi evaṃ iha sanniruddhasva iha sanniruddhasva evaṃ mama sarvopacārasahitāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa svāhā ityāvāhanādinavamudrāḥ pradarśya pīṭhe puṣpaṃ dattvā | atha śrīcakropari lelihānamudrāṃ vidhāya prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ kuryāt
oṃ āṁ hrīṃ kroṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ haṃ saḥ śrīmacchībhuvaneśvaryyāḥ prāṇā iha prāṇā iha || 21 || jīva iha sthitaḥ || 21 || sarvendriyāṇi iha sthitāni iha sthitāni || 21 || vāṅmanastvakcakṣuḥśrotrajihvāghrāṇaprāṇā ihaivāgatya sukhaṃ ciraṃ tiṣṭhantu svāhā iti prāṇapratiṣthāṃ kṛtvā pīṭhe puṣpaṃ datvā digbandhanaṃ kṛtvā avaguṇṭhya sakalīkṛtya paramīkaraṇaṃ vidhāya dhenuyonimudre pradarśya śaktimudrāṃ pradarśya varābhayapustakākṣamālājñānāṅkuśacāpabāṇakapālamālādimudrāḥ pradarśya tataḥ puṣpahastamudrayā śrīpātrāmṛtena sāyudhāṃ savāhanāṃ saparivārāṃ samudrāṃ sāvaraṇāṃ śrīmacchrīmaheśvarabhairavasahitāṃ śrībhuvaneśvarīṃ tarpayāmi nama iti triḥ pīṭhopari saṃtarpya punarapi mūlānte śrīmacchrībhuvaneśvarīpādukāṃ tarpayāmi namaḥ iti triḥ saṃtarpya | atha ṣoḍaśopacārapūjāṃ kuryāt mūlānte etatpādyaṃ śrīmacchrībhairavasahitāyai śrībhuvaneśvaryyai namaḥ pādayoḥ pādyaṃ mūlānte idamarghyaṃ svāhā śirasi mūlānte idamācamanīyaṃ svāhā mūle mūlānte idaṃ madhuparkkaṃ svadhā mukhe mūlānte idaṃ snānīyaṃ namaḥ sarvāṅge ityādi susnāpya śuddhadukūlenāṅgaṃ proñchya atha mūrtau vicitrapaṭṭavastrakuṃkumakastūrīcandanasindūramukuṭakuṇḍalamālya(##-) tato madhyānāmāṅguṣṭhāgramudrayā mūlānte ayaṃ gandho namaḥ iti gandhaṃ dattvā tato'ṅguṣṭhatarjanyagrayā mudrayā mūlānte imāni puṣpāṇi vauṣaṭ iti puṣpāṇi dattvā tato dhūpapātraṃ phaḍiti saṃprokṣya sammukhe saṃsthāpya vāmahastatarjanyāsaṃspṛśan mūlānte dhūpaṃ nivedayāmi nama iti jalaṃ dattvā tataḥ oṃ jagaddhvanimantramātaḥsvāhā ityanena gandhādibhiḥ ghaṇṭāṃ sampūjya vāmapāṇinā ghaṇṭāṃ vādayan dakṣiṇapāṇimadhyānāmāṅguṣṭhairdhūpapātraṃ samuddhṛtya gāyatrīṃ mūlaṃ ca paṭhan (-)
oṃ vanaspatirasotpanno gandhāḍhyo gandha uttamaḥ | āghreyaḥ sarvadevānāṃ dhūpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām ||
mūlānte savāhanasaparivārasāyudhasamudrasaparicchadasāvaraṇaśrīmacchrīmaheśvara(##-) devīṃ dhūpayet | tato dīpapātraṃ sammukhe saṃsthāpya pūrvavat prokṣaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ ca kṛtvā vāmahastamadhyamayā dīpapātraṃ saṃspṛśan pūrvavanmūlasāvaraṇānte dīpaṃ nivedayāmi iti dakṣiṇapāṇinā jalena nivedya pūrvavadghaṇṭāṃ vādayan dakṣiṇapāṇinā madhyānāmāmadhye dīpapātramaṅguṣṭhena dhṛtvā darśayan mūlagāyatrīṃ ca paṭhan(-)
oṃ suprakāśo mahādīpaḥ sarvatra timirāpahaḥ | sabāhyābhyantarajyotirdīpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām ||
iti pūrvavaddīpaṃ nivedayāmi nama ityanena devīṃ dīpayet | atha parṇādipātre kuṃkumena vasupatraṃ candrarūpaṃ caruṃ kṛtvā pātramadhye dīpakamekamaṣṭapatreṣu dīpāṣṭakaṃ saṃsthāpya pūjayet || śrīṃ sauṃḥ glūṃ slūṃ mlūṃ plūṃ nlūṃ sauṃ śrīṃ śrīṃ ratnaiśvaryai nama ityanena pātraṃ sampūjya mūlena ca sampūjya tato vāmapāṇinā ghaṇṭāṃ vādayan dakṣena sthālakaṃ mastakāntaṃ uddhṛtya navadhā mūlaṃ japan (-)
samastacakracakreśīyute devīnavātmike | ārārtikamidaṃ devi gṛhāṇa mama siddhaye ||
iti cakramudrayā || tato nānā naivedyaṃ svarṇādipātre nikṣipya humityavaguṇṭhya vamiti dhenumudrayāmṛtīkṛtya mūlaṃ saptadhā japtvā vāmahastāṅguṣṭhena naivedyapātraṃ spṛśan mūlānte(-)
hemapātragataṃ divyaṃ paramānnaṃ susaṃskṛtam | pañcadhā ṣaḍrasopetaṃ gṛhāṇa parameśvari ||
śrībhuvaneśvaryyai naivedyaṃ nivedayāmi namaḥ tato dakṣānāmāṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ naivedyapātramutsṛjet punarācamanīyaṃ datvā mūlānte karpūrādiyuktaṃ tāmbūlaṃ nivedayāmīti pūrvavad dadyāt sarveṣāṃ madhye jalenotsargaḥ kāryaḥ | tatastatvamudrayā śrīpātrāmṛtena devīṃ triḥ saṃtarpya tataḥ pūrvoktamudrāḥ pradarśya yonimudrāmevaṃ darśayet(-)hṛdi kṣobhiṇīṃ mukhe drāviṇīṃ bhrūmadhye ākarṣiṇīṃ lalāṭe vaśinīṃ brahmarandhre āhlādinīṃ iti pañcamudrāmayīṃ yonimudrāṃ pradarśya atha kṛtāñjaliḥ śrībhuvaneśvari(!) āvaraṇān te pūjayāmi ityājñāṃ gṛhītvā āvaraṇapūjāmārabhet karṇikāmadhye oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hṛllekhāyai namaḥ pūrve aiṃ gaṅgāyai namaḥ dakṣiṇe raktāyai namaḥ uttare iṃ karālikāyai namaḥ paścime mahocchuṣmāyai nama iti prathamāvaraṇam | āgneyyāṃ oṃ hrāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ nair(-)ṛtyāṃ oṃ hrīṃ śirase svāhā vāyavyāṃ oṃ hrṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ aiśānyāṃ oṃ hraiṃ kavacāya huṃ agrabhāge oṃ hrauṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ dikṣu oṃ hraḥ astrāya phaṭ madhye mūlaṃ punarapi ṣaṭkoṇeṣu pūrve gāyatrīsahitabrahmaṇe namaḥ nair(-)ṛtyāṃ sāvitrīsahitaviṣṇave namaḥ vāyavyāṃ sarasvatīsahitāya
rudrāya namaḥ āgneyyāṃ lakṣmīsahitāya kuberāya namaḥ paścimāyāṃ ratisahitāya madanāya namaḥ aiśānyāṃ puṣṭisahitavighnarājāya namaḥ ṣaṭkoṇapārśvayoḥ śaṅkhanidhaye namaḥ padmanidhaye namaḥ punarapi āgneyyādikeśareṣu āgneye oṃ hrāṃ hṛdayaśaktaye namaḥ īśāne oṃ hrīṃ śiraḥ śaktaye namaḥ vāyavye oṃ hrūṁ śikhāśaktaye namaḥ nair(-)ṛtye oṃ hraiṃ kavacaśaktaye namaḥ āgneye oṃ hrauṃ netraśaktaye namaḥ dikṣu oṃ hraḥ astraśaktaye namaḥ madhye mūlaṃ iti dvitīyāvaraṇaṃ || tataḥ pūrvādyaṣṭadaleṣu oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ anaṅgakusumāyai namaḥ anaṅgakusumāturāyai namaḥ anaṅgamadanāyai namaḥ anaṅgamadanāturāyai namaḥ bhuvanapālāyai namaḥ gaganavegāyai namaḥ śaśirekhāyai namaḥ gaganarekhāyai namaḥ madhye mūlaṃ iti tṛtīyāvaraṇam || tataḥ pūrvādiṣoḍaśadaleṣu sampūjya (-)
pūjyapūjakayormadhye prācīti kathyate budhaiḥ |
oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ karālyai namaḥ vikarālyai namaḥ umāyai namaḥ sarasvatyai namaḥ śriyai namaḥ durgāyai namaḥ uṣāyai namaḥ lakṣmyai namaḥ śrutyai namaḥ smṛtyai namaḥ dhṛtyai namaḥ śraddhāyai namaḥ medhāyai namaḥ matyai namaḥ kāntyai namaḥ āryāyai namaḥ madhye mūlaṃ iti caturthāvaraṇam || tataḥ ṣoḍaśapatrebhyo bahiḥ oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ anaṅgarūpāyai namaḥ anaṅgamadanāyai namaḥ || 2 || madanāturāyai namaḥ || 3 || bhuvanavegāyai namaḥ || 4 || bhuvanapālinyai namaḥ || 5 || sarvamadanāyai namaḥ || 6 || anaṅgavedanāyai namaḥ || 7 || anaṅgamekhalāyai namaḥ || 8 || madhye mūlaṃ iti pañcamāvaraṇam || tatastadbahiḥ oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ brāhmyai namaḥ || 1 || māheśvaryyai namaḥ || 2 || kaumāryai namaḥ || 3 || vaiṣṇavyai namaḥ || 4 || vārāhyaiḥ namaḥ || 5 || indrāṇyai namaḥ || 6 || cāmuṇḍāyai namaḥ || 7 || mahālakṣmyai namaḥ || 8 || madhye mūlaṃ tatastadbahiḥ oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ asitāṅgabhairavāya namaḥ || 1 || rurubhairavāya namaḥ || 2 || caṇḍabhairavāyaḥ namaḥ || 3 || krodhabhairavāya namaḥ || 4 || unmattabhairavāya namaḥ || 5 || kapālabhairavāya namaḥ || 6 || bhīṣaṇabhairavāya namaḥ || 7 || saṃhārabhairavāya namaḥ || 8 || madhye mūlaṃ iti ṣaṣṭhāvaraṇam || tato vṛttamadhye oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ indrāya namaḥ || 1 || agnaye namaḥ || 2 || dharmarājāya namaḥ || 3 || nair(-)ṛtyāya namaḥ || 4 || varuṇāya namaḥ || 5 || vāyave namaḥ || 6 || kuberāya namaḥ || 7 || īśānāya namaḥ || 8 || īśāne brahmaṇe namaḥ | nai(-)ṛtyāṃ viṣṇave namaḥ | madhye mūlaṃ iti saptamāvaraṇam || tatastadbahiḥ oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ indraśaktaye namaḥ || 1 || agniśaktaye namaḥ || 2 || yamaśaktaye namaḥ || 3 ||
nair(-)ṛtyaśaktaye namaḥ || 4 || varuṇaśaktaye namaḥ || 5 || vāyavyaśaktaye namaḥ || 6 || kuberaśaktaye namaḥ || 7 || īśānaśaktaye namaḥ || 8 || brahmaśaktaye namaḥ || 9 || vaiṣṇavaśaktaye namaḥ || 10 || madhye(-)varamudrāyai namaḥ || 1 || abhayamudrāyai namaḥ || 2 || japamālāyai namaḥ || 3 || pustakāyai namaḥ || 4 || madhye mūlamiti navamāvaraṇam | tato bhūgṛhe oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ vajraśaktaye namaḥ || 1 || śaktiśaktaye namaḥ || 2 || daṇḍaśaktaye namaḥ || 3 || khaḍgaśaktaye namaḥ || 4 || pāśaśaktaye namaḥ || 5 || aṅkuśaśaktaye namaḥ || 6 || gadāśaktaye namaḥ || 7 || triśūlaśaktaye namaḥ || 8 || padmaśaktaye namaḥ || 9 || cakraśaktaye namaḥ || 10 || madhye mūlamiti daśamāvaraṇaṃ || tatastadbahiḥ oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ airāvatāya namaḥ meṣāya namaḥ mahiṣāya namaḥ pretāya namaḥ makarāya namaḥ mṛgāya namaḥ narāya namaḥ vṛṣabhāya namaḥ haṃsāya namaḥ garuḍāya namaḥ madhye siṃhāya namaḥ tatastadbahiḥ oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ airāvataśaktaye namaḥ meṣaśaktaye namaḥ mahiṣaśaktaye namaḥ pretaśaktaye namaḥ makaraśaktaye namaḥ mṛgaśaktaye namaḥ naraśaktaye namaḥ vṛṣaśaktaye namaḥ haṃsaśaktaye namaḥ garuḍaśaktaye namaḥ siṃhaśaktaye namaḥ ityekādaśāvaraṇam || tataḥ pūrvakrameṇa oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ ādityāya namaḥ somāya namaḥ bhaumāya namaḥ budhāya namaḥ gurave namaḥ śukrāya namaḥ śanaiścarāya namaḥ rāhave namaḥ madhye ketave namaḥ tatastadbahiḥ oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ ādityaśaktaye namaḥ somaśaktaye namaḥ bhaumaśaktaye namaḥ budhaśaktaye namaḥ guruśaktaye namaḥ śukraśaktaye namaḥ śaniśaktaye namaḥ rāhuśaktaye namaḥ madhye ketuśaktaye namaḥ iti dvādaśāvaraṇam || tataḥ pūrve oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ vāṃ vaṭukāya namaḥ dakṣiṇe yāṃ yoginībhyo namaḥ paścime kṣāṃ kṣetrapālāya namaḥ uttare glauṃ gaṇapataye namaḥ īśāne huṃ sarvabhūteśvarāya namaḥ madhye mūlamiti sampūjya saṃtarpya athāvaraṇaṃ dhyāyet (-)
hṛllekhādyāḥ samabhyarcyāḥ paṃcabhūtasamaprabhāḥ | varapāśāṅkuśābhītidhāriṇyo'mitabhūṣaṇāḥ ||
daṇḍakamaṇḍalvakṣamālādhāriṇau gāyatrībrahmāṇau śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadhāriṇau pītāmbarau sāvitrīviṣṇū paraśvakṣamālābhayahastau sarasvatīmaheśvaro ratnakumbhamaṇikaraṇḍakadhāritundilaḥ pītāmbaraḥ kuberaḥ svāṅkasthāṃ dakṣiṇabhujena padmadhāriṇīṃ mahālakṣmīṃ vāmabāhunā'liṅgya sthitaḥ bāṇapāśāṅkuśadharāsanahasto raktamālyāmbaradharo modakahasto dakṣiṇahastenā'liṅgya vāmenotpaladhāriṇīṃ ratiṃ aṅkuśapāśahastaḥ kareṇakāntābhagaṃ
digambaro mādhvīkapūrṇakalaśaṃ dhārayan puṣkareṇa caṣakadhārī raktavarṇo vighneśaḥ madavihvalā raktavarṇā vāmapāṇinā caṣakadhāriṇī gaṇeśaliṅgaṃ spṛśantī anyena dhṛtotpalā samāśliṣṭakāntā digambarā puṣṭiḥ anaṅgarūpādyāstu (-)
caṣakaṃ tālavṛntaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ chatramujvalam | cāmaraṃ ca śukaṃ puṣpaṃ bibhrāṇāḥ karapaṅkajaiḥ || nānā'bharaṇasaṃdīptā ityādi āvaraṇapūjādhyānaṃ vidhāya |
atha divyaughān siddhaughān mānavaughān paṅktitrayeṇa pṛthak pṛthak trikoṇeṣu pūjayet punarapi bindau mūlena sampūjya santarpya pañcamudrāḥ pradarśya tataḥ puṣpāñjalimaṃtreṇa puṣpāñjaliṃ dadyāt (-)
oṃ yaddattaṃ bhaktimātreṇa patraṃ puṣpaṃ jalaṃ phalam | niveditaṃ ca naivedyaṃ tadgṛhāṇānukampayā ||
ityanena pañcapuṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā anyoktibhiryathālābhadravyairhomaṃ kuryāt agnau jale vā cakraṃ vilikhya vibhāvya prāṇāya svāhā apānāya svāhā vyānāya svāhā udānāya svāhā samānāya svāhā ityādi hutvā oṃ hrāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ svāhā ityādi ṣaḍaṅgāhutīrdatvā svayantroktaparivārān mūladevīṃ ca yathoktaprakāreṇa hutvā nāmasahasreṇa homaṃ kṛtvā devīṃ sampūjya kṣamāpayet (-)
oṃ bhūmau skhalitapādānāṃ bhūmirevāvalambanam | tvayi jātāparādhānāṃ tvameva śaraṇaṃ mama || 1 ||
aparādho bhavatyeva sevakasya pade pade | ko'paraḥ sahate loke kevalaṃ svāminaṃ vinā || 2 ||
aparādhasahasrāṇi kriyante'harniśaṃ mayā | samakṣaṃ savidhe sarvamiti mātaḥ kṣamasva me || 3 ||
āvāhanaṃ na jānāmi na jānāmi visarjanam | pūjābhāvaṃ na jānāmi tvaṃ gatiḥ parameśvari(!) || 4 ||
karmaṇā manasā vācā nāsti cānyā gatirmama | antaścāreṇa bhūtānāṃ rakṣa tvaṃ parameśvari(!) || 5 ||
devī dātrī ca bhoktrī ca devī sarvamidaṃ jagat | devī jayati sarvatra yā devī so'hameva hi || 6 ||
yadakṣaraparibhraṣṭaṃ (yadakṣarapadabhraṣṭaṃ mātrāhīnaṃ) maṃtrahīnaṃ ca yadbhavet | kṣantumarhasi deveśi kasya na skhalitaṃ manaḥ || 7 ||
dravyahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ maṃtrahīnaṃ sureśvari(!) | sarvaṃ tat kṛpayā devi kṣamasva parameśvari(!) || 8 ||
yanmayā kriyate kama jāgratsvapnasuṣuptiṣu | tatsarvaṃ tāvakī pūjā bhūyādbhūtyai namaḥ śive(!) || 9 ||
prātaḥ prabhṛti sāyāntaṃ sāyādi prātaraṃtataḥ | yatkaromi jagadyone tadastu tava pūjanam || 10 ||
kṣamasva devadeveśi mama mantrasvarūpiṇi | tava pādāmbhuje nityaṃ niścalā bhaktirastu me || 11 ||
ityevaṃ devīṃ kṣamāpya punarapi nirmālyaṃ tyaktvā sampūjya devīṃ svahṛdi visarjayet | puṣpāñjalimādāya (-)
oṃ gaccha gaccha paraṃ sthānaṃ svasthānaṃ parameśvari(!) | yatra brahmādayo devā na viduḥ paramaṃ padam ||
iti pīṭhe puṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā saṃhāramudrayā pīṭhāt puṣpaṃ gṛhṇīyāt(-)
oṃ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha pare sthāne svasthāne parameśvari(!) | yatra brahmādayaḥ sarve surāstiṣṭhanti me hṛdi ||
iti paṭhitvā puṣpaṃ hṛdi spṛśannāghrāya śirasi sthāpayet | tata īśāne maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā vāṃ vaṭukāya nama iti sampūjya oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ aihyehi devīputra baṭukanātha kapilajaṭābhārabhāsvara trinetra jvālāmukha sarvavighnānnāśaya nāśaya sarvopacārasahitaṃ baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa svāhā ityanenāṅguṣṭhānāmikāyogena īśānāya baṭukāya baliṃ dattvā āgneyyāṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā yāṃ yoginībhyo nama iti sampūjya oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ(-)
ūrddhvaṃ brahmāṇḍato vā divi gaganatale bhūtale niṣkale vā pātāle vā'nale vā salilapavanayoryatra kutra sthito vā | kṣetre pīṭhopapīṭhādiṣu ca kṛtapadā dhūpadīpādikena prītā devyaḥ sadā naḥ śubhabalividhinā pāntu vīrendravandhyāḥ ||
yāṃ yoginībhyo huṃ phaṭ svāhā ityanena kaniṣṭhikāṅguṣṭhayogena vahnikoṇe yoginibhyo baliṃ dattvā nair(-)ṛtyāṃ oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ kṣāṃ kṣīṃ kṣūṃ kṣaiṃ kṣauṃ kṣaḥ sthānakṣetrapāla (!) sarvakāmān pūraya pūraya alibalisahitaṃ baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa svāhā ityanena vāyukoṇe maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā sampūjya śrāṃ gāṃ gīṃ gūṃ gaiṃ gauṃ gaḥ gaṇapataye varavarada sarvajanaṃ me vaśamānaya imāṃ pūjāṃ baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa svāhā gajaśuṇḍamudrayā baliṃ dadyāt ityanena gaṇapataye baliṃ dattvā īśānetarayormadhye maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ sarvavighnakṛdbhyaḥ sarvabhūtebhyaḥ huṃ phaṭ svāhā ityanena sarvabhūtebhyo baliṃ datvā tato chāgādibalimapi dadyāt | tataḥ śirasi guruṃ hṛdi iṣṭadevatāṃ ca dhyātvā yathāśaktito japaṃ vidhāya prāṇāyāma(-)ṛṣyādikaraṣaḍaṅganyāsān vidhāya jalamādāya(-)
oṃ guhyātiguhyagoptrī tvaṃ gṛhāṇāsmatkṛtaṃ japam | siddhirbhavatu me devi tvatprasādānmaheśvari (!) ||
ityanena tejomayaṃ japaphalaṃ devyā vāmahaste samarpya kavacasahasranāmastotrādi paṭhitvā sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇipatya pradakṣiṇīkṛtya sāmayikaiḥ saha pātravandanaṃ vidhāya(-)
nandantu sādhakāḥ sarve vinaśyantu vidūṣakāḥ | avasthā śāmbhavī me'stu prasanno'stu guruḥ sadā ||
ityādi śāntistotraṃ paṭhitvā īśāne maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā oṃ nirmālyavāsinyai nama ityanena īśāne nirmālyādikaṃ nikṣipya jalamādāya oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ itaḥ prāṇabuddhidehadharmādhikārato jāgratsvapnasuṣuptyavasthāsu manasā vācā karmaṇā hastābhyāṃ padbhyāṃ udareṇaśiśnā yatsmṛtaṃ yaduktaṃ yatkṛtaṃ tat sarvaṃ māmakīnaṃ sakalaṃ śrībhuvaneśvaryyāścaraṇakamale samarpaṇamastu svāhā ityanenāgrabhāge jalaṃ nikṣipya oṃ tatsad brahma iti smṛtvā yathāsukhaṃ viharet ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre daśavidyārahasye śrībhuvaneśvaryā nityapūjanapaddhatiḥ sampūrṇā] || saṃvat (1943) mitī śrāvaṇa sudi (9) ravivāsare śrīrastu || kalyāṇamastu ||
[atha kavacam]
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
oṃ asya śrībhuvaneśvarīmaṃtrasya śaktir(-)ṛṣirgāyatrī chandaḥ bhuvaneśvarī devatā haṃ bījaṃ īṃ śaktiḥ raṃ kīlakaṃ mamābhīṣṭasiddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ | śakti(-)ṛṣaye namaḥ śirasi gāyatrīchandase namo mukhe śrībhuvaneśvarīdevatāyai namo hṛdi haṃ bījāya namo guhye īṃ śaktaye namaḥ pādayoḥ raṃ kīlakāya namaḥ sarvāṅge | oṃ hrāṃ aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ hrīṃ tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ hrūṃ madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ hraiṃ anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ hrauṃ kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ hraḥ karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | hrāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ hrīṃ śirase svāhā hrūṃ śikhāyai vaṣat hraiṃ kavacāya huṃ hrauṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ hraḥ astrāya phaṭ ityādi nyāsaṃ kṛtvā dhyāyet (-)
oṃ udyadinadyutimindukirīṭāṃ tuṅgakucāṃ nayanatrayayuktām | smeramukhīṃ varadāṅkuśapāśābhītikarāṃ prabhaje bhuvaneśīm ||
devyuvāca(-)
bhuvaneśyāśca deveśa yā yā vidyāḥ prakāśitāḥ | śrutāścādhigatāḥ sarvāḥ śrotumicchāmi sāmpratam || 1 ||
trailokyamaṅgalaṃ nāma kavacaṃ yat puroditam (kh: purā kṛtam) | kathayasva mahādeva(!) mama prītikaraṃ param || 2 ||
īśvara uvāca(-)
pārvati śṛṇu vakṣyāmi sāvadhānā'vadhāraya | trailokyamaṅgalaṃ nāma kavacaṃ maṃtravigraham || 3 ||
siddhividyāmayaṃ devi sarvaiśvaryapradāyakam (kh: samanvitam) | paṭhanāddhāraṇān martyastrailokyaiśvaryavān (kh: trailokyaiśvaryabhāg) bhavet || 4 ||
trailokyamaṅgalasyāsya kavacasya ṛṣiḥ śivaḥ | chando virāṭ jagaddhātrī devatā bhuvaneśvarī || 5 ||
dharmārthakāmamokṣārthe (kh: mokṣeṣu) viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | hrīṃ bījaṃ me śiraḥ pātu bhuvaneśī lalāṭakam || 6 ||
aiṃ pātu dakṣanetraṃ me hrīṃ pātu vāmalocanam | śrīṃ pātu dakṣakarṇaṃ me trivarṇātmā maheśvarī || 7 ||
vāmakarṇaṃ sadā pātu aiṃ ghrāṇaṃ pātu me sadā | hrīṃ pātu vadanaṃ (kh: vadane) devī aiṃ pātu rasanāṃ mama || 8 ||
vāktripurā (kh: tripurā pātu; g: tripuṭā pātu) trivarṇātmā kaṇṭhaṃ pātu parātmikā | śrīṃ skandhau pātu niyataṃ hrīṃ bhujau pātu sarvadā || 9 ||
klīṃ karau tripureśānī (kh: me) tripuraiśvaryadāyinī | śrīṃ (āṃ) pātu hṛdayaṃ hrīṃ me madhyadeśaṃ sadā'vatu || 10 ||
kroṃ pātu nābhideśaṃ sā (kh: sarvabījapradā) tryakṣarī bhuvaneśvarī | sarvajīvapradā (kh: śaṅkhinī sarvaṃvajrapadā) pṛṣṭhaṃ pātu sarvavaśaṃkarī || 11 ||
hrīṃ pātu guhyadeśaṃ me namo bhagavatī kaṭim | māheśvarī sadā pātu sakthinī (kh: sarvato mudā) jānuyugmakam || 12 ||
annapurṇe sadā pātu svāhā pātu padadvayam | saptadaśākṣarī pāyādannapūrṇā'khilaṃ vapuḥ || 13 ||
tāraṃ māyā ramā kāmaḥ ṣoḍaśārṇā tataḥ param | śiraḥsthā sarvadā pātu viṃśatyarṇātmikā parā || 14 ||
tāraṃ durge yugaṃ rakṣiṇi svāheti daśākṣarī | jayadurgā ghanaśyāmā pātuṃ māṃ pūrvataḥ sadā (kh: tataḥ) || 15 ||
māyā bījādikā caiṣā daśārṇā ca tathā (kh: jaya durgā'nane'vatu; g: jayadurgā'vane'vatu) parā | uttaptakāñcanābhā sā jayadurgā'nale'vatu || 16 ||
tāraṃ hrīṃ durgāyai nama aṣṭavarṇātmikā parā (kh: tāraṃ hrīṃ duṃ ca durgāyai namo'ṣṭārṇātmikā parā) | śaṅkhacakradhanurbāṇadharā māṃ dakṣiṇe'vatu || 17 ||
mahiṣamarddinī svāahā vasuvarṇātmikā parā | nair(-)ṛtyāṃ sarvadā pātu mahiṣāsuranāśinī || 18 ||
māyā padmāvatī svāhā paścime māṃ sadā'vatu (kh, g: saptārṇā parikīrtitā | + padmāvatīpadmasaṃsthā paścime māṃ sadā'vatu) | pāśāṅkuśapuṭā māyā pāhi parameśvari svāhā (g: māyeti parameśvari svāhā) || 19 ||
trayodaśārṇā (g: namo daśārṇā) aśvārūḍhā'nile'vatu (kh: sā'śvarūḍhā) | sarasvatī pañcaśare (kh: pañcasvarā) nityaklinne madadrave || 20 ||
svāhā ca tryakṣarī (kh: vasvakṣarī) nityā māmuttare sadā'vatu | tāraṃ māyā ca kavacaṃ khe ca (g: khe rakṣet satataṃ vadhuḥ) rakset tato vadhuḥ (g: stvaritāṣṭāhibhiḥ budhaḥ) || 21 ||
huṃ kṣeṃ hrīṃ phaṭ mahāvidyā dvādaśārṇā'khilapradā | tvaritaṣṭādibhiḥ pāyācchivakoṇe sadā ca mām || 22 ||
aiṃ klīṃ sauṃḥ satataṃ bālā māmūrddhvadeśato'vatu | bindvantā (kh: māmūrdhvadeśe tato'vatu; g: bindunā) bhairavī bālā bhūmau (kh: hsauṃ; g: hastau) māṃ sarvadā'vatu || 23 ||
iti te kavacaṃ (kh: etat te kathitaṃ) puṇyaṃ trailokyamaṅgalaṃ param | sārāt sārataraṃ puṇyaṃ mahāvidyaughavigraham || 24 ||
asya hi paṭhanānnityaṃ (kh: asyāpi paṭhanāt sadyaḥ; g: dhāraṇātpaṭhanādyataḥ) kubero'pi dhaneśvaraḥ | indrādyāḥ sakalā devāḥ paṭhanāddhāraṇādyataḥ (kh: dadyāt) || 25 ||
sarvasiddhīśvarāḥ saṃtaḥ sarvaiśvaryamavāpnuyuḥ | puṣpāñjalyaṣṭakaṃ dattvā (kh: pṛthak pṛthak) mūlenaiva paṭhet sakṛt (kh: prītimanyonyataḥ) || 26 ||
saṃvatsarakṛtāyāstu pūjāyāḥ phalamāpnuyāt | prītimān yo'nyataḥ (kh: tattanum) kṛttvā kamalā niścalā gṛhe || 27 ||
vāṇī ca nivasedvaktre satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | yo dhārayati puṇyātmā trailokyamaṅgalābhidham (kh: parameśvarīṃ) || 28 ||
kavacaṃ paramaṃ puṇyaṃ so'pi puṇyavatāṃ varaḥ | sarvaiśvaryayuto bhūtvā trailokyavijayī bhavet || 29 ||
puruṣo dakṣiṇe bāhau nārī vāmabhuje tathā | bahuputravatī bhūtvā vandhyāpi labhate sutam || 30 ||
brahmāstrādīni śastrāṇi naiva kṛntanti taṃ janam | etatkavacamajñātvā yo japed bhuvaneśvarīṃ || 31 ||
drāridryaṃ paramaṃ prāpya so'cirān mṛtyumāpnuyāt || 32 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre pārvatīśvarasaṃvāde trailokyamaṅgalam nāma bhuvaneśvarīkavacaṃ samāptam] ||
[śrībhuvaneśvarīsahasranām ]
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
śrīdevyuvāca (-)
deva deva mahādeva sarvaśāstraviśārada (!) | kapālakhaṭvāṅgadhara (!) citābhasmānulepana (!) || 1 ||
ādyā yā prakṛtirnityā sarvaśāstreṣu gopitā | tasyāḥ śrībhuvaneśvaryā nāmnāṃ puṇyaṃ sahasrakam || 2 ||
kathayasva mahādeva (!) yathā devī prasīdati |
īśvara (g: mahādeva) uvāca (-)
sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ mahādevi (!) sādhakānāṃ hitāya vai || 3 ||
yā nityā prakṛtirādyā sarvaśāstreṣu gopitā | yasyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 4 ||
ārādhanādbhavedyasyā jīvanmukto na saṃśayaḥ | tasyā nāmasahasraṃ vai kathayāmi samāsataḥ || 5 ||
oṃ asya śrībhuvaneśvaryāḥ sahasranāmastotrasya dakṣiṇāmūrtir(-)ṛṣiḥ paṃktiśchandaḥ ādyā śrībhuvaneśvarī devatā hrīṃ bījaṃ śrīṃ śaktiḥ klīṃ kīlakaṃ mama śrīdharmārthakāmamokṣārthe jape viniyogaḥ |
ādyā māyā parā śaktiḥ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ bhuvaneśvarī | bhuvanā bhāvanā bhavyā (g: bhuvanābhuvanā bhāvyā) bhavānī bhavabhāvinī || 6 ||
rudrāṇī rudrabhaktā ca tathā rudrapriyā satī | umā kātyāyanī durgā maṅgalā sarvamaṅgalā || 7 ||
tripurā parameśānī tripurā sundarī priyā (g: sundarī sundarapriyā) | ramaṇā ramaṇī rāmā rāmakāryakarī śubhā || 8 ||
brāhmī nārāyaṇī caṇḍī (g: caṇḍā) cāmuṇḍā muṇḍanāyikā | māheśvarī ca kaumārī vārāhī cāparājitā || 9 ||
mahāmāyā muktakeśī mahātripurasundarī | sundarī śobhanā raktā raktavastrāpidhāyinī || 10 ||
raktākṣī raktavastrā ca raktabījātisundarī (g: raktabījaniṣūdinī) | raktacandanasiktāṅgī raktapuṣpasadāpriyā (g: raktapuṣpapriyā sadā) || 11 ||
kamalā kāminī kāntā kāmadevasadāpriyā (g: kāmadevapriyā sadā) | lakṣmī lolā cañcalākṣī cañcalā capalā priyā || 12 ||
bhairavaī bhayahartrī (g: bhayahantrī) ca mahābhayavināśinī | bhayaṅkarī mahābhīmā bhayahā bhayanāśinī || 13 ||
śmaśāne prāntare durge saṃsmṛtā bhayanāśinī (g: bhayahāriṇī) | jayā ca vijayā caiva jayapūrṇā (g: jayanā ca) jayapradā || 14 ||
yamunā yāmunā yāmyā yāmunajā (g: yamabhāgī) yamapriyā | sarveṣāṃ janikā janyā janahā janavarddhinī || 15 ||
kālī kapālinī kullā kālikā kālarātrikā | mahākālahṛdisthā ca kālabhairavarūpiṇī || 16 ||
kapālakhaṭvāṅgadharā pāśāṅkuśavidhāriṇī | abhayā ca bhayā caiva tathā ca bhayanāśinī (g: tathā bhayavināśinī) || 17 ||
mahābhayapradātrī ca tathā ca varahastinī | gaurī gaurāṅginī gaurā gauravarṇā jayapradā || 18 ||
ugrā ugraprabhā śāntiḥ śāntidā'śāntināśinī (g: śītanāśinī) | ugratārā tathā cogrā nīlā caikajaṭā tathā || 19 ||
hāṃ hāṃ hūṃ hūṃ (g: haṃsarūpā) tathā tārā tathā ca siddhikālikā | tārā nīlā ca vāgīśī tathā nīlasarasvatī || 20 ||
gaṅgā kāśī satī satyā sarvatīrthamayī tathā | tīrtharūpā tīrthapuṇyā tīrthadā tīrthasevikā || 21 ||
puṇyadā puṇyarūpā ca puṇyakīrtiprakāśinī (g: pratāriṇī) | puṇyakālā puṇyasaṃsthā tathā puṇyajanapriyā || 22 ||
tulasī totulāstotrā (g: totalā tolā) rādhikā rādhanapriyā | satyāsatyā satyabhāmā rukmiṇī kṛṣṇavallabhā (g: rukmavallabhā) || 23 ||
devakī kṛṣṇamātā ca subhadrā bhadrarūpiṇī | manoharā tathā saumyā śyāmāṅgī samadarśanā || 24 ||
ghorarūpā ghoratejā ghoravatpriyadarśanā | kumārī bālikā kṣudrā (g: kṣubdhā) kumārīrūpadhāriṇī || 25 ||
yuvatī yuvatīrūpā yuvatīrasarañjikā (kh: rasarañjitā) | pīnastanī kṣudramadhyā (kh: kṣudrarūpā) prauḍhā madhyā jarāturā || 26 ||
ativṛddhā sthāṇurūpā calāṅgī cañcalā calā (kh: devakāryakarī śubhā | lāṅgalī cañcalā vegā devamātāsvarūpiṇī) | devamātā devarūpā devakāryakarī śubhā || 27 ||
devamātā ditirdakṣā sarvamātā sanātanī | pānapriyā pāyanī ca (kh: ca yajvānī) pālanā (kh: pālinī) pālanapriyā || 28 ||
matsyāśī māṃsabhakṣyā ca sudhāśī janavallabhā (kh: māṃsāśī janavallabhā) | tapasvinī tapī tapyā (kh: tapastāpyā) tapaḥsiddhipradāyinī || 29 ||
haviṣyā ca (kh, g: haviṣyāśī) havirbhoktrī havyakavyanivāsinī | yajurvedā vaśyakarī (kh, g: yajurvahā vaṃśakarī) yajñāṅgī yajñavallabhā (kh: yajñabhuk sadā; g: yajñabhuk satī) || 30 ||
dakṣā dākṣāyiṇī durgā (kh: dākṣāyaṇī mahādurgā) dakṣayajñavināśinī | pārvatī parvataprītā tathā parvatavāsinī || 31 ||
haimī harmyā hemarūpā menā mānyā manoramā | kailāsavāsinī muktā (kh, g: śuklā) śarvakriḍāvilāsinī (kh, g: śivakroḍavilāsinī) || 32 ||
cārvaṅgī cārurūpā ca suvaktrā ca śubhānanā | calatkuṇḍalagaṇḍaśrīrlasatkuṇḍaladhāriṇī || 33 ||
mahāsiṃhāsanasthā (kh, g: mahāsiṃhoparisthā ca) ca hemabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā | hemāṅgadā hemabhūṣā sūryakoṭisamaprabhā || 34 ||
bālādityasamākāntiḥ sindūrārcitavigrahā | yavā yāvakarūpā ca raktacandanarūpadhṛk || 35 ||
koṭarī koṭarākṣī ca nirlajjā ca digambarā | pūtanā (kh: pūrṇānanā) bālamātā ca śūnyālayanivāsinī || 36 ||
śmaśānavāsinī śūnyā hṛdyā caturavāsinī (g: haracatvaravāsinī) | madhukaiṭabhahaṃtrī ca mahiṣāsuraghātinī (kh: nāśinī) || 37 ||
niśumbhaśumbhamathanī caṇḍamuṇḍavināśinī | śivākhyā śivarūpā ca śivadūtī śivapriyā || 38 ||
śivadā śivavakṣaḥsthā śarvāṇī (kh: serveṣāṃ; g: śivānī) śivakāriṇī | indrāṇī cendrakanyā ca (kh: rudrāṇī rudrakanyā ca) rājakanyā surapriyā || 39 ||
lajjāśīlā sādhuśīlā kulastrī kulabhūṣikā (kh: kulapālikā) | mahākulīnā niṣkāmā nirlajjā kulabhūṣaṇā (bhūṣaṇānvitā) || 40 ||
kulīnā kulakanyā ca tathā ca kulabhūṣitā | anantānantarūpā ca (kh, g: anantānanta pālā ca) anantāsuranāśinī || 41 ||
hasantī śivasaṅgena vāñchitānandadāyinī | nāgāṅgī nāgabhūṣā ca nāgahāravidhāriṇī || 42 ||
dhariṇī dhāriṇī dhanyā mahāsiddhipradāyinī (kh: aṣṭa) | ḍākinī śākinī caiva rākinī hākinī tathā (kh: rākṣasī ḍāmarī tathā) || 43 ||
bhūtā pretā piśācī ca yakṣiṇī dhanadārcitā (kh, g: dhanadā śivā) | dhṛtiḥ kīrtiḥ (kh: śrutiḥ) smṛtirmedhā (mahāmedhā) tuṣṭiḥpuṣṭirumā ruṣā (g: uṣā) || 44 ||
śāṅkarī śāmbhavī mīnā (kh, g: menāratiḥ) ratiḥ prītiḥ smarāturā | anaṅgamadanā devī anaṅgamadanāturā || 45 ||
bhuvaneśī mahāmāyā tathā bhuvanapālinī | īśvarī ceśvaraprītā candraśekharabhūṣaṇā || 46 ||
cittānandakarī (kh: cidānandakarī) devī cittasaṃsthā janasya ca | arūpā bahurūpā ca sarvarūpā cidātmikā (kh: arūpā sarvarūpā ca tathā'nandapradā śivā) || 47 ||
anantarūpiṇī nityā tathānantapradāyinī | nandā cānandarūpā ca tathā'nandaprakāśinī || 48 ||
sadānandā sadānityā sādhakānandadāyinī | vanitā taruṇī bhavyā bhavikā ca vibhāvinī || 49 ||
candrasūryasamā dīptā sūryavatparipālinī | nārasiṃhī hayagrīvā hiraṇyākṣavināśinī || 50 ||
vaiṣṇavī viṣṇubhaktā ca śālagrāmanivāsinī | caturbhujā cāṣṭabhujā sahasrabhujasaṃjñitā || 51 ||
ādyā kātyāyanī nityā sarvādyā sarvadāyinī (kh: sarvadāyikā) | sarvacandramayī (g: sarvamaṃtramayī) devī sarvavedamayī śubhā || 52 ||
sarvadevamayī devī sarvalokamayī purā (kh: parā) | sarvasammohinī devī sarvalokavaśaṃkarī || 53 ||
rājinī rañjinī rāgā (kh: rajanī rañjitā rāmā; g: rañjinī rañjitā rāgā) dehalāvaṇyarañjitā | naṭī naṭapriyā dhūrtā tathā dhūrtajanārdinī (kh, g: dhūrtajanapriyā) || 54 ||
mahāmāyā mahāmohā mahāsatvavimohitā | balipriyā māṃsarucirmadhumāṃsapriyā sadā || 55 ||
madhumattā mādhavikā madhumādhavarūpikā (g: sādhumādhavarūpikā) | divāmayī rātrimayī saṃdhyā saṃdhisvarūpiṇī || 56 ||
kālarūpā sūkṣmarūpā sūkṣmiṇī (kh: suṣumṇā) cātisūkṣmiṇī | tithirūpā vārarūpā tathā nakṣatrarūpiṇī || 57 ||
sarvabhūtamayī devī pañcabhūtanivāsinī | śūnyākārā śūnyarūpā śūnyasaṃsthā ca stambhinī (kh: stambhikā) || 58 ||
ākāśagāminī devī jyotiścakranivāsinī | grahāṇāṃ sthitirūpā ca rudrāṇī cakrasambhavā (kh: rudrādīnāñca sambhavā) || 59 ||
ṛṣīṇāṃ brahmaputrāṇāṃ (g: vratapātrāṇāṃ) tapaḥsiddhipradāyinī | arundhatī ca gāyatrī sāvitrī satvarūpiṇī (kh, g: satyarūpiṇī) || 60 ||
citāsaṃsthā citārūpā cittasiddhipradāyinī (kh: cittasaṃsthā cittirūpā cintā siddhipradāyinī) | śavasthā śavarūpā ca śavaśatrunivāsinī (kh: śabdasthā śabdarūpā ca śabdacakranivāsinī; g: śavacakranivāsinī) || 61 ||
yoginī yogarūpā ca yogināṃ malahāriṇī (kh: varadhāriṇī) | suprasanā mahādevī yāmunī (kh: māyinī) muktidāyinī || 62 ||
nirmalā vimalā śuddhā śudhasatvā jayapradā | mahāvidyā mahāmāyā (kh, g: mahāmāyā viṣṇumāyā) mohinī viśvamohinī || 63 ||
kāryasiddhikarī devī sarvakāryanivāsinī | kāryākāryakarī raudrī mahāpralayakāriṇī || 64 ||
strīpuṃbhedāhyabhedyā ca (g: strīpuṃbhedābhedarūpā) bhedinī bhedanāśinī | sarvarūpā sarvamayī advaitānandarūpiṇī (kh: advaitānantarūpiṇī) || 65 ||
pracaṇḍā caṇḍikā caṇḍā caṇḍāsuravināśinī | sumastā (kh, g: sumattā) bahumastā ca chinnamastā'sunāśinī (kh: asunāsikā; g: chinnamadhyā sunāsikā) || 66||
arūpā ca virūpā ca citrarūpā cidātmikā (kh: surūpā rūpavarjitā | citrarūpā mahārūpā vicitrā ca cidātmikā) | bahuśastrā aśastrā ca (kh: pyaśastrā ca) sarvaśastraprahāriṇī || 67 ||
śāstrārthā śāstravādā ca nānā śāstrārthavādinī | kāvyaśāstrapramodā ca kāvyālaṅkāravāsinī || 68 ||
rasajñā rasanā jihvā rasāmodā rasapriyā | nānākautukasaṃyuktā nānārasavilāsinī || 69 ||
arūpā ca svarūpā ca virūpā ca surūpiṇī (kh, g: avyaktāvyaktarūpā ca viśvarūpā ca rūpiṇī) | rūpāvasyā tathā jivā veśyādyā (kh: g: jīvāveśāḍhyā) veśadhāriṇī || 70 ||
nānāveśadharā (kh: veśadharī) devī nānāveśeṣu saṃsthitā | kurūpā kuṭilā (kh, g: kutsitā) kṛṣṇā kṛṣṇārūpā ca kālikā || 71 ||
lakṣmīpradā mahālakṣmīḥ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutā | kuberagṛhasaṃsthā (kh: kuberagraha) ca dhanarūpā dhanapradā || 72 ||
nānāratnapradā devī ratnakhaṇḍeṣu saṃsthitā | varṇasaṃsthā varṇarūpā sarvavarṇamayī sadā (g: nāsti) || 73 ||
oṃkārarūpiṇī vācyā (g: ādyā) ādityajyotīrūpiṇī | saṃsāramocinī devī saṃgrāme jayadāyine || 74 ||
jayarūpā jayākhyā ca yajinī jayadāyinī | māninī mānarūpā ca mānabhaṅgapraṇāśinī || 75 ||
mānyā mānapriyā medhā māninī mānadāyinī | sādhakāsādhakāsādhyā sādhikā sādhanapriyā || 76 ||
sthāvarā jaṅgamā proktā (kh, g: sūkṣmā) capalā capalapriyā | ṛddhidā ṛddhirūpā ca siddhidā siddhidāyinī || 77 ||
kṣemaṅkarī śaṅkarī ca sarvasammohakāriṇī | rañjitā rañjinī yā ca sarvavāñchāpradāyinī || 78 ||
bhagaliṅgapramodā ca bhagaliṅganivāsinī | bhagarūpā bhagābhāgyā liṅgarūpā ca liṅginī || 79 ||
bhagagītirmahāprītirliṅgagītirmahāsukhā | svayaṃbhūḥ kusumārādhyā svayaṃbhūḥ kusumākulā (svayaṃbhūḥ kusumākalā) || 80 ||
svayaṃbhūḥ puṣparūpā ca svayambhūḥ kusumapriyā | śukrakūpā (kh: g: śukrarūpā) mahākūpā śukrāsavanivāsinī (kh, g: mahāśukrā śukrabindunivāsinī) || 81 ||
śukrasthā śukriṇī śukrā śukrapūjakapūjitā | kāmākṣā kāmarūpā ca yoginī pīṭhavāsinī || 82 ||
sarvapīṭhamayī devī pīṭhapūjānivāsinī (kh: pīṭhamadhyanivāsinī) | akṣamālādharā devī pānapātravidhāriṇī (kh: g: vidhāyinī) || 83 ||
śūlinī śūlahastā ca pāśinī pāśarūpiṇī | khaḍginī gadinī caiva tathā sarvāstradhāriṇī || 84 ||
bhāvyā bhavyā bhavānī sā bhavamuktipradāyinī | caturā caturaprītā caturānanapūjitā || 85 ||
devastavyā devapūjyā sarvapūjyā sureśvarī | jananī janarūpā ca janānāṃ cittahāriṇī || 86 ||
jaṭilā keśabaddhā ca sukeśī keśabaddhikā (kh: keśavātmikā; g: keśavā śivā) | ahiṃsā dveṣikā dveṣyā sarvadveṣavināśinī || 87 ||
uccāṭinī dveṣinī (g: stambhinī) ca mohinī madhurākṣarā (g: madhurāsanā) | krīḍā krīḍakalekhāṅkakāraṇākārakārikā (kh, g: krīḍā krīḍanakhelā ca khelākaraṇakārikā) || 88 ||
sarvajñā sarvakāryā ca sarvabhakṣā surārihā | sarvarūpā sarvaśāntā (g: sarvasītā) sarveṣāṃ prāṇarūpiṇī || 89 ||
sṛṣṭisthitikarī devī tathā (g: māyā) pralayakāriṇī | mugdhā sādhvī tathā raudrī nānāmūrtividhāriṇī (g: nāsti) || 90 ||
uktāni yāni deveśi anuktāni maheśvari | yat kiñcid dṛśyate devi tat sarvaṃ bhuvaneśvarī || 91 ||
iti śrībhuvaneśvaryā nāmāni kathitāni te | sahasrāṇi mahādevi phalaṃ teṣāṃ nigadyate || 92 ||
yaḥ paṭhet prātarutthāya cārddharātre tathā priye | prātaḥkāle tathā madhye sāyāhne haravallabhe || 93 ||
yatra tatra paṭhitvā ca bhaktyā siddhirna saṃśayaḥ | paṭhed vā pāṭhayed vāpi śṛṇuyācchrāvayettathā || 94 ||
tasya sarvaṃ bhavet satyaṃ manasā yacca vāñchitam | aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ navamyāṃ vā viśeṣataḥ || 95 ||
sarvamaṅgalasaṃyukte saṃkrātau śanibhaumayoḥ | yaḥ paṭhet parayā bhaktyā devyā nāmasahasrakam || 96 ||
tasya dehe ca saṃsthanaṃ kurute bhuvaneśvarī | tasya kāryaṃ bhaved devi anyathā na kathañcana || 97 ||
śmaśāne prāntare vāpi śūnyāgāre catuṣpathe | catuṣpathe caikaliṅge merudeśe tathaiva ca || 98 ||
jalamadhye vahnimadhye saṃgrāme grāmaśāntaye (kh: prāṇasaṃśaye) | japtvā maṃtrasahasraṃ tu (kh: vai) paṭhennāmasahasrakam || 99 ||
dhūpadīpādibhiścaiva balidānādikaistathā | nānāvidhaistathā devi naivedyai (kh: pakvānnaiḥ) rbhuvaneśvarīm || 100 ||
sampūjya vidhivajjaptvā stutvā nāmasahasrakaiḥ (kh: śrutvā nāmasahasrakam) | acirāt siddhimāpnoti sādhako nātra saṃśayaḥ || 101 ||
tasya tuṣṭā bhaved devī sarvadā bhuvaneśvarī | bhūrjapatre samālikhya kuṃkumād raktacandanaiḥ || 102 ||
tathā gorocanādyaiśca vilikhya sādhakottamaḥ | sutithau śubhanakṣtre likhitvā dakṣiṇe bhuje || 103 ||
dhārayet parayā bhaktyā devīrūpeṇa pārvati (!) | tasya siddhirmaheśāni acirācca bhaviṣyati || 104 ||
raṇe (g: vane) rājakule vā'pi sarvatra vijayī bhavet | devatā vaśamāyāti kiṃ purnamānavādayaḥ || 105 ||
vidyāstambhaṃ jalastambhaṃ (kh, g: vāyvagnyośca gatistambham) karotyeva na saṃśayaḥ | paṭhed vā pāṭhayed vā'pi devībhaktyā (kh, g: buddhyā) ca pārvati || 106 ||
iha bhuktvā varān (kh: kalau) bhogān kṛtvā kāvyārthavistarān (g: kāvyān sudustarān) | ante devyā gaṇatvaṃ ca sādhako muktimāpnuyāt || 107 ||
prāpnoti devadeveśi sarvārthannātra saṃśayaḥ | hīnāṅge cātiriktāṅge śaṭhāya paraśiṣyake || 108 ||
na dātavyaṃ maheśāni prāṇānte'pi kadācana | śiṣyāya matiśuddhāya (kh, g: bhaktiyuktāya) vinītāya maheśvari || 109 ||
dātavyaḥ stavarājaśca sarvasiddhiprado bhavet | likhitvā dhārayed dehe duḥkhaṃ tasya na jāyate || 110 ||
ya idaṃ bhuvaneśvaryāḥ stavarājaṃ maheśvari | iti te kathita devi bhuvaneśyāḥ sahasrakam || 111 ||
yasmai kasmai na dātavyaṃ vinā śiṣyāya pārvati (g: nāsti) | surataruvarakāntaṃ siddhisādhyaikasevyaṃ (kh, g: siddhasaṅghaikasevyaṃ) yadi paṭhati manuṣyo nānyacetāḥ sadaiva | iha hi sakalabhogān (kh: nikhilabhogān) prāpya cānte śivāya vrajati parasamīpaṃ sarvadā muktimante (kh: parisamīpaṃ kinnaraiḥ stūyamānaḥ) || 112 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre bhuvaneśvarīsahasranāmākhyaṃ stotraṃ sampūrṇam || śrīrastu] ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
[atha śrībhuvaneśvaryaṣṭottaraśatanāmastotram]
īśvara uvāca
mahāsammohinī devī sundarī bhuvaneśvarī | ekākṣarī ekamantrī ekākī lokanāyikā || 1 ||
ekarūpā mahārūpā sthūlasūkṣmaśarīriṇī | bījarūpā mahāśaktiḥ saṅgrāme jayavarddhinī || 2 ||
mahāratirmahāśaktiryoginī pāpanāśinī | aṣṭasiddhiḥ kalārūpā vaiṣṇavī bhadrakālikā || 3 ||
bhaktipriyā mahādevī haribrahmādirūpiṇī | śivarūpī viṣṇurūpī kālarūpī sukhāsinī || 4 ||
purāṇī puṇyarūpī ca pārvatī puṇyavarddhinī | rudrāṇī pārvatīndrāṇī śaṅkarārddhaśarīriṇī || 5 ||
nārāyaṇī mahādevī mahiṣī sarvamaṅgalā | akārādikṣakārāntā hyaṣṭātriṃśatkalādharī || 6 ||
saptamā triguṇā nārī śarīrotpattikāriṇī | ākalpāntakalāvyāpisṛṣṭisaṃhārakāriṇī || 7 ||
sarvaśaktirmahāśaktiḥ śarvāṇī parameśvarī | hṛllekhā bhuvanā devī mahākaviparāyaṇā || 8 ||
icchājñānakriyārūpā aṇimādiguṇāṣṭakā | namaḥ śivāyai śāntāyai śāṅkari bhuvaneśvari || 9 ||
vedavedāṅgarūpā ca atisūkṣmā śarīriṇī | kālajñānī śivajñāni śaivadharmaparāyaṇā || 10 ||
kālāntarī kālarūpī saṃjñānāṃ prāṇadhāriṇī | khaḍgaśreṣṭhā ca khaṭvāṅgi triśūlavaradhāriṇī || 11 ||
arūpā bahurūpā ca nāyikā lokavaśyagā | abhayā lokarakṣā ca pinākī nāgadhāriṇī || 12 ||
vajraśaktirmahāśaktiḥ pāśatomaradhāriṇī | aṣṭādaśabhujā devī hṛllekhā bhuvanā tathā || 13 ||
khaḍgadhāri mahārūpā somasūryāgnimadhyagā | evaṃ śatāṣṭakaṃ nāma stotraṃ ramaṇabhāṣitaṃ || 14 ||
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvāriṣṭanivāraṇam | sarvaśatrukṣayakaraṃ sadā vijayavarddhanam || 15 ||
āyuṣkaraṃ puṣṭikaraṃ rakṣākaraṃ yaśaskaram | amarādipadaiśvaryamamattvāṃśakalāpaham || 16 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre bhuvaneśvaryaṣṭottaraśatanāma samāptam] | saṃvat (1943) phālgunavadi (10) mī(0) guruvāraḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
[atha śrībhuvaneśvaryaṣṭakam]
śrīdevyuvāca
prabho śrībhairavaśreṣṭha dayālo bhaktavatsala | bhuvaneśīstavam brūhi yadyahantava vallabhā || 1 ||
īśvara uvāca
śṛṇu devi (!) pravakṣyāmi bhuvaneśyaṣṭakaṃ śubham | yena vijñātamātreṇa trailokyamaṅgalambhavet || 2 ||
oṃ namāmi jagadādhārāṃ bhuvaneśīṃ bhavapriyām | bhuktimuktipradāṃ ramyāṃ ramaṇīyāṃ śubhāvahām || 3 ||
tvaṃ svāhā tvaṃ svadhā devi(!) tvaṃ yajñā yajñanāyikā | tvaṃ nāthā tvaṃ tamohartrī vyāpyavyāpakavarjjitā || 4 ||
tvamādhārastvamijyā ca jñānajñeyaṃ paraṃ padam | tvaṃ śivastvaṃ svayaṃ viṣṇustvamātmā paramo'vyayaḥ || 5 ||
tvaṃ kāraṇañca kāryañca lakṣmīstvañca hutāśanaḥ | tvaṃ somastvaṃ raviḥ kālastvaṃ dhātā tvañca mārutaḥ || 6 ||
gāyatrī tvaṃ ca sāvitrī tvaṃ māyā tvaṃ haripriyā | tvamevaikā parāśaktistvameva gururūpadhṛk || 7 ||
tvaṃ kālā tvaṃ kalā'tītā tvameva jagatāṃśriyaḥ | tvaṃ sarvakāryaṃ sarvasya kāraṇaṃ karuṇāmayi(!) || 8 ||
idamaṣṭakamādyāyā bhuvaneśyā varānane | trisandhyaṃ śraddhayā martyo yaḥ paṭhet prītamānasaḥ || 9 ||
siddhayo vaśagāstasya sampado vaśagā gṛhe | rājāno vaśamāyānti stotrasyā'sya prabhāvataḥ || 10 ||
bhūtapretapiśācādyā nekṣante tāṃ diśaṃ grahāḥ | yaṃ yaṃ kāmaṃ pravāñcheta sādhakaḥ prītamānasaḥ || 11 ||
taṃ tamāpnoti kṛpayā bhuvaneśyā varānane (!) | anena sadṛśaṃ stotraṃ na samaṃ bhuvanatraye || 12 ||
sarvasampatpradamidaṃ (stotraṃ) pāvanānāñca pāvanam | anena stotravaryeṇa sādhitena varānane (!) | sampado vaśamāyānti bhuvaneśyāḥ prasādataḥ || 13 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrībhuvaneśvaryaṣṭakaṃ sampūrṇam] | saṃvat (1943) phālguna vadi (10) guruvāraḥ ||
[atha śrībhuvaneśvaryā bhakarādisahasranāma stotram]
oṃ asya śrībhuvaneśvarīsahasranāmastotramaṃtrasyasadāśiva ṛṣiḥ anuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ bhuvaneśvarī devatā lajjā bījam kamalā śaktiḥ vāgbhavaṃ kīlakam sarvārthasādhane pāṭhe viniyogaḥ ||
oṃ bhuvaneśī bhuvārādhyā bhavānī bhayanāśinī | bhavarūpā bhavānandā bhavasāgaratāriṇī || 1 ||
bhavodbhavā bhavaratā bhavabhāranivāriṇī | bhavyāsyā bhavyanayanā bhavyarūpā bhavauṣadhiḥ || 2 ||
bhavyāṅganā bhavyakeśī bhavapāśavimocinī | bhavyāsanā bhavyavastrā bhavyābharaṇabhūṣitā || 3 ||
bhagarūpā bhagānandā bhageśī bhagamālinī | bhagavidyā bhagavatī bhagaklinā bhagāvahā || 4 ||
bhagāṅkarā bhagakriḍā bhagāḍhyā bhagamaṅgalā | bhagalīlā bhagaprītā bhagasampadbhageśvarī || 5 ||
bhagālayā bhagotsāhā bhagasthā bhagapoṣiṇī | bhagotsavā bhagavidyā bhagamātā bhagasthitā || 6 ||
bhagaśaktirbhaganidhirbhagapūjā bhageṣaṇā | bhagasvāpā bhagādhiśā bhagārcyā bhagasundarī || 7 ||
bhagarekhā bhagasnehā bhagasnehavivardhinī | bhaginī bhagabījasthā bhagabhogavilāsinī || 8 ||
bhagācārā bhagādhārā bhagākārā bhagāśrayā | bhagapuṣpā bhagaśrīpā bhagapuṣpanivāsinī || 9 ||
bhavyarūpadharā bhavyā bhavyapuṣpairalaṅkṛtā | bhavyalīlā bhavyamālā bhavyāṅgi bhavyasundarī || 10 ||
bhavyaśīlā bhavyalīlā bhavyākṣī bhavyanāśinī | bhavyāṅgikā bhavyavāṇī bhavyakāntirbhagālinī || 11 ||
bhavyatrapā bhavyanadī bhavyabhogavihāriṇī | bhavyastanī bhavyamukhī bhavyagoṣṭhī bhayāpahā || 12 ||
bhakteśvarī bhaktikarī bhaktānugrahakāriṇī | bhaktidā bhaktijananī bhaktānandavivarddhinī || 13 ||
bhaktipriyā bhaktiratā bhaktibhāvavihāriṇī | bhaktiśīlā bhaktilīlā bhakteśā bhaktipālinī || 14 ||
bhaktividyā bhaktavidyā bhaktirbhaktivinodinī | bhaktirītirbhaktiprītirbhaktisādhanasādhinī || 15 ||
bhaktisādhyā bhaktasādhyā bhaktirālī bhaveśvarī | bhaṭavidyā bhaṭānandā bhaṭasthā bhaṭarūpiṇī || 16 ||
bhaṭamānyā bhaṭasthānyā bhaṭasthānanivāsinī | bhaṭinī bhaṭarūpeśī bhaṭarūpavivarddhinī || 17 ||
bhaṭaveśī bhaṭeśī ca bhaṭabhāgbhavasundarī | bhaṭaprītyā bhaṭarītyā bhaṭānugrahakāriṇī || 18 ||
bhaṭārādhyā bhaṭabodhyā bhaṭabodhavinodinī | bhaṭaiḥ sevyā bhaṭavarā bhaṭārcyā bhaṭabodhinī || 19 ||
bhaṭakīrtyā bhaṭakalā bhaṭapā bhaṭapālinī | bhaṭaiśvaryyā bhaṭādhīśā bhaṭekṣā bhaṭatoṣiṇī || 20 ||
bhaṭeśī bhaṭajananī bhaṭabhāgyavivarddhinī | bhaṭabhuktirbhaṭayuktirbhaṭaprītivivarddhinī || 21 ||
bhāgyeśī bhāgyajananī bhāgyasthā bhāgyarūpiṇī | bhāvanā bhāvakuśalā bhāvadā bhāvavarddhinī || 22 ||
bhāvarūpā bhāvarasā bhavāntaravihāriṇī | bhavāṅkarā bhavakalā bhāvasthānanivāsinī || 23 ||
bhāvāntarā bhāvadhṛtā bhāvamadhyavyavasthitā | bhāva(-)ṛddhirbhāvasiddhirbhāvādirbhāvabhāvinī || 24 ||
bhāvālayā bhāvaparā bhāvasādhanatatparā | bhāveśvarī bhāvagamyā bhāvasthā bhāvagarvitā || 25 ||
bhāvinī bhāvaramaṇī bhāratī bhārateśvarī | bhāgīrathī bhhagyavatī bhāgyodayakarī kalā || 26 ||
bhāgyāśrayā bhāgyamayī bhāgyā bhāgyaphalapradā | bhāgyācārā bhāgyasārā bhāgyadhārā ca bhāgyadā || 27 ||
bhāgyeśvarī bhāgyanidhirbhāgyā bhāgyasumātṛkā | bhāgyekṣā bhāgyanā bhāgyabhāgyadā bhāgyamātṛkā || 28 ||
bhāgyekṣā bhāgyamanasā bhāgyādirbhāgyamadhyagā | bhrātrīsvarī bhrātṛmatī bhrātrambā bhrātṛpālinī || 29 ||
bhrātṛsthā bhrātṛkuśalā bhrāmarī bhramarāmbikā | bhillarūpā bhillavatī bhillasthā bhillapālinī || 30 ||
bhillamātā bhilladhātrī bhillinī bhillakeśvarī | bhillakīrtirbhillakalā bhillamandaravāsinī || 31 ||
bhillakrīḍā bhillalīlā bhillārcyā bhillavallabhā | bhillasnuṣā bhillaputrī bhillinī bhillapoṣiṇī || 32 ||
bhillapautrī bhillagoṣṭhī bhillacāranivāsinī | bhillapūjyā bhillavāṇī bhillāṇī bhillabhītihā || 33 ||
bhītasthā bhītajananī bhītirbhītivināśinī | bhītidā bhītihā bhītyā bhītyākāravihāriṇī || 34 ||
bhīteśī bhītiśamanī bhītisthānanivāsinī | bhītirītyā bhītikalā bhītīkṣā bhītihāriṇī || 35 ||
bhīmeśī bhīmajananī bhīmā bhīmanivāsinī | bhīmeśvarī bhīmaratā bhīmāṅgī bhīmapālinī || 36 ||
bhīmanādā bhīmatantrī bhīmaiśvaryyavivarddhinī | bhīmagoṣṭhī bhīmadhātrī bhīmavidyāvinodinī || 37 ||
bhīmavikramadātrī ca bhīmavikramavāsinī | bhīmānandakarī devī bhīmānandavihāriṇī || 38 ||
bhīmopadeśinī nityā bhīmabhāgyapradāyinī | bhīmasiddhirbhīma(-)ṛddhirbhīmabhaktivivarddhinī || 39 ||
bhīmasthā bhīmavaradā bhīmadharmopadeśinī | bhīṣmeśvarī bhīṣmabhṛtirbhiṣmabodhaprabodhinī || 40 ||
bhīṣmaśrīrbhīṣmajananī bhīṣmajñānopadeśinī | bhīṣmasthā bhīṣmatapanā bhīṣmeśī bhīṣmatāriṇī || 41 ||
bhīṣmalīlā bhīṣmaśīlā bhīṣmarodhonivāsinī | bhīṣmāśrayā bhīṣmavarā bhīṣmaharṣavivarddhinī || 42 ||
bhuvanā bhuvaneśānī bhuvanānandakāriṇī | bhuvisthā bhuvirūpā ca bhuvibhāranivāriṇī || 43 ||
bhuktisthā bhuktidā bhuktirbhukteśī bhuktirūpiṇī | bhukteśvarī bhuktidātrī bhuktirākārarūpiṇī || 44 ||
bhujaṅgasthā bhujaṅgeśī bhujaṅgākārarūpiṇī | bhujaṅgī bhujagāvāsā bhujaṅgānandadāyinī || 45 ||
bhūteśī bhūtajananī bhūtasthā bhūtarūpiṇī | bhūteśvarī bhūtalīlā bhūtaveṣakarī sadā || 46 ||
bhūtadātrī bhūtakeśī bhūtadhātrī maheśvarī | bhūtarītyā bhūtapatnī bhūtalokanivāsinī || 47 ||
bhūtasiddhirbhūta(-)ṛddhirbhūtānandanivāsinī | bhūtakīrtirbhūtalakṣmīrbhūtabhāgyavivarddhinī || 48 ||
bhūtārcyā bhūtaramaṇī bhūtavidyāvinodinī | bhūtapautrī bhūtaputrī bhūtabhāryyā vidhīśvarī || 49 ||
bhūtasthā bhūtaramaṇī bhūteśī bhūtapālinī | bhūpamātā bhūpanibhā bhūpaiśvaryyapradāyinī || 50 ||
bhūpaceṣṭā bhūpaneṣṭā bhūpabhāvavivarddhinī | bhūpasvasā bhūpabhūrī bhūpapautrī tathā vadhuḥ || 51 ||
bhūpakīrtirbhūpanītirbhūpabhāgyavivarddhinī | bhūpakriyā bhūpakrīḍā bhūpamandaravāsinī || 52 ||
bhūpārcyā bhūpasaṃrādhyā bhūpabhogavivarddhinī | bhūpāśrayā bhūpakalā bhūpakautukadaṇḍinī || 53 ||
bhūṣaṇasthā bhūṣaṇeśī bhūṣā bhūṣaṇadhāriṇī | bhūṣaṇādhāradharmeśī bhūṣaṇākārarūpiṇī || 54 ||
bhūpatācāranilayā bhūpatācārabhūṣitā | bhūpatācāraracanā bhūpatācāramaṇḍitā || 55 ||
bhūpatācāradharmeśī bhūpatācārakāriṇī | bhūpatācāracaritā bhūpatācāravarjitā || 56 ||
bhūpatācāravṛddhisthā bhūpatācāravṛddhidā | bhūpatācārakaraṇā bhūpatācārakarmadā || 57 ||
bhūpatācārakarmeśī bhūpatācārakarmadā | bhūpatācāradehasthā bhūpatācārakarmiṇī || 58 ||
bhūpatācārasiddhisthā bhūpatācārasiddhidā | bhūpatācāradharmāṇī bhūpatācāradhāriṇī || 59 ||
bhūpatānandalaharī bhūpateśvararūpiṇī | bhūpaternītinītisthā bhūpatisthānavāsinī || 60 ||
bhūpatisthānagīrvāṇā bhūpatervaradhāriṇī | bheṣajānandalaharī bheṣajānandarūpiṇī || 61 ||
bheṣajānandamahiṣī bheṣajānandadhāriṇī | bheṣajānandakarmeśī bheṣajānandadāyinī || 62 ||
bheṣajī bheṣajā kandā bheṣajasthanavāsinī | bheṣajeśvararūpā ca bheṣajeśvarasiddhidā || 63 ||
bheṣajeśvaradharmeśī bheṣajeśvarakarmadā | bheṣajeśvarakarmeśī bheṣajeśvarakarmiṇī || 64 ||
bheṣajādhīśajananī bheṣajādhīśapālinī | bheṣajādhīśaracanā bheṣajādhīśamaṅgalā || 65 ||
bheṣajāraṇyamadhyasthā bheṣajāranyarakṣiṇī | bhaiṣajyavidyā bhaiṣajyā bhaiṣajyepsitadāyinī || 66 ||
bhaiṣajasthā bhaiṣajeśī bhaiṣajyānandavarddhinī | bhairavī bhairavācārā bhairavākārarūpiṇī || 67 ||
bhairavācāracaturā bhairavācāramaṇḍitā | bhairavā ca bhairaveśī bhairavānandadāyinī || 68 ||
bhairavānandarūpeśī bhairavānandarūpiṇī | bhairavānandanipuṇā bhairavānandamandirā || 69 ||
bhairavānandatatvajñā bhairavānandatatparā | bhairavānandakuśalā bhairavānandanītidā || 70 ||
bhairavānandaprītisthā bhairavānandaprītidā | bhairavānandamahiṣī bhairavānandamālinī || 71 ||
bhairavānandamatidā bhairavānandamātṛkā | bhairavādhārajananī bhairavādhārarakṣiṇī || 72 ||
bhairavādhārarūpeśī bhairavādhārarūpiṇī | bhairavādhāranicayā bhairavādhāraniścayā || 73 ||
bhairavādhāratatvajñā bhairavādhāratattvadā | bhairavāśrayatantreśī bhairavāśrayamantriṇī || 74 ||
bhairavāśrayaracanā bhairavāśrayarañjitā | bhairavāśrayanirdhārā bhairavāśrayanirbharā || 75 ||
bhairavāśrayanirdhārā bhairavāśrayanirdharā | bhairavānandabodheśī bhairavānandabodhinī || 76 ||
bhairavānandabodhasthā bhairavānandabodhadā | bhairavyaiśvaryyavaradā bhairavyaiśvaryyadāyinī || 77 ||
bhairavyaiśvaryyaracanā bhairavyaiśvaryyavarddhinī | bhairavyaiśvaryyasiddhisthā bhairavyaiśvaryyasiddhidā || 78 ||
bhairavyaiśvaryyasiddheśī bhairavyaiśvaryyarūpiṇī | bhairavyaiśvaryasupathā bhairavyaiśvaryyasuprabhā || 79 ||
bhairavyaiśvaryyavṛddhisthā bhairavyaiśvaryyavṛddhidā | bhairavyaiśvaryyakuśalā bhairavyaiśvaryyakāmadā || 80 ||
bhairavyaiśvaryyasulabhā bhairavyaiśvaryyasampradā | bhairavyaiśvaryyaviśadā bhairavyaiśvaryyavikriyā || 81 ||
bhairavyaiśvaryyavinayā bhairavyaiśvaryyaveditā | bhairavyaiśvaryyamahimā bhairavyaiśvaryyamāninī || 82 ||
bhairavyaiśvaryyaniratā bhairavyaiśvaryyanirmitā | bhogeśvarī bhogamātā bhogasthā bhogarakṣinī || 83 ||
bhogakrīḍā bhogalīlā bhogeśī bhogavarddhinī | bhogāṅgī bhogaramaṇī bhogācāravicāriṇī || 84 ||
bhogāśrayā bhogavatī bhoginī bhogarūpiṇī | bhogāṅkurā bhogavidhā bhogādhāranivāsinī || 85 ||
bhogāmbikā bhogaratā bhogasiddhividhāyinī | bhojasthā bhojaniratā bhojanānandadāyinī || 86 ||
bhojanānandalaharī bhojanāntarvihāriṇī | bhojanānandamahimā bhojanānandabhogyadā || 87 ||
bhojanānandaracanā bhojanānandaharṣitā | bhojanācāracaturā bhojanācāramaṇḍitā || 88 ||
bhojanācāracaritā bhojanācāracarcitā | bhojanācārasampannā bhojanācārasaṃyutā || 89 ||
bhojanācāracittasthā bhojanācārarītidā | bhojanācāravibhavā bhojanācāravistṛtā || 90 ||
bhojanācāraramaṇī bhojanācārarakṣiṇī | bhojanācārahariṇī bhojanācārabhakṣiṇī || 91 ||
bhojanācāra sukhadā bhojanācārasuspṛhā | bhojanāhārasurasā bhojanāhārasundarī || 92 ||
bhojanāhāracaritā bhojanāhāracañcalā | bhojanāsvādavibhavā bhojanāsvādavallabhā || 93 ||
bhojanāsvādasaṃtuṣṭā bhojanāsvādasampradā | bhojanāsvādasupathā bhojanāsvādasaṃśrayā || 94 ||
bhojanāsvādaniratā bhojanāsvādanirṇatā | bhaukṣarā bhaukṣareśānī bhaukārākṣararūpiṇī || 95 ||
bhaukṣarasthā bhaukṣarādirbhaukṣarasthānavāsinī | bhaṅkārī bharmiṇī bharmī bhasmeśī bhasmarūpiṇī || 96 ||
bhaṅkārā bhañcanā bhasmā bhasmasthā bhasmavāsinī | bhakṣarī bhakṣarākārā bhakṣarasthānavāsinī || 97 ||
bhakṣarāḍhyā bhakṣareśī bharūpā bhasvarūpiṇī | bhūdharasthā bhūdhareśī bhūdharī bhūdhareśvarī || 98 ||
bhūdharānandaramaṇī bhūdharānandapālinī | bhūdharānandajananī bhudharānandavāsinī || 99 ||
bhūdharānandaramaṇī bhūdharānandarakṣitā | bhūdharānandamahimā bhūdharānandamandirā || 100 ||
bhūdharānandasarveśī bhūdharānandasarvasūḥ | bhūdharānandamahiṣī bhūdharānandadāyinī || 101 ||
bhūdharādhīśadharmeśī bhūdharānandadharmiṇī | bhūdharādhīśadharmeśī bhūdharādhīśasiddhidā || 102 ||
bhūdharādhīśakarmeśī bhūdharādhīśakāminī | bhūdharādhīśaniratā bhūdhārādhīśanirṇitā || 103 ||
bhūdharādhīśanītisthā bhūdharādhīśanītidā | bhūdharādhīśabhāgyeśī bhūdharādhīśabhāminī || 104 ||
bhūdharādhīśabuddhisthā bhūdharādhīśabuddhidā | bhūdharādhīśavaradā bhūdharādhīśavanditā || 105 ||
bhūdharādhīśasaṃrādhyā bhūdharādhīśacarcitā | bhaṅgeśvarī bhaṅgamayī bhaṅgasthā bhaṅgarūpiṇī || 106 ||
bhaṅgākṣatā bhaṅgaratā bhaṅgārcyā bhaṅgarakṣiṇī | bhaṅgāvatī bhaṅgalīlā bhaṅgabhogavilāsinī || 107 ||
bhaṅgāraṅgapratīkāśā bhaṅgāraṅganivāsinī | bhaṅgāśinī bhaṅgamūlī bhaṅgabhogavidhāyinī || 108 ||
bhaṅgāśrayā bhaṅgabījā bhaṅgabījāṅkureśvarī | bhaṅgayaṃtracamatkārā bhaṅgayaṃtreśvarī tathā || 109 ||
bhaṅgayaṃtravimohasthā bhaṅgayaṃtravinodinī | bhaṅgayaṃtravicārasthā bhaṅgayaṃtravicāriṇī || 110 ||
bhaṅgayaṃtrarasānandā bhaṅgayaṃtraraseśvarī | bhaṅgayaṃtrarasasvādā bhaṅgayaṃtrarasasthitā || 111 ||
bhaṅgayaṃtrarasādhārā bhaṅgayaṃtrarasāśrayā | bhūdharātmajarūpeśī bhūdharātmajarūpiṇī || 112 ||
bhūdharātmajayogeśī bhūdharātmajapālinī | bhūdharātmajamahimā bhūdharātmajamālinī || 113 ||
bhūdharātmajabhūteśī bhūdharātmajarūpiṇī | bhūdharātmajasiddhisthā bhūdharātmajasiddhidā || 114 ||
bhūdharātmajabhāveśī bhūdharātmajabhāvinī | bhūdharātmajabhogasthā bhūdharātmajabhogyadā || 115 ||
bhūdharātmajabhogeśī bhūdharātmajabhoginī | bhavyā bhavyatarā bhavyabhāvinī bhavavallabhā || 116 ||
bhāvātibhāvā bhāvākhyā bhātibhā bhītibhāntikā | bhāsātibhāsā bhāsasthā bhāsābhā bhāskaropamā || 117 ||
bhāskarasthā bhāskareśī bhāskaraiśvaryyavarddhinī | bhāskarānandajananī bhāskarānandadāyinī || 118 ||
bhāskarānandamahimā bhāskārānandamātṛkā | bhāskarānandanaiśvaryyā bhāskarānandaneśvarā || 119 ||
bhāskarānandasupathā bhāskarānandasuprabhā | bhāskarānandanicayā bhāskarānandanirmitā || 120 ||
bhāskarānandanītisthā bhāskarānandanītidā | bhāskarodayamadhyasthā bhāskarodayamadhyagā || 121 ||
bhāskarodayatejaḥsthā bhāskarodayatejasā | bhāskarācāracaturā bhāskarācāracandrikā || 122 ||
bhāskarācāraparamā bhāskarācāracaṇḍikā | bhāskarācāraparamā bhāskarācārapāradā || 123 ||
bhāskarācāramuktisthā bhāskarācāramuktidā | bhāskarācārasiddhisthā bhāskarācārasiddhidā || 124 ||
bhāskarācaraṇādhārā bhāskarācaraṇāśritā | bhāskarācāramantreśī bhāskarācāramantriṇī || 125 ||
bhāskarācāravitteśī bhāskarācāracitriṇī | bhāskarādhāradharmmeśī bhāskarādhāradhāriṇī || 126 ||
bhāskarādhāraracanā bhāskarādhārarakṣitā | bhāskarādhārakarmāṇī bhāskarākarmmadā || 127 ||
bhāskarādhārarūpeśī bhāskarādhārarūpiṇī | bhāskarādhārakāmyeśī bhāskarādhārakāminī || 128 ||
bhāskarādhārasāṃśeśī bhāskarādhārasāṃśinī | bhāskarādhāradharmeśī bhāskarādhāradhāminī || 129 ||
bhāskarādhāracakrasthā bhāskarādhāracakriṇī | bhāskareśvarakṣetreśī bhāskareśvarakṣetriṇī || 130 ||
bhāskareśvarajananī bhāskareśvarapālinī | bhāskareśvarasarveśī bhāskareśvaraśarvarī || 131 ||
bhāskareśvarasadbhīmā bhāskareśvarasannibhā | bhāskareśvarasupathā bhāskareśvarasuprabhā || 132 ||
bhāskareśvarayuvatī bhāskareśvarasundarī | bhāskareśvaramūrteśī bhāskareśvaramūrtinī || 133 ||
bhāskareśvaramitreśī bhāskareśvaramantriṇī | bhāskareśvarasānandā bhāskareśvarasāśrayā || 134 ||
bhāskareśvaracitrasthā bhāskareśvaracitradā | bhāskareśvaracitreśī bhāskareśvaracitriṇī || 135 ||
bhāskareśvarabhāgyasthā bhāskareśvarabhāgyadā | bhāskareśvarabhhāgyeśī bhāskareśvarabhāvinī || 136 ||
bhāskareśvarakīrtīśī bhāskareśvarakīrtinī | bhāskareśvarakīrtisthā bhāskareśvarakīrtidā || 137 ||
bhāskareśvarakaruṇā bhāskareśvarakāriṇī | bhāskareśvaragīrvāṇī bhāskareśvaragāruḍī || 138 ||
bhāskareśvaradehasthā bhāskareśvaradehadā | bhāskareśvaranādasthā bhāskareśvaranādinī || 139 ||
bhāskareśvaranādeśī bhāskareśvaranādinī | bhāskareśvarakośasthā bhāskareśvarakośadā || 140 ||
bhāskareśvarakośeśī bhāskareśvarakośadā | bhāskareśvaraśaktisthā bhāskareśvaraśaktidā || 141 ||
bhāskareśvaratoṣeśī bhāskareśvaratoṣiṇī | bhāskareśvarakṣatreśī bhāskareśvarakṣatriṇī || 142 ||
bhāskareśvarayogasthā bhāskareśvarayogadā | bhāskareśvarayogeśī bhāskareśvarayoginī || 43 ||
bhāskareśvarapadmeśī bhāskareśvarapadminī | bhāskareśvarahṛdbījā bhāskareśvarahṛdvarā || 44 ||
bhāskereśvarahṛdyonirbhāskareśvarahṛddyutiḥ | bhāskareśvarabuddhisthā bhāskareśvarasadvidhā || 45 ||
bhāskareśvarasadvāṇī bhāskareśvarasadvarā | bhāskareśvararājyasthā bhāskareśvararājyadā || 146 ||
bhāskareśvararājyeśī bhāskareśvarapoṣiṇī | bhāskareśvarajñānasthā bhāskareśvarajñānadā || 147 ||
bhāskareśvarajñāneśī bhāskareśvaragāminī | bhāskareśvaralakṣeśī bhāskareśvaralakṣitā || 148 ||
bhāskareśvarakṣālitā bhāskareśvararakṣitā | bhāskareśvarakhaḍgasthā bhāskareśvarakhaḍgadā || 149 ||
bhāskareśvarakhaḍgeśī bhāskareśvarakhaḍginī | bhāskareśvarakāryyeśī bhāskareśvarakāminī || 150 ||
bhāskareśvarakāyasthā bhāskareśvarakāyadā | bhāskareśvaracakṣuḥsthā bhāskareśvaracakṣuṣā || 151 ||
bhāskareśvarasannābhā bhāskareśvarasārcitā | bhrūṇahatyāpraśamanī bhrūṇapāpavināśinī || 152 ||
bhrūṇadrāridryaśamanī bhrūṇarogavināśinī | bhrūṇaśokapraśamanī bhrūṇadoṣanivāriṇī || 153 ||
bhrūṇasaṃtāpaśamanī bhrūṇavibhramanāśinī | bhavābdhisthā bhavābdhīśā bhavābdhibhayanāśinī || 154 ||
bhavābdhipārakaraṇī bhavābdhisukhavarddhinī | bhavābdhikāryyakaraṇī bhavābdhikaruṇānidhiḥ || 155 ||
bhavābdhikālaśamanī bhavābdhivaradāyinī | bhavābdhibhajanasthānā bhavābdhibhajanasthitā || 156 ||
bhavābdhibhajanākārā bhavābdhibhajanakriyā | bhavābdhibhajanācārā bhavābdhibhajanāṅkurā || 157 ||
bhavābdhibhajanānandā bhavābdhibhajanādhipā | bhavābdhibhajanaiśvaryā bhavābdhibhajabhajaneśvarī || 158 ||
bhavābdhibhajanāsiddhirbhavābdhibhajanāratiḥ | bhavābdhibhajanānityā bhavābdhibhajanāniśā || 159 ||
bhavābdhibhajanānimnā bhavābdhibhavabhītihā | bhavābdhibhajanā kāmyā bhavābdhibhajanākalā || 160 ||
bhavābdhibhajanākīrtirbhavābdhibhajanākṛtā | bhavābdhiśubhadānityā bhavābdhiśubhadāyinī || 161 ||
bhavābdhisakalānandā bhavābdhisakalākalā | bhavābdhisakalāsiddhirbhavābdhisakalā nidhiḥ || 162 ||
bhavābdhisakalāsārā bhavābdhisakalārthadā | bhavābdhibhavanāmūrtirbhavābdhibhavanākṛtiḥ || 163 ||
bhavābdhibhavanā bhavyā bhavābdhibhavanāmbhasā | bhavābdhimadanārūpā bhavābdhimadanāturā || 164 ||
bhavābdhimadaneśānī bhavābdhimadaneśvarī | bhavābdhibhāgyaracanā bhavābdhibhāgyadā sadā || 165 ||
bhavābdhibhāgyadākālā bhavābdhibhāgyanirbharā | bhavābdhibhāgyaniratā bhavābdhibhāgyabhāvitā || 166 ||
bhavābdhibhāgyasaṃcārā bhavābdhibhāgyasaṃcitā | bhavābdhibhāgyasupathā bhavābdhibhāgyasupradā || 167 ||
bhavābdhibhāgyarītijñā bhavābdhibhāgyanītidā | bhavābdhibhāgyarītīśī bhavābdhibhāgyarītinī || 168 ||
bhavābdhibhoganipuṇā bhavābdhibhogasampradā | bhavābdhibhāgyagahanā bhavābdhibhogagumphitā || 169 ||
bhavābdhibhogagāndhārī bhavābdhibhogagumphitā | bhavābdhibhogasurasā bhavābdhibhogasuspṛhā || 170 ||
bhavābdhibhogagraṃthinī bhavābdhibhogayoginī | bhavābdhibhogarasanā bhavābdhibhogarājitā || 171 ||
bhavābdhibhogavibhavā bhavābdhibhogavistṛtā | bhavābdhibhogavaradā bhavābdhibhogavanditā || 172 ||
bhavābdhibhogakuśalā bhavābdhibhogaśobhitā | bhavābdhibhedajananī bhavābdhibhedapālinī || 173 ||
bhavābdhibhedaracanā bhavābdhibhedarakṣitā | bhavābdhibhedaniyatā bhavābdhibhedaniḥspṛhā || 174 ||
bhavābdhibhedaracanā bhavābdhibhedaropitā | bhavābdhibhedarāśighnī bhavābdhibhedarāśinī || 175 ||
bhavābdhibhedakarmeśī bhavābdhibhedakarmiṇī | bhadreśī bhadrajananī bhadrā bhadranivāsinī || 176 ||
bhadreśvarī bhadravatī bhadrasthā bhadradāyinī | bhadrarūpā bhadramayī bhadradā bhadrabhāṣiṇī || 177 ||
bhadrakarṇā bhadraveṣā bhadrāmbā bhadramandirā | bhadrakriyā bhadrakalā bhadrikā bhadravarddhinī || 178 ||
bhadrākrīḍā bhadrakalā bhadralīlā'bhilāṣiṇī | bhadrāṅkarā bhadraratā bhadrāṅgī bhadramaṃtriṇī || 179 ||
bhadravidyā'bhadravidyā bhadravāgbhadravādinī | bhūpamaṅgaladā bhūpā bhūlatā bhūmivāhinī || 180 ||
bhūpabhogā bhūpaśobhā bhūpāśā bhūparūpadā | bhūpākṛtirbhūparatirbhūpaśrīrbhūpaśreyasī || 181 ||
bhūpanītirbhūparītirbhūpabhītirbhayaṅkarī | bhavadānandalaharī bhavadānandasundarī || 182 ||
bhavadānandakaraṇī bhavadanandavarddhinī | bhavadānandaramaṇī bhavadānandadāyinī || 183 ||
bhavadānandajananī bhavadānandarūpiṇī | ya idaṃ paṭhate stotraṃ pratyahaṃ bhaktisaṃyutaḥ || 184 ||
gurubhaktiyuto bhūtvā gurusevāparāyaṇaḥ | jitendriyaḥ satyavādī tāmbūlapūritānanaḥ || 185 ||
divārātrau ca sandhyāyāṃ sa bhavet parameśvaraḥ | stavamātrasya pāṭhena rājā vaśyo bhaved dhruvam || 186 ||
sarvāgameṣu vijñāni sarvatantre svayaṃ haraḥ | gurormukhāt samabhyasya sthitvā ca gurusannidhau || 187 ||
śivasthāneṣu sandhyāyāṃ śūnyāgāre catuṣpathe | yaḥ paṭhecchaṛṇuyādvāpi sa yogī nātra saṃśayaḥ || 188 ||
sarvasvadakṣiṇāṃ dadyātstrīputrādikameva ca | svachandamānaso bhūtvā stavamenaṃ samuddharet || 189 ||
etatstotrarato devi hararūpo na saṃśayaḥ | yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi ekacittena sarvadā || 190 ||
sa dīrghāyuḥ sukhī vāgmī vāṇī tasya na saṃśayaḥ | gurupādarato bhūtvā kāminīnāṃ bhavet priyaḥ || 191 ||
dhanavānguṇavān śrīmān dhīmāniva guruḥ priye | sarveṣāṃ tu priyo bhūtvā pūjayet sarvadā stavam || 192 ||
maṃtrasiddhiḥ karasthaiva tasya devi na saṃśayaḥ | kuberatvaṃ bhavet tasya tasyādhīnā hi siddhayaḥ || 193 ||
mṛtaputrā ca yā nārī daurbhāgyaparipīḍitā | vandhyā vā kākavandhyā vā mṛtavatsā ca yā'ṅganā || 194 ||
dhanadhānyavihīnā ca rogaśokākulā ca yā | tābhiretanmahādevi bhūrjapatre vilikhya vai || 195 ||
savye bhuje dhāraṇīyaṃ tena saukhyapradaṃ bhavet | evaṃ punaḥ punaryāyādduḥkhena paripīḍitā || 196 ||
sabhāyāṃ vyasane vāṇīvivāde śatrusaṅkaṭe | caturaṅge tathā yuddhe sarvatrāpadi pīḍane || 197 ||
smaraṇādasya kalyāṇī saṃśayā yānti dūrataḥ | na deyaṃ paraśiṣyāya nābhaktāya ca durjane || 198 ||
dāmbhikāya kuśīlāya kṛpaṇāya sureśvarī | dadyācchiṣyāya śāntāya vinītāya jitātmane || 199 ||
bhaktāya śāntiyuktāya rajaḥpūjāratāya ca | janmāntarasahasraistu varṇituṃ naiva śakyate || 200 ||
stavamātrasya māhātmyaṃ vaktrakoṭiśatairapi | viṣṇave kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ brahmaṇāpi priyaṃvade || 201 ||
adhunāpi tava snehāt kathitaṃ parameśvari | gopitavyaṃ paśubhyaśca sarvathā na prakāśayet || 202 ||
[iti mahātantrārṇave īśvarapārvatīsaṃvādebhuvaneśvarībhakārādisahasranāma stotraṃ samāptam] |
[śrībhuvaneśvarīhṛdayastotram ]
śrīdevyuvāca(-)
bhagavan brūhi tatstotraṃ sarvakāmaprasādhanam | yasya śravaṇamātreṇa nānyacchrotavyamiṣyate || 1 ||
yadi me'nugrahaḥ kāryaḥ prītiścāpi mamopari | tadidaṃ kathaya brahman vimalaṃ yanmahītale || 2 ||
īśvara uvāca(-)
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi sarvakāmaprasādhanam | hṛdayaṃ bhuvaneśvaryāḥ stotramasti yaśaḥpradam || 3 ||
oṃ asya śrībhuvaneśvarīhṛdayastotramaṃtrasya śaktir(-)ṛṣiḥ gāyatrī chandaḥ bhuvaneśvarī devatā hakāro bījam īkāraḥ śaktiḥ rephaḥ khīlakam sakalamanovāñchitasiddhyarthe pāṭhe viniyogaḥ ||
oṃ hrīṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ (1) oṃ śrīṃ śirase svāha (2) oṃ aiṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ (3) oṃ hrīṃ kavacāya huṃ (4) oṃ śrīṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ (5) oṃ aiṃ astrāya phaṭ | iti hṛdyādiṣaḍaṅganyāsaḥ |
oṃ hrīṃ aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ (1) oṃ śrīṃ tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ (2) oṃ aiṃ madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ (3) oṃ hrīṃ anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ (4) oṃ śrīṃ kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ (5) oṃ aiṃ karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ (6) | iti karanyāsaḥ ||
atha dhyānam
dhyāyed brahmādikānāṃ kṛtajanijananīṃ yoginīṃ yogayoniṃ devānāṃ jīvanāyojjvalitajayaparajyotirugrāṅgadhātrīm | śaṃkhaṃ cakraṃ ca bāṇaṃ dhanurapi dadhatīṃ doścatuṣkāmbujātai(-) rmāyāmādyāṃ viśiṣṭāṃ bhavabhavabuvanāṃ bhūbhuvābhārabhūmim || 4 ||
yadājñayedaṃ gaganādyaśeṣaṃ sṛjatyajaḥ śrīpatiraurasaṃ vā | bibharti saṃharti bhavastadante bhajāmahe śribhuvaneśvarīṃ tām || 5 ||
jagajjanānandakarīṃ jayākhyāṃ yaśasvinīṃ yaṃtrasuyajñayonim | jitāmitāmitrakṛtaprapañcāṃ bhajāmahe śrībhuvaneśvarīṃ tām || 6 ||
harau prasupte bhuvanatrayānte avātarannābhijapadmajanmā | vidhistato'ndhe vidadhāra yatpadaṃ bhajāmahe śrībhuvaneśvarīṃ tām || 7 ||
na vidyate kvāpi tu janma yasyā na vā sthitiḥ sāntatikīha yasyāḥ | na vā nirodhe'khilakarmma yasyā bhajāmahe śrībhuvaneśvarīṃ tām || 8 ||
kaṭākṣamokṣācaraṇogravittā niveśitārṇā karuṇārdracittā | subhaktaye eti samīpsitaṃ yā bhajāmahe śrībhuvaneśvarīṃ tām || 9 ||
yato jagajjanma babhūva yonestadeva madhye pratipāti yā vā | tadatti yā'nte'khilamugrakālī bhajāmahe śrībhuvaneśvarīṃ tām || 10 ||
suṣuptikāle janamadhyayantyā yayā janaḥ svapnamavaiti kiñcit | prabudhyate jāgrati jīva eṣa bhajāmahe śrībhuvaneśvarīṃ tām || 11 ||
dayāsphuratkorakaṭākṣalābhānnaikatra yasyāḥ pralabhanti siddhāḥ | kavitvamīśitvamapi svataṃtrā bhajāmahe śrībhuvaneśvarīṃ tām || 12 ||
lasanmukhāmbhoruhamutsphuraṃtaṃ hṛdi praṇidhyāya diśi sphuraṃtaḥ | yasyāḥ kṛpārdraṃ pravikāśayaṃti bhajāmahe śrībhuvaneśvarīṃ tām || 13 ||
yadānurāgānugatālicitrāściraṃtanapremapariplutāṅgāḥ | sunirbhayāḥ santi pramudya yasyāḥ bhajāmahe śrībhuvaneśvarīṃ tām || 14 ||
harirvirañcirhara īśitāraḥ puro'vatiṣṭhaṃti prapannabhaṅgāḥ | yasyāḥ samicchanti sadānukūlyaṃ bhajāmahe śrībhuvaneśvarīṃ tām || 15 ||
manuṃ yadīyaṃ haramagnisaṃsthaṃ tataśca vāmaśruticandrasaktam | japanti ye syurhi suvaṃditāste bhajāmahe śrībhuvaneśvarīṃ tām || 16 ||
prasīdatu premarasārdracittā sadā hi sā śrībhuvaneśvarī me | kṛpākaṭākṣeṇa kuberakalpā bhavaṃti yasyāḥ padabhaktibhājaḥ || 17 ||
mudā supāṭhyaṃ bhuvaneśvarīyaṃ sadā satāṃ stotramidaṃ susevyam | sukhapradaṃ syātkalikalmaṣaghnam suśṛṇvatāṃ saṃpaṭhatāṃ praśasyam || 18 ||
etattu hṛdayaṃ stotraṃ paṭhedyastu samāhitaḥ | bhavet tasyeṣṭadā devī prasannā bhuvaneśvarī || 19 ||
dadāti dhanamāyuṣyaṃ puṇyaṃ puṇyamatiṃ tathā | naiṣṭhikīṃ devabhaktiṃ ca gurubhaktiṃ viśeṣataḥ || 20 ||
pūrṇimāyāṃ caturddaśyāṃ kujavāre viśeṣataḥ | paṭhanīyamidaṃ stotraṃ devasadmani yatnataḥ || 21 ||
yatra kutrāpi pāṭhena stotrasyāsya phalaṃ bhavet | sarvasthāneṣu deveśyāḥ pūtadehaḥ sadā paṭhet || 22 ||
[iti nīlasarasvatītantre bhuvaneśvarīpaṭale śrīdevīśvarasaṃvāde śrībhuvaneśvarīhṛdayastotraṃ samāptam] ||
[atha śrībhuvaneśvarīstotram]
athānandamayīṃ sākṣācchabdabrahmasvarūpiṇīm | īḍe sakalasampatyai jagatkāraṇamambikām || 1 ||
ādyāmaśeṣajananīmaravindayonerviṣṇoḥ śivasya ca vapuḥpratipādayitrīm | sṛṣṭisthitikṣayakarīṃ jagatāṃ trayāṇāṃ stutvā giraṃ vimalayāmyahamambike(!) tvām || 2 ||
pṛthvyā jalena śikhinā marutāṃ vareṇa hotrendunā dinakareṇa ca mūrtibhājaḥ | devasya manmathariporapiśaktimattāhetustvameva khalu parvatarājaputri (!) || 3 ||
trisrotasaḥ sakaladevasamarccitāyā vaiśiṣṭyakāraṇamavaimi tadeva mātaḥ | tvatpādapaṅkajaparāgapavitritāsu śambhorjaṭāsu satataṃ parivartanaṃ yat || 4 ||
ānandayet kumudinīmadhipaḥ kalānāṃ nānyāminaḥ kamalinīmatha netarāṃ vā | ekatra modanavidhau parame ka īṣṭe tvantu prapañcamabhinandayasi svadṛṣṭyā || 5 ||
ādyā'pyaśeṣajagatāṃ navayauvanā'si śailādhirājatanayā'pyatikomalā'si | trayyāḥprasūrapi tathā na samīkṣitā'si dhyeyā'si gauri (!) manaso na pathi sthitā'si || 6 ||
āsādya janma manujeṣu cirāddurāpaṃ tatrāpi pāṭavamavāpya nijendriyāṇām | nābhyarcayanti jagatāṃ janayitri (!) ye tvāṃ niḥśreṇikāgramadhiruhya punaḥ patanti || 7 ||
karpūracūrṇahimavāriviloḍitena ye candanena kusumaiśca sugandhigandhaiḥ | ārādhayanti hi bhavāni (!) samutsukāstvāṃ te khalvaśeṣabhuvanādhibhuvaḥ prathante || 8 ||
āviśya madhyapadavīṃ prathame saroje suptāhirājasadṛśī viracayya viśvam | vidyullatāvalayavibhramamudvahantī padmāni pañca vidalayya samaśnuvānā || 9 ||
tannirgatāmṛtarasaiḥ pariṣiktagātramārgeṇa tena nilayaṃ punarapyavāptā | yeṣāṃ hṛdi sphurasi jātu na te bhaveyurmātarmaheśvarakuṭumbini (!) garbhabhājaḥ || 10 ||
ālambikuṇḍalabharāmabhirāmavaktrāmāpīvarastanataṭīṃ tanuvṛttamadhyām | cintākṣasūtrakalaśālikhitāḍhyahastāmāvartayāmi manasā tava gauri (!) mūrtim || 11 ||
āsthāya yogamavajitya ca vairiṣaṭkamābaddhya cendriyagaṇaṃ manasi prasanne | pāśāṅkuśābhayavarāḍhyakarāṃ suvaktrāmālokayanti bhuvaneśvari (!) yoginastvām || 12 ||
uttaptahāṭakanibhākaribhiścaturbhirāvartitāmṛtaghaṭairabhiṣicyamānā | hastadvayena naline rucire vahantī padmā'pi sā'bhayavarā bhavasi tvameva || 13 ||
aṣṭābhirugravividhāyudhavāhinībhirdorvallarībhiradhiruhya mṛgādhirājam | dūrvādaladyutiramartyavipakṣapakṣān nyakkurvatī tvamasi devi(!) bhavāni(!) durgā || 14 ||
āvirnidāghajalaśīkaraśobhivaktrāṃ guñjāphalena parikalpitahārayaṣṭim | pītāṃśukāmasitakāntimanaṅgatandrāmādyāṃ pulindataruṇīmasakṛt smarāmi || 15 ||
haṃsairgatikvaṇitanūpuradūradṛṣṭe mūrtairivārthavacanairanugamyamānau | padmāvivordhvamukharūḍhasujātanālau śrīkaṇṭhapatni (!) śirasā vidadhe tavāṅghrī || 16 ||
dvābhyāṃ samīkṣitumatṛptimateva dṛgbhyāmutpāṭya bhālanayanaṃ vṛṣaketanena | sāndrānurāgataralena nirīkṣyamāṇe jañghe śubhe api bhavāni(!) tavānato'smi || 17 ||
ūrū smarāmi jitahastikarāvalepau sthaulyena mārdavatayā paribhūtarambhau | śroṇībharasya sahanau parikalpya dattaustambhāvivāṅga vayasā tava madhyamena || 18 ||
śroṇyaustanau ca yugapat prathayiṣyatoccairbālyātpareṇa vayasā parihṛṣṭasārau | romāvalīvilasitena vibhāvya mūrtiṃ madhyaṃ tava sphuratu me hṛdayasya madhye || 19 ||
sakhyaḥ smarasya haranetrahutāśaśāntyai lāvaṇyavāribharitaṃ navayauvanena | āpādya dattamiva pallavamapraviṣṭaṃ nābhiṃ kadāpi tava devi(!) na vismareyam || 20 ||
īśe'pi gehapiśunaṃ bhasitaṃ dadhāne kāśmīrakarddamamanustanapaṅkaje te | snātotthitasya kariṇaḥ kṣaṇalakṣyaphenau sindūritau smarayataḥ samadasya kumbhau || 21 ||
kaṇṭhātiriktagaladujjvalakāntidhārāśobhau bhujau nijaripokarmakaradhvajena | kaṇṭhagrahāya racitau kila dīrghapāśau mātarmama smṛtipathaṃ na vilaṅghayetām || 22 ||
nātyāyataṃ racitakambuvilāsacauryaṃ bhūṣābhareṇa vividhena virājamānam | kaṇṭhaṃ manoharaguṇaṃ girirājakanye(!) sañcintya tṛptimupayāmi kadāpi nāham || 23 ||
atyāyatākṣamabhijātalalāṭapaṭṭam mandasmitena daraphullakapolarekham | bimbādharaṃ vadanamunnatadīrghanāsaṃ yaste smaratyasakṛdamba(!) sa eva jātaḥ || 24 ||
āvistuṣārakaralekhamanalpagandhapuṣpoparibhramadalivrajanirviśeṣam | yaścetasā kalayate tava keśapāśaṃ tasya svayaṃ galati devi purāṇapāśaḥ || 25 ||
śrutisucaritapākaṃ śrīmatāṃ stotrametat paṭhati ya iha martyo nityamārdrāntarātmā | sa bhavati padamuccaiḥ sampadāṃ pādanamrakṣitipamukuṭalakṣmīlakṣaṇānāṃ cirāya || 26 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrībhuvaneśvarīstotraṃ samāptam] |
[atha śrīpṛthvīdharācāryapaddhatau ]
[śrībhuvaneśvarīkramacandrikā]
|| śrīḥ ||
citprakāśaṃ guruṃ vande paramānandavigraham | kriyate svaprakāśena bhuvaneśīkramaṃ mahat || 1 ||
atha mantrī brāhme muhūrte cotthāya svaśirasi śrīgurucaraṇāravindaṃ dhyātvā(##-)
praśāsmahe namovākamākāśānandamūrtaye | śivāya karuṇārdrāya gururūpamupeyuṣe || 2 ||
svaprakāśavimarśākhyabījāṅkuralatāṃ parām | śṛṅgārapīṭhanilayāṃ vande śrībhuvaneśvarīm || 3 ||
brāhme muhūrte cotthāya brahmarandhre sitāmbuje | ciccandramaṇḍale śuddhe sphaṭikābhaṃ varābhaye || 4 ||
dadhānaṃ raktayā śaktyā śliṣṭaṃ vāmāṅkasaṃsthayā | dhārayantyotpalaṃ dīrghaṃ netratrayavibhuṣitam || 5 ||
prasannavadanaṃ śāntaṃ smarettannāmapūrvakam | raktaśuklātmakaṃ tasya saṃsmṛtya caraṇadvayam || 6 ||
guruñca gurupatnīñca devaṃ devīṃ vibhāvayet | pādukāmantramuccārya yathāsvagururuktitaḥ || 7 ||
tattanmudrānvitairgandhādyupacāraiḥ prapūjayet |
tadyathā(-) laṃ pṛthivyātmane paramātmane gandhatanmātraprakṛtyātmane śrīgurunāthāya gandhaṃ samarpayāmi kaniṣṭhayoḥ | haṃ ākāśātmane paramātmane śabdatanmātraprakṛtyātmane śrīgurunāthāya puṣpaṃ samarpayāmi aṅguṣṭhayoḥ | yaṃ vāyavyātmane paramātmane sparśatanmātraprakṛtyātmane śrīgurunāthāya dhūpaṃ samarpayāmi tarjanyoḥ | raṃ agnyātmane paramātmane rūpatanmātraprakṛtyātmane śrīgurunāthāya dīpaṃ samarpayāmi madhyamayoḥ | vaṃ abātmane paramātmane
rasatanmātraprakṛtyātmane śrīgurunāthāya naivedyaṃ samarpayāmi anāmikayoḥ | saṃ śaktyātmane paramātmane sarvatanmātraprakṛtyātmane śrīgurunāthāya tāmbulaṃ samarpayāmi karasampuṭayorityupacāraiḥ śrīgurunāthaṃ sampūjya prārthayet (-)
prātaḥ prabhṛti sāyāntaṃ sāyādi prātarantataḥ | yatkaromi jagannātha(!) tadastu tava pūjanam ||
ityuktarītyā svaguruṃ tannāmapūrvakaṃ praṇamya tadyathā (-) aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ amukānandanāthasaṃvidaṃ vā śaktiyuktaśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi nama iti namaskṛtya (-)
herambaṃ kṣetrapālañca vāgiśaṃ vaṭukaṃ tathā | śrīguruṃ nāthamānandaṃ bhairavaṃ bharavīṃ parām ||
iti krameṇa gurupādukāstotraṃ paṭhitvā (-)
tasyai diśe satatamañjalireṣa pauṣpaḥ prakṣipyate mukharito bhramarairdvirephaiḥ | jāgarti yatra bhagavān gurucakravarttī viśvodayapralayanāṭakanityasākṣī ||
iti pañcamudrābhirnamaskṛtya mūlavidyāṃ dhyāyet | tadyathā(-)
mūlādibrahmarandhrāntaṃ saṃsmarennijadevatām | sūryakoṭipratīkāśāṃ candrakoṭisuśītalām || udyaddivākaradyotāṃ yāvachvāsaṃ dṛḍhāsanaḥ | dhyātvā tadaikarasyena kañcit kālaṃ sukhī bhavet ||
ityuktarītyā mūlavidyāṃ vibhāvyaṃ ajapāsaṃkalpaṃ kuryāt | tadyathā(-) asya śrī(-)ajapānāmagāyatrīmantrasya haṃsa ṛṣiḥ paramahaṃso devatā avyaktagāyatrī chandaḥ haṃ bījam saḥ śaktiḥ so'haṃ kīlakam praṇavastatvam nādaḥ sthānam udāttaḥ svaraḥ śveto varṇaḥ mama samastapāpakṣayārthaṃ svasvarūpasaṃvitprāptyarthamadyāhorātramadhye śvāsocchvāsarūpeṇa ṣaṭśatādhikamekaviṃśatisahasramajapānāma gāyatrījapamahaṃ kariṣya iti saṃkalpya haṃsaḥ so'hamiti mantreṇa prāṇāyāmaṃ karaśuddhiṃ ṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ kuryāt | hsāṃ sūryātmane hṛdayāya namaḥ aṅguṣṭhayoḥ |
