aiṃ kāmeśvarīṃ vidmahe hrīṃ bhuvaneśvarīṃ dhīmahi tannaḥ śaktiḥ pracodayāt | udyadādityavartinyai śrībhuvaneśvaryai idamarghyaṃ samarpayāmi nama ityarghyatrayaṃ datvā yathāśaktivāraṃ gāyatrīṃ tarpayet | punaḥ pūrvavadācamya mūlena prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ pūrvavannyāsaṃ vidhāya gāyatrīṃ dhyāyet |
tato japan maheśānīmādhāre kuṅkumaprabhām | madhyāhne hṛdayāmbhoje cintayeccandrasannibhām || dhyāyecca śiraso madhye tamālaśyāmalaśriyam ||
iti dhyātvā pūrvoktagāyatrīmaṣṭottaraśatavāraṃ japitvā punaḥ ṣaḍaṅganyāsadhyānaṃ vidhāya guhyātiguhyamiti japaṃ ṣaḍadhvavyāpinyai devatāyai samarpayet | evamuktakālatraye'pi mārjanādyarghyāntaṃ kuryāt | tataḥ prātaḥsandhyānantaraṃ saurapūjāṃ kuryāt | tadyathā(-) bhūmau gomayena caturaśraṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā tatra raktacandanenāṣṭadalaṃ viracya madhye divaseśvaraṃ māyābījasahitaṃ vinyasya daleṣu somādīn vinyasya pūjayet | tadyathā(-) hrīṃ sūryāya namo madhye daleṣu hrīṃ somāya namaḥ hrīṃ bhaumāya namaḥ hrīṃ budhāya namaḥ hrīṃ gurave namaḥ hrīṃ bhārgavāya namaḥ hrīṃ mandāya namaḥ hrīṃ rāhave namaḥ hrīṃ ketave nama iti sampūjyārghyapātre candanākṣatakusumāni nikṣipya ṣaḍdīrghamāyābījena ṣaḍaṅgaṃ kṛtvā divaseśvaraṃ dhyāyet |
ratnāṅkaṃ svarṇakoṭiṃ ca kaṭakādivibhūṣitam | svarṇaṃ lambodaraṃ śoṇaṃ cārupadmakaradvayam ||
iti dhyātvā sūryamantreṇārghyatrayaṃ dadyāt | tatra sūryamantraḥ(-) oṃ hrīṃ haṃsaḥ sūryāya nama ityarghyatrayaṃ datvā lalāṭamadhyagamādityaṃ bindurūpeṇa bhāvayet | itthaṃ saurapūjāṃ vidhāya tarpaṇaṃ kuryāt | tadyathā(##-)
jalāntike samupaviśya pādau pāṇiṃ prakṣālyācamya jalamadhye yantraṃ vibhāvya pūrvavadaṅkuśamudrayā tīrthaṃ sūryamaṇḍalādākṛṣyāvāhanādimudrāḥ pradarśya mūlena ṣaḍaṅgaṃ vidhāya tarpayet | oṃ hrīṃ śivastṛpyatu oṃ hrīṃ pīṭhādhikāriṇyo devatāstṛpyantu oṃ hrīṃ guravaḥ pūrvācāryāstṛpyantu oṃ hrīṃ śaktayastṛpyantu oṃ hrīṃ paramamarīcayastṛpyantu oṃ hrīṃ ṣaḍadhvavyāpidevatāstṛpyantu oṃ hrīṃ vighneśvarāstṛpyantu oṃ hrīṃ mantreśvarāstṛpyantu oṃ hrīṃ saptasrotā devastṛpyatu oṃ hrīṃ brahmaviṣṇurudrāstṛpyantu oṃ hrīṃ lokapālāstṛpyantu oṃ hrīṃ grahāstṛpyantu oṃ hrīṃ siddhāstṛpyantu oṃ hrīṃ svargādhikāriṇastṛpyantu oṃ hrīṃ pīṭhādhikāriṇaścauṣadhayastṛpyantu iti devatīrthena (prāgagreṣu surāṃstṛpyenmanuṣyāṃścaiva madhyataḥ | pitṛṃśca dakṣiṇāgreṣu dadyāditi jalāñjalīn || agnipurāṇe | ṛṣitarpaṇantu(##-) śvasuramahāśvasuravṛddhaśvasurāstṛpyantu oṃ hrīṃ catuṣpīṭhādhikāriṇaḥ siddhāstṛpyantu oṃ hrīṃ pīṭhādhikāriṇyo devatāstṛpyantu oṃ hrīṃ guravaḥ pūrvācāryāstṛpyantu oṃ hrīṃ pīṭhādhikāriṇyastṛpyantu oṃ hrīṃ auṣadhayastṛpyantu iti manuṣyatīrthena (tarjanyaṅguṣṭhamadhyasthāne ityamaraḥ |) | oṃ hrīṃ pitṛpitāmahaprapitāmahāstṛpyantu oṃ hrīṃ pitṛvaṃśajāstṛpyantu oṃ hrīṃ mātāmahapramātāmahavṛddhapramātāmahāstṛpyantu oṃ hrīṃ mātṛvaṃśajāstṛpyantu oṃ hrīṃ śvasuravaṃśajāstṛpyantu iti pitṛtīrthena (pitṛtīrthaḥ(-) antarāṅguṣṭhadeśinyoḥ pitṝṇāṃ tīrthamuttamam | kūrmapurāṇe |) | ekoccāraṇena vā kāryānusārataḥ kuryāt | sarvajanavihite mārge na doṣaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ śivaśaktipurassarā marīcayaḥ ṣaḍadhvavāsinyo devatā vidyā vidyeśvarā mantrā mantreśvarā brahmādayo lokapālamātara ugrasiddhā auṣadhayastṛpyantu iti devatātīrthena | oṃ hrīṃ pīṭhādhikārāḥ siddhā bhūcaryo guravaḥ pūrvācāryāstṛpyantu iti manuṣyatīrthena | oṃ hrīṃ pitṛpitāmahaprapitāmahamātāmahapramātāmahavṛddhapramātāmaha(##-)
śvasuravaṃśajāstṛpyantu iti pitṛtīrthena | tataḥ pitrādi svapitṛkramaṃ tarpayet | tato mūlabījena catusttvāṅkitaiḥ (śodhayāmītyantyapadairmantraiḥ) salilaṃ pibet |
caturviśeṣācamo'yaṃ dehatatvaviśodhakaḥ | (tat) kṛtvā kuryān maheśāni(!) tarpaṇaṃ mūlavidyayā || pīṭhānyādau pratarpyātha devīmāvāhya tarpayet | tridhā santarpya devyāśca tatastvāvaraṇaṃ yajet || vāṅmayā kamalā pūrvaṃ sarvamantrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || tritāramūlamantrānte bhuvaneśvarī (bhuvaneśī) padaṃ tataḥ | namaḥ śrīpādukānte tu tarpayāmīti coccaret | anena kramayogena tarpayedāvaraṇaṃ kramāt ||
tadyāthā(-) aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ oṃ hrīṃ bhuvaneśvaryambā (yai) namaḥ śrīpādukāṃ tarpayāmi iti triḥsantarpya tataḥ pīṭhadevatānāmāvaraṇadevatānāṃ tritāraṃ namaḥ śrīpādukāṃ tarpayāmītyekaikamañjaliṃ tarpayet | tatra pīṭhāvaraṇadevatāścāgre vakṣyāmaḥ |

ācamya prāṇānāyamya deśakālau saṅkīrtya mama sakaladoṣaparihārārthaṃ bhuvaneśvarīprasādasiddhyarthaṃ bhūtaśuddhyādi nyāsān kariṣye iti saṃkalpya | tatrādau āsananiyamaḥ (-)
vināsanena mantrajñaḥ kṛtaṃ karma na sidhyati | kṛṣṇājine jñānasiddhistapaḥsiddhiḥ kuśāsane ||
bhūmyāsane yaśohāni pallave cittavibhramaḥ | tṛṇāsane na siddhiḥ syād vaitasaṃ kīrtidāyakam ||
śvetāvikaṃ vinā śāntiḥ pāṣāṇe vyādhireva ca | vyāghracarmaṇi mokṣaḥ syāddaurbhāgyaṃ dārukāsane ||
vaiṇave balahāniḥ syāt sarvārthaścitrakambale | abhicārādike kṛṣṇaḥ cakṣurhāniśca nidrayā ||
mahatī devahāniśca jṛmbhābhiḥ sarvadā bhavet | manasā cañcalenāśu na siddhyati kadācana ||
ityāsanāni | atha śubhe śucau deśe vidhiproktamṛdvāsane aiṃ bījakarṇikaṃ svarayugmakiñjalkaṃ ka ca ṭa ta pa ya śa la vargāṣṭakadalaṃ dikṣu vaṃ bījānvitaṃ vidikṣu ṭhaṃ bījamaṇḍitaṃ mātṛkāmbujaṃ dhyātvā aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ ādhāraśaktikamalāsanāya nama iti puṣpākṣatādibhirabhyarcya prāṅmukha udaṅmukho vā upaviśya bhūmiṃ prārthayet |

kṣetrādyakṣaramuccārya amukakṣetre medātmakakhaḍgīśāya varṇeśānandanāthāya atiraktavarṇāya raktadvādaśaśaktiyuktāya asmin kṣetre imāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa svāhā iti puṣpākṣatādibhirdīpanāthamabhyarcya(-)
tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraṃ(!) mahākāya(-)kalpāntajvalanopama | bhairavāya namastubhyamanujñāṃ dātumarhasi ||
iti bhairavājñāṃ labdhvā hastābhyāmañjaliṃ vidhāya sapuṣpaṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ śivādigurubhyo namaḥ śirasi (3) gaṃ gaṇapataye namo dakṣaskandhe (3) vaṃ vaṭukāya namo vāmaskandhe (3) duṃ durgāyai namaḥ dakṣorumūle (3) kṣaṃ kṣetrapālāya namo vāmorumūle (3) iti dakṣavāmapārśvordhvādhobhāgeṣu vinyaset |
akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākāraṃ vyāptaṃ yenaṃ carācaram | tatpadaṃ darśitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ ||
caraṇaṃ pavitraṃ vitataṃ purāṇaṃ yena pūtastarati duṣkṛtāni | tena pavitreṇa śuddhena pūtā atipāpmānamarātiṃ tarema ||
ityādi vaidikairmantrairgurupādukāmuccārya aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ amukānandanātha amukāmbāśaktiyukta śrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi nama iti sahasrāravinde śrīgurunāthaṃ sampūjya yonimudrayā praṇamet | tato bhūtotsāraṇaṃ kuryāt (-)
apasarpantu te bhūtā ye bhūtā bhūmisaṃsthitāḥ | ye bhūtā vighnakartāraste naśyantu śivājñayā ||
oṃ ślīṃ paśu huṃ phaṭ iti pāśupatāstreṇa nārācamudrayā vighnānutsārya siddhārthākṣatakusumaiḥ pātālabhūnabholīnān vighnān krameṇa vāmapārṣṇighātakarāsphoṭasamudañcitavaktrairutsārya uktapāśupatāstreṇa vāmahastatalaṃ dviddhā maṇibandhāt samārabhya sapṛṣṭhaṃ dakṣapāṇinā pramṛjya dakṣiṇaṃ pāṇiṃ sakṛdevoktamārgataḥ anena ṣaṭ karaśodhanaṃ kṛtvā nābherāpādaṃ hṛdo nābhiparyantaṃ śiraso hṛtparyantaṃ tenaivāstreṇa vyāpayitvā antastālatrayaṃ bahistālatrayaṃ kṛtvā daśadigbandhanaṃ kṛtvā raṃ agniprākārāya namaḥ oṃ sahasrāra huṃ phaṭ svāhā pūrvoktāstramantrābhyāṃ prākārau kṛtvā triragniveṣṭanaṃ kṛtvā evaṃ rakṣāṃ purā kṛtvā bhūtaśuddhimathācaret | tadyathā(-)
praṇavadvādaśāvṛtyā nāḍīśuddhiṃ vidhāya hṛdisthaṃ caitanyaṃ haṃsaḥ iti mantreṇa saṃghaṭṭamudrayordhvamunniya dvādaśāntaḥsthite pare tejasi saṃyojya astreṇa rakṣāṃ kṛtvā bhūtāni śodhayet | asya pārthivamantrasya brahmā ṛṣirgāyatrī chandaḥ somo devatā pārthivākhyabhūtaśuddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ | pādādijānuparyantaṃ pṛthvīsthānam tatra pārthivamaṇḍalaṃ pītavarṇaṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ vajralāñchitam brahmadaivatyaṃ tena pañcaguṇā pṛthvī ṣaḍudghātaprayogeṇa oṃ laṃ 60 bījena saṃśodhya apsu layaṃ nayet |
vāruṇamantrasya gautama(-)ṛṣirvaruṇo devatā triṣṭup chando varuṇākhyabhūtaśuddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ | jānvādinābhiparyantaṃ āpasthānaṃ varuṇamaṇḍalaṃ dhavalaṃ dhanurākāraṃ ubhayoḥ koṭyoḥ śvetapadmalāñchitaṃ tanmadhye vaṃ bījaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ viṣṇudaivatyaṃ tena caturguṇā āpaḥ pañcodghātaprayogeṇa śoṣayāmi | oṃ vaṃ (48) iti bījena tejasi layaṃ nayet |
āgneyamaṃtrasya kaśyapaḥ ṛṣiḥ | agnirdevatā triṣṭup chanda āgneyākhyabhūtaśuddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ | nābhyādihṛdayaparyantaṃ agnisthānaṃ tatra vahnimaṇḍalaṃ trikoṇākāraṃ koṇatraye svastikāṅkitaṃ tanmadhye raṃ bījaṃ raktavarṇaṃ rudradaivatyaṃ tena triguṇo vahnistrirud ghātaprayogeṇa śoṣayāmi | oṃ raṃ (36) iti vāyau layaṃ nayet |
vāyavyamantrasya kiṣkandha ṛṣirvāyurdevatā triṣṭup chando vāyavyākhyabhūtaśuddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ | hṛdayādibhrūmadhyaparyantaṃ vāyusthānam tatra vāyumaṇḍalaṃ ṣaṭkoṇākāraṃ ṣaḍbindulāñchitam tanmadhye yaṃ bījaṃ nīlavarṇaṃ saṅkarṣaṇadaivatyaṃ triguṇo vāyurdvirudghātaprayogeṇa śoṣayāmi oṃ yaṃ (24) iti ākāśe layaṃ nayet |
ākāśamantrasya brahmā ṛṣiḥ mahadākāśo devatā triṣṭup chanda ākāśākhyabhūtaśuddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ | bhrūmadhyād brahmarandhaparyantamākāśasthānam tatra nabhomaṇḍalaṃ vartulākāraṃ dhvajalāñchitaṃ tanmadhye haṃ bījaṃ dhūmravarṇam sadāśivadaivatyam tenaikaguṇa ākāśa ekodghātaprayogeṇa śoṣayāmi oṃ haṃ (12) iti bījena pare śive layaṃ nayet |
ṣaṣṭisaṃkhyā samārabhya dvādaśa dvādaśa tyajet | pṛthivyādīni bhūtāni krameṇa svasvakāraṇe ||
evaṃ pañcamahābhūtāni pare tatve ekībhūtāni vicintya punarbhūtāni pravilāpayet | oṃ lhāṃ brahmaṇe pṛthivyadhipataye nivṛttikalātmane huṃ phaṭ svāhā pādādijānuparyantaṃ vyāpya pṛthvīṃ śodhayet | oṃ hrīṃ viṣṇave abdhipataye pratiṣṭhākalātmane huṃ phaṭ svāhā iti jānvādinābhiparyantaṃ vyāpya apaḥ śodhayet | oṃ hraṃ agnaye tejo'dhipataye vidyākalātmane huṃ phaṭ svāhā iti nābhyādivakṣaḥparyantaṃ vyāpya agniṃ śodhayet | oṃ hyaiṃ īśvarāya vāyvadhipataye śāntikalātmane huṃ phaṭ svāhā | hṛdayādi bhrūyugāntaṃ vyāpya vāyuṃ śodhayet | oṃ hauṃ sadāśivāya vyomādhipataye śāntyatītakalātmane huṃ phaṭ svāhā | bhruvādibrahmarandhrāntaṃ vyāpya ākāśaṃ śodhayet | iti vyāpakaṃ kṛtvā yonimudrāṃ baddhvā kulakuṇḍalinīmutthāpya ṣaṭsarojāni bhittvā jīvapradīpasneharūpiṇīṃ tāṃ pare tejasi saṃyojya vakṣyamāṇakrameṇa śoṣaṇādi samācaret |
tatrādau vāmakukṣau pāpapuruṣaṃ dhyāyet(-)
brahmahatyāśiraskaṃ ca svarṇasteyabhujadvayam | surāpānahṛdā yuktaṃ gurutalpakaṭidvayam ||
upapātakaromāṇaṃ pātakopāṅgasaṃśrayam | khaḍgacarmadharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pāpaṃ kukṣau vicintayet ||
ityādi krameṇa kukṣau pāpapuruṣaṃ dhyātvā tatsahitasya dehasya śoṣaṇādikaṃ kuryāt | tadyathā (-)
vāmanāsāpuṭe vāyumaṇḍalaṃ tadbījayuktaṃ yaṃ kādimāntaiḥ sparśavarṇaiḥ sevitaṃ dhūmravarṇaṃ smṛtvā aṃ (16) mātrāṣoḍaśakena sampūrya prāṇāpānavāyumbhyāṃ saha saṃyojya tadutthenānilena saha śārīrairmahāpāpai rogaiśca saha saṃśoṣya dvātriṃśadbhirmātrābhiḥ (32) kumbhakaṃ soḍaśabhiḥ (16) recakaṃ tato dāhanam |
dakṣanāsāpuṭe vahnimaṇḍalaṃ tadbījayuktaṃ yādidaśabhiryaṃ sevitaṃ vicintya prāṇāpānavāyubhyāṃ saha saṃyojya tadutthenānalena ca saha śārīrairmahāpāpai rogaiśca saha saṃdahya pūrvavat kumbhakarecakau | tataḥ plāvanam | vāmanāsāpuṭe āpyamaṇḍalaṃ tadbījayuktaṃ dhavalaṃ dhanurākāraṃ ṣoḍaśasvara (16) sevitaṃ vicintya pūrvavat sampūrya ādhāragatena vāyunā vahnikuṇḍalinīmutthāpya tasyā jvālāsamudāyena āplāvyamānaṃ brahmarandhrendumaṇḍalādamṛtādāplāvyamānaṃ pūrvavat pūrakakumbhakarecakāḥ | evaṃ śoṣaṇadāhanaplāvanāni kṛtvā parasmin śāmbhave brahmaṇi svaśarīraṃ tatsārūpyapratibimbitaṃ budbudākāraṃ dhyātvā laṃ pṛthivībījena kaṭhinīkṛtya haṃ vyomabījena vibhidya bhūtotpattiṃ vicintayet | akṣarāt kham | ākāśād vāyuḥ | auṣadhibhyo annam | annād retaḥ | retasaḥ puruṣa iti sṛṣṭikramaṃ vicintya | oṃ haṃ (12) oṃ hauṃ sadāśivāya vyomādhipataye śāntyatītakalātmane huṃ phat svāhā iti brahmarandhrabhrūmadhyaparyantaṃ vyāpyaṃ yaṃ (24) oṃ hraiṃ īśvarāya vāyvadhipataye śāntikalātmane huṃ phaṭ svāhā bhrūmadhyād hṛdayaparyantaṃ vyāpyaṃ raṃ (36) oṃ hraṃ agnaye tejo'dhipataye vidyākalātmane huṃ phaṭ svāhā hṛdādinābhiparyantaṃ vyāpyaṃ vaṃ (48) oṃ hvīṃ viṣṇave abdhipataye pratiṣṭhākalātmane huṃ phaṭ svāhā nābhyādijānuparyantaṃ vyāpyaṃ laṃ (60) oṃ hlāṃ brahmaṇe pṛthivyadhipataye nivṛttikalātmane huṃ phaṭ svāhā jānvādipādaparyantaṃ vyāpyamiti krameṇa dvādaśasaṃkhyā samārabhya ṣaṣṭiparyantaṃ varddhayan so'hamityuccārya hṛtpadme śivātmānaṃ jīvaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśattatvarūpaṃ smaret | tata ekaviṃśativāraṃ māyāṃ japitvā aṅkuśākāratarjanyā prāṇān mūlādhārād brahmarandhrānte prāṇapratiṣṭhāmantreṇa sthāpayet |
atha prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ kurvīta vakṣyamāṇaprakārataḥ tadyathā(-) prāṇapratiṣṭhāmantrasya brahmaviṣṇuśivā ṛṣayaḥ śirasi | ṛgyajuḥsāmāni chandāṃsi mukhe | prāṇaśaktirdevatā hṛdaye | dvādaśānte prāṇapratiṣṭhāpane viniyogaḥ | aṃ kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ ghaṃ ṅaṃ (5) āṃ pṛthivyaptejovāyvākāśātmane hṛdayāya namaḥ | aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | iṃ caṃ chaṃ jaṃ jhaṃ ñaṃ (5) īṃ śabdasparśarūparasagandhātmane śirase svāhā | tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ | uṃ ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ ṇaṃ (5) ūṁ śrotratvakcakṣurjihvāghrāṇātmane śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ | eṃ taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ naṃ (5) aiṃ vākpāṇipāyūpasthāne kavacāya huṃ | anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃ paṃ phaṃ baṃ bhaṃ maṃ (5) auṃ vacanādānagamanavisargānandātmane netratrayāya vausaṭ | kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ | aṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ haṃ kṣaṃ aḥ manobudhyahaṃkāracittātmane (cittavijñānātmane iti āhnikakarmasūtrāvalipāṭhaḥ) astrāya phaṭ | karatalakarapṛṣṭhayoḥ | yaṃ tvagātmane namaḥ | raṃ asṛgātmane namaḥ | laṃ māṃsātmane namaḥ | vaṃ meda ātmane namaḥ | śaṃ asthyātmane namaḥ | ṣaṃ majjātmane namaḥ | saṃ śukrātmane namaḥ | oṃ āṃ hrīṃ kroṃ iti bījatrayaiśca trirvyāpakaṃ kṛtvā | tato dyānam (-)
raktāmbhodhisthapotollasadaruṇasarojādhirūḍhā karābjaiḥ pāśaṃ kodaṇḍamikṣūdbhavamatha guṇamapyaṅkuśaṃ pañca bāṇān || bibhrāṇā'sṛkkapālaṃ trinayanasadṛśā pīnavakṣoruhāḍhyā devī bālārkavarṇā bhavatu sukhakarī prāṇaśaktiḥ parā naḥ |
iti dhyānam |
hṛdi hastaṃ datvā mantraṃ japet | āṃ hrīṃ kroṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ hoṃ mama prāṇena śrībhuvaneśvarīprāṇā iha prāṇāḥ 11 mama jīvena saha śrībhuvaneśvaryā jīva iha sthitaḥ 11 mama sarvendriyaiḥ saha śrībhuvaneśvaryāḥ sarvendriyāṇi vāṅmanastvakcakṣuḥśrotrajihvāghrāṇaprāṇā ihaivāgatya sukhaṃ ciraṃ tiṣṭhantu svāhā iti prāṇapratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ |
atha mātṛkānyāsakramaḥ |
gudāttu dvyaṅgulādūrdhvaṃ suṣumṇāmūlarandhragam | vādivedārṇalasitaṃ paṅkajaṃ kanakaprabham ||
tatsthāṃ vidyullatākārāṃ tejorekhāmaṇīyasīṃ | kulakuṇḍalinīmūrdhvaṃ nayet ṣaṭcakrabhedinīm ||
dvādaśānte dumadhyasthaṃ pūrvoktaṃ mātṛkāmbujam | navanītanibhaṃ dhyātvā drutaṃ kuṇḍalinītviṣā ||
tejo'ñjalau viniḥsārya mātṛkānyāsamācaret ||
aṃ āṃ iṃ īṃ uṃ ūṃ iti ṣaṭ svarān dakṣavāmakaratalatatpṛṣṭhatadvyāptikrameṇa nyaset | śiṣṭān daśa svarānaṅguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhāntaṃ daśasvaṅguliṣu nyaset | dakṣapradeśinīmārabhya vāmakaniṣṭhikāparyantaṃ pūrvatrayāgreṣu catuścaturaḥ kādisāntān varṇān halāvaṅguṣṭhayoḥ antyaṃ aṅgulyagreṣu nyaset | tato lipiṣaḍaṅgaḥ |
aṃ kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ ghaṃ ṅaṃ (5) āṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | iṃ caṃ chaṃ jaṃ jhaṃ ñaṃ (5) īṃ śirase svāhā tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ | uṃ ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ ṇaṃ (5) ūṃ śikhāyai vaṣat madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ | eṃ taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ naṃ (5) aiṃ kavacāya huṃ anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃ paṃ phaṃ baṃ bhaṃ maṃ (5) auṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ | aṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ haṃ kṣaṃ (10) aḥ astrāya phaṭ karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ |
asyāḥ śudhabinduvisargamātṛkāyāḥ brahmā ṛṣiḥ śirasi | devī gāyatrī chando mukhe | śrīmātṛkā sarasvatī devatā hṛdi | vyañjanāni bījāni guhye | svarāḥ śaktayaḥ pādayoḥ | śuddhabinduvisargamātṛkānyāse viniyogaḥ |
hsauṃ aṃ āṃ śauṃ | iti mātṛkāṃ trirvyāpayet | tatra nyāse kārikā (-)
kānanavṛttadvyakṣiśrutito gaṇḍoṣṭhadantamūrdhāsye | doḥpatsandhyagreṣu ca pārśvayośca pṛṣṭhanābhijaṭhareṣu ||
hṛddormūlāparagalakakṣe hṛdādipāṇipādayuge | jaṭharānanayorvyāpakasaṃjñāṃ nyasedathākṣarān kramaśaḥ ||
tatra nyāsaḥ | oṃ a namaḥ śirasi | oṃ ā namo mukhavṛtte | oṃ i namo dakṣanetre | oṃ ī namo vāmanetre | oṃ u namo dakṣakarṇe | oṃ ū namo vāmakarṇe | oṃ ṛ namo dakṣanāsāpuṭe | oṃ ṝ namo vāmanāsāpuṭe | oṃ ḷ namo dakṣagaṇḍe | oṃ ḹ namo vāmagaṇḍe | oṃ e nama ūrdhvoṣṭhe | oṃ ai namaḥ adharoṣṭhe | oṃ o nama ūrdhvadantapaṅktau | oṃ au namaḥ adhodantapaṃktau | oṃ aṃ namo jihvāmule | oṃ aḥ namo jihvāgre | oṃ ka namo dakṣahatamūle | oṃ kha namo dakṣahastakūrpare | oṃ ga namo dakṣahastamaṇibandhe |
oṃ gha namo dakṣahastāṅgulimūle | oṃ ṅa namo dakṣahatāṅgulyagre | oṃ ca namo vāmahastamūle | oṃ cha namo vāmahastakūrpare | oṃ ja namo vāmahastamaṇibandhe | oṃ jha namo vāmahastāṅgulimūle | oṃ ña namo vāmahastāṅgulyagre | oṃ ṭa namo dakṣapādamūle | oṃ ṭha namo dakṣapādajānuni | oṃ ḍa namo dakṣapādagulphe | oṃ ḍha namo dakṣapādāṅgulimūle | oṃ ṇa namo dakṣapādāṅgulyagre | oṃ ta namo vāmapādamūle | oṃ tha namo vāmapādajānuni | oṃ da namo vāmapādagulphe | oṃ dha namo vāmapādāṅgulimūle | oṃ na namo vāmapādāṅgulyagre | oṃ pa namo dakṣapārśve | oṃ pha namo vāmapārśve | oṃ ba namaḥ pṛṣṭhe | oṃ bha namo nābhau | oṃ ma namo jaṭhare | oṃ ya namo hṛdi | oṃ ra namo dakṣaskandhe | oṃ la namo vāmaskandhe | oṃ va namaḥ kaṇṭhe | oṃ śa namo dakṣakakṣe | oṃ ṣa namo vāmakakṣe | oṃ sa namo hṛdādipāṇiyuge | oṃ ha namo hṛdādipādayuge oṃ la namo jaṭharādi ānane | vyāpakam | oṃ kṣa namo mastakādipādāntaṃ | vyāpakam | punastatraiva oṃ aṃ namaḥ śirasi | oṃ āṃ namo mukhavṛtte ityādi krameṇa bindumatṛkāṃ nyaset | punastatraiva oṃ aḥ namaḥ śirasi | oṃ āḥ namo mukhavṛtte ityādi krameṇa visargamātṛkāmaṅguṣṭhānāmikāyogena nyaset | atha dhyānam (-)
arkonmuktaśaśāṅkakoṭisadṛśīmāpīnatuṅgastanīṃ candrārdhāhitamastakāṃ madhumadāmālolanetratrayām | bibhrāṇāmaniśaṃ varaṃ japavaṭīṃ śūlaṃ kapālaṃ karai(-) rādyāṃ yauvanagarvitāṃ lipitanuṃ vāgīśvarīmāśraye ||
iti dhyānam | iti śuddhabinduvisargamātṛkāśceti trividho mātṛkānyāsakramaḥ |
atha antarmātṛkānyāsakramaḥ | asya śrī(-)antarmātṛkānyāsasya brahmā ṛṣiḥ śirasi | gāyatrī chando mukhe | antarmātṛkā sarasvatī devatā hṛdi | halo bījāni guhye | svarāḥ śaktayaḥ pādayoḥ | kṣaḥ kīlakaṃ nābhau | antarmātṛkānyāse viniyogaḥ |
atha ṣaḍaṅgaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ aṃ kaṃ (5) āṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ aṅguṣṭhayoḥ | oṃ hrīṃ iṃ caṃ (5) īṃ śirase svāhā tarjanyoḥ | oṃ hrīṃ uṃ ṭaṃ (5) ūṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ madhyamayoḥ | oṃ hrīṃ eṃ taṃ (5) aiṃ kavacāya huṃ anāmikayoḥ | oṃ hrīṃ oṃ paṃ (5) auṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ kaniṣṭhayoḥ oṃ hrīṃ aṃ yaṃ 9 aḥ astrāya phaṭ karatalakarapṛṣṭhayoḥ | dhyānam (-)
bandhukābhāṃ trinetrāṃ pṛthujaghanalasacchuktimadraktavastrāṃ pīnottuṅgapravṛddhastanajaghanabharāṃ yauvanābhārarūḍhām |
divyālaṅkārayuktāṃ sarasijanayanāmindusaṅkrāntimūrdhnāṃ devīṃ pāśāṅkuśāḍhyāmabhayavarakarāṃ mātṛkāṃ tāṃ namāmi ||
iti dhyānam | tatra viśuddhau ṣoḍaśadalakamalamūrdhvamukham dhyātvā tattaddaleṣu prāgādiprādakṣiṇyena bījapūrvakaṃ nyaset | oṃ hrīṃ aṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ āṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ iṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ īṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ uṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ ūṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ ṛṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ ṝṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ ḷṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ ḹṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ eṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ aiṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ oṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ auṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ aṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ aḥ namaḥ | evaṃ ṣoḍaśasvarān nyaset |
tato'nāhatacakraṃ dvādaśadalakamalaṃ dhyātvā tathaiva kakārādiṭhakārāntān varṇān prādakṣiṇyena nyaset | oṃ hrīṃ kaṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ khaṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ gaṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ ghaṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ ṅaṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ caṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ chaṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ jaṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ jhaṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ ñaṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ ṭaṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ ṭhaṃ namaḥ |
tato nābhau maṇipūrakacakraṃ daśadalakamalaṃ dhyātvā tattaddaleṣu ḍakārādiphakārāntān daśa varṇān nyaset | oṃ hrīṃ ḍaṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ ḍhaṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ ṇaṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ taṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ thaṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ daṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ dhaṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ naṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ paṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ phaṃ namaḥ |
tato liṅgamūle svādhiṣṭhānacakraṃ ṣaḍdalakamalaṃ dhyātvā tattaddaleṣu bakārādi lakārāntān ṣaḍvarṇān nyaset | oṃ hrīṃ baṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ bhaṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ maṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ yaṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ raṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ laṃ namaḥ |
tato mūlādhāre caturdalakamalaṃ dhyātvā tattaddaleṣu vakārādisakārāntān caturvarṇān nyaset | oṃ hrīṃ vaṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ śaṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ ṣaṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ saṃ namaḥ |
tato bhrūmadhye ājñācakraṃ dvidalakamalaṃ dyātvā tattaddalayordvivarṇān nyaset | oṃ hrīṃ haṃ namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ kṣaṃ namaḥ |
atha ṣaṭcakradhyānam(-)
ādhāre liṅganābhau prakaṭitahṛdaye tālumūle lalāṭe | dve patre ṣoḍaśāre dvidaśadaśayute dvādaśārdhe catuṣke |
vāsānte bālamadhye ḍa pha ka ṭha sahite kaṇṭhadeśe svarāṇāṃ haṃ kṣaṃ tatvārthayuktaṃ sakaladalagataṃ varṇarūpaṃ namāmi ||
iti ṣaṭcakradhyānam | ityantarmātṛkānyāsaḥ |
atha bhuvaneśvarīsampuṭitabahirmātṛkānyāsaḥ | asya śrībhuvaneśvarīsampuṭitabahirmātṛkāmantrasya brahmā ṛṣiḥ śirasi gāyatrī chando mukhe bahirmātṛkā sarasvatī devatā hṛdaye halo bījāni guhye svarāḥ śaktayaḥ pādayoḥ kṣaḥ kīlakaṃ nābhau bahirmātṛkānyāse viniyogaḥ |
atha ṣaḍaṅgaḥ | oṃ hraṃ aṃ kaṃ (5) āṃ hrāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ aṅguṣṭhayoḥ | oṃ hriṃ iṃ caṃ (5) īṃ hrīṃ śirase svāhā tarjanyoḥ | oṃ hrūṃ uṃ ṭaṃ (5) ūṃ hraṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ madhyamayoḥ | oṃ hreṃ eṃ taṃ (5) aiṃ hraiṃ kavacāya huṃ anāmikayoḥ | oṃ hroṃ oṃ paṃ (5) auṃ hrauṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ kaniṣṭhikayoḥ | oṃ hraṃ aṃ yaṃ 10 aḥ hraḥ astrāya phaṭ karatalakarapṛṣṭhayoḥ | iti ṣaḍaṅgaḥ |
dhyānam (-)
pañcāśadvarṇabhedairvihitavadanadoḥpādayukkukṣivakṣo(-) deśāṃ bhāsvatkapardākalitaśaśikalāmindukundāvadātām | akṣasrakkumbhacintālikhitavarakarām tryakṣarāṃ padmasaṃsthā(-) macchākalpāvatucchastanajaghanabharāṃ bhāratīṃ tāṃ namāmi ||
pustakajñānamudrāṅkāṃ trinetrāṃ candraśekharām | ādhārād brahmarandhrāntāṃ bisatantutanīyasīm ||
tāṃ devīṃ cintayedantaḥ pāpatrayavināśinīm | mantravittanmayo bhūtvā bhhavamanyaṃ na bhāvayet ||
brahmakeśavarudrādyairlabhate durllabhaṃ padam | pādādikrodhaparyantaṃ varṇacakraṃ susaṃyutam ||
niṣkalaṅkaṃ sudhākāntikamanīyaṃ nyaset tanau |
tatra nyāse kārikā (-)
ādyo maulirathāparo mukhami(-)ī netre ca karṇāvu(-)ū nāsāvaṃśapuṭe ṛ ṝ tadanujau varṇau kapoladvayam | dantāścordhvamadhastathoṣṭhayugalaṃ sandhyakṣarāṇi kramāt jihvāmūlamudagravindurapi ca grīvā visargī svaraḥ ||
kādirdakṣiṇato bhujastaditaro vargaśca vāmo bhuja(-) ṣṭādistādiranukrameṇa caraṇau kukṣidvayaṃ te paphau | vaṃśaḥ pṛṣṭhabhavo'tha nābhihṛdaye bāditrayam dhātavo yādyāḥ saptasamīraṇaśca saparaḥ kṣaḥ krodha ityambike(!) ||

iti mātṛkānyāsaphalam |
tataḥ prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kuryāt | tasya lakṣaṇam |
iḍayā pūrayed vāyuṃ svarairvarṇaiśca kumbhayet | recayed yādikairvarṇaistataḥ piṅgalayā saha ||

asya śrī(-)ekākṣarabhuvaneśvarīmantrasya śakti(-)ṛṣaye namaḥ śirasi | gāyatrī chandase namo mukhe | śrībhuvaneśvarīdevatāyai namo hṛdaye | haṃ bījāya namo guhye | īṃ śaktaye namaḥ pādayoḥ | raṃ kīlakāya namaḥ sarvāṅgeṣu | śrībhuvaneśvarīprītyarthaṃ jape viniyogaḥ |
atha hṛllekhādinyāsaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ hṛllekhāyai namo mūrdhni | oṃ hraṃ gaganāyai namo mukhe | oṃ hraiṃ raktāyai namo hṛdaye | oṃ hrauṃ karālikāyai namo guhye | oṃ hraḥ mahocchuṣmāyai namaḥ pādayoḥ | iti hṛllekhādinyāsaḥ |
atha mūlamantraṣaḍaṅgaḥ | oṃ hrāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ aṅguṣṭhayoḥ | oṃ hrīṃ śirase svāhā tarjanyoḥ | oṃ hrūṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ madhyamayoḥ | oṃ hraiṃ kavacāya huṃ anāmikayoḥ | oṃ hrauṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ kaniṣṭhikayoḥ | oṃ hraḥ astrāya phaṭ karatalakarapṛṣṭhayoḥ | iti ṣaḍaṅgaḥ |
atha sāvitryādinyāsaḥ | oṃ hrāṃ gāyatrīsahitāya brahmaṇe namo bhāle | oṃ hrīṃ sāvitrīsahitāya viṣṇave namo dakṣakapole | oṃ hraṃ vāgīśvarīsahitāya maheśvarāya namo vāmakapole | oṃ hrauṃ śriyā sahitāya dhanapataye namo vāmakarṇe | oṃ hrauṃ ratisahitāya smarāya namo mukhe | oṃ hraṃ siddhibuddhisahitāya gaṇapataye namo dakṣakarṇe | oṃ hraḥ bhuvaneśvaryai namo mukhe | iti sāvitryādinyāsaḥ |
punaḥ pṛthaktvena etāṃstanau nyaset | tadyathā(-) oṃ hrāṃ gāyatryai namaḥ kaṇṭhamūle | oṃ hrīṃ sāvitryai namaḥ savyastane | oṃ hrūṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ aparastane | oṃ hraiṃ brahmaṇe namaḥ savyāṃse | oṃ hrauṃ viṣṇave namo hṛdaye | oṃ hraḥ śivāya namo dakṣāṃse iti vinyasya |
oṃ hrauṃ hṛllekhāyai namo hṛdi | oṃ hraiṃ gaganāyai namaḥ śirase svāhā | oṃ hrūṃ raktāyai namaḥ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | oṃ hrīṃ karālikāyai namaḥ kavacāya huṃ | oṃ hrāṃ mahocchuṣmāyai namo netratrayāya vauṣaṭ | hraḥ sarvasiddhidāyinyai astrāya phaṭ | iti pañcavaktranyāsalipiḥ |
atha brāhmyādinyāsaḥ | oṃ hrāṃ brahmyai namo mūrdhni | oṃ hrīṃ māheśvaryai namaḥ savyāṃse | oṃ hrūṃ kaumāryai namo dakṣapārśve | oṃ hraiṃ vārāhyai namo vāmāṃse | oṃ hrauṃ caṇḍikāyai namo vāmapārśve | oṃ hraḥ mahālakṣmyai namo hṛdaye iti brāhmyādinyāsaḥ |
kecit svadehe pīṭhanyāsamapi kurvanti |

udyadinadyutimindukirīṭāṃ tuṅgakucāṃ nayanatrayayuktām | smeramukhīṃ varadāṅkuśapāśābhītikarāmprabhaje bhuvaneśīm ||
iti dhyātvā mānasairupacāraiḥ sampūjya pratyahaṃ (32) dvātriṃśacchatam japet | athavāṣṭottaraśataṃ japet | japānantaraṃ punarācamanaprāṇāyāmādikaṃ ṣaḍaṅganyāsadhyānaṃ vidhāya dakṣa (kare) jalaṃ gṛhitvā(-)
guhyātiguhyagoptrī tvaṃ gṛhāṇāsmatkṛtaṃ japam | siddhirbhavatu me devi(!) tvatprasādāt sureśvari ||
iti puṣpākṣatasahitaṃ svavāmabhāge devyā dakṣahaste japaṃ nivedayet | pañcamudrābhiḥ praṇamet |
stambhanaṃ caturaśraṃ ca matsyagokṣurameva ca | yonimudreti vikhyātāḥ pañcamudrābhivādane ||
iti namaskāraṃ kuryāt |
tataḥ stotrasahasranāmādipāṭhaṃ kuryāt | atha mantrabhedoddhāraḥ |
lakulīśo'gnimārūḍho vāmanetrārddhacandramāḥ | bījaṃ tasyāḥ samākhyātaṃ sevitaṃ siddhikāṅkṣibhiḥ ||
atha dvitīyo bhedoddhāraḥ(-)

|| śrī (ḥ) ||

śrīdevyuvāca

pūjanaṃ śṛṇu deveśi(!) sādhake siddhipradāyakam | nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ pūjanaṃ trividhaṃ smṛtam ||

yantroddhāraḥ |
bindu trikoṇaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vasupatraṃ suśobhanam | vṛttaṃ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ padmaṃ caturdvāropaśobhitam ||
karpūrāgurukastūrīśrīkhaṇḍakuṅkumena ca | likhedyantraṃ prayatnena lekhanyā hematārayoḥ ||
evaṃ yantraṃ śobhanaṃ svarṇaraupyādyabhāve gomayenopaliptāyāṃ bhūmau pīṭhaṃ samacaturasraṃ caturviṃśatibhiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ dvādaśabhiraṅgulaiḥ parimitaṃ uttamaṃ madhyamaṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ karpūrāgurukastūrīśrīkhaṇḍakuṃkumādinā caturasraṃ ṣoḍaśadalaṃ aṣṭadalaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ trikoṇaṃ binduṃ vilikhya rājyabhogavāsanākāmena hemalekhanyā likhet | dūrvārasena mṛtyuṃ jayati | kanakarasena śatruṃ jayati | stambhanaṃ haridrārasena | tatra lekhanīniyamaḥ | pālāsajātiviṭapasārasvatakākapakṣādi sāmrājyakāmaḥ suvarṇarajatodbhavayā sāmānyasamṛddhikāmaḥ raktāśvatthaṃ mārjārāsthnā vaśyaṃ ākṛṣṭiprayoge raktacandanaṃ stambhane haridrālekhanyā likhet | evaṃ yantroddhāraṃ vidhāya | tatra devīṃ pūjayet | taduktaṃ smṛtau (-)
yantraṃ devamayaṃ proktaṃ devatā yantrarūpiṇī | kāmakrodhādidoṣotthasarvaduḥkhanima (ya)ntraṇāt ||
yantramityāhuretasmin devaḥ prīṇāti pūjitaḥ | śarīramiva jīvasya dīpasya snehavat priye ||
sarveṣāmapi devānāṃ tathā yantraṃ pratiṣṭhitam | jñātvā gurumukhāt sarvaṃ pūjayed vidhinā priye ||
ata uddhāraprāmāṇyena yandroddhāraṃ kṛtvā pūjāmārabhet | tatrādau maṇḍapārcanam | tato devatāgāraṃ manoharaṃ sudhūpitaṃ bahudīpavirājitaṃ kṛtvā puṣpaṃ gṛhītvā aiṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ bhuvaneśvarīmaṇḍapāya nama iti puṣpākṣatādibhiḥ sampūjya dvārapūjāmārabhet | mūlamantramuccārya śuddhodakena caturdvārāt saṃprokṣya dvāradevatāḥ pūjayet | aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ dvāraśriyai namaḥ iti dvāre sampūjya ūrddhvoduṃbaramadhye aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ gaṃ gaṇapataye namaḥ | aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ sāṃ sarasvatyai namastatkoṇayoḥ | aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ kṣāṃ kṣetrapālāya namaḥ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ vāṃ vaṭukāya namaḥ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ dhāṃ dhātre namaḥ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ vidhātre namaḥ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ gāṃ gaṅgāyai namaḥ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ yāṃ yamunāyai namaḥ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ śaṃ śaṅkhanidhaye namaḥ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ paṃ padmanidhaye namaḥ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ ḍākinībhyo dakṣaśākhāyām aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ śākinībhyo vāmaśākhāyām aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ deṃ dehalyai namo dehalyām aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ vāstupuruṣāya nama iti maṇḍapābhyantare sampūjya | evaṃ dvārāṇi pūjayitvā

ityanena sadīpaṃ carukaṃ gandhākṣatapuṣpasahitaṃ kṣetrapālāya datvā tatpātrasthadravyeṇa vāmakaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhayogena dhārāṃ pātayan dhyāyet (##-)
ekaṃ khaṭvāṅgahastaṃ bhujagamapi varaṃ pāśamekaṃ triśulaṃ kāpālaṃ khaḍgahastaṃ ḍamaruga(ka)sahitaṃ vāmahaste pinākam | candrārddhaṃ ketumālākirativaraśaraṃ sarpayajñopavītaṃ kālaṃ bibhratkapālaṃ mama haratu bhayaṃ bhairavaḥ kṣetrapālaḥ || yo'smin kṣetre nivāsī ca kṣetrapālasya kiṅkaraḥ | prītostu balidānena sarvarakṣāṃ karotu me |
itthaṃ balidānaṃ vidhāya | ke(ṣāṃ)cinmatena(-) huṃ sarvavighnakṛdbhyo bhūtebhyo namaḥ iti mantreṇa sadīpaṃ alipiśitasahitaṃ carukaṃ gandhākṣatapuṣpasamanvitaṃ gṛhādbahirnikṣipet | iti bhūtabaliḥ | tataḥ śāligodhūmādipiṣṭena saguḍena sajīrakena sālidvitīyena sārddhaṃ trikoṇākārān ḍamarukarūpeṇa nava pañca trīn vā vidhāya ghṛtena pācayitvā tāmrādibhājane aṣṭadalaṃ trikoṇaṃ vidhāya mūlena sampūjya aṣṭadale aṣṭadīpān saṃsthāpya trikoṇe ekaṃ dīpaṃ saṃsthāpya evaṃ navadīpān saṃsthapya mūlena phalapuṣpatāmbūlasuvarṇādikaṃ pātre nikṣipya mūlena prajvālya sāmayikaṃ ślokadvayaṃ paṭhan mūlena devyupari sārdhatrivāraṃ bhrāmayet |
antastejo bahisteja ekīkṛtya nirantaram | tridhā devyuparibhrāmya kuladīpaṃ nivedayet ||
candrādityau ca dharaṇī vidyudagnistathaiva ca | tvameva sarvajyotīṃṣi ārtikyaṃ pratigṛhyatām ||
tato mūlena lavaṇanimbapatrādyaiḥ annapiṣṭapiṇḍādibhirvā dṛṣṭimuttārya paścād dvātriṃśatsaṃkhyayā athavāṣṭottaraśatasaṅkhyayā mūlavidyāṃ japet | guhyātiguhyeti devyai japaṃ nivedayet | stotrasahasranāmādikaṃ paṭhitvā yonimudrayā namaskāraṃ kuryāt |
atha śaktipūjanam | svaśaktiṃ vā vīraśaktiṃ cāhūya svavāmabhāge trikoṇaṃ vidhāya tasyopari āvāhayet (-)
āyāhi varade devi maṇḍalopari satvaram | pūjāṃ gṛhāṇa deveśi tvatkṛpābhājanasya me |
ityāvāhya tasyāścaraṇakṣālanapūrvakaṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā haridrākuṅkumakajjalādibhirbhūṣayitvā tasyai mūlenābhimaṃtritaṃ śaktipātraṃ piśitasahitaṃ datvā tatra mantraḥ (-)
alipātramidaṃ tubhyaṃ dīyate piśitānvitam | svīkṛtya subhage devi jayaṃ dehi ripuṃ daha ||
ityanena mantreṇa nivedayet (-)
vatsa tubhyaṃ mayā dattaṃ pītaśeṣaṃ kulāmṛtam | tava śatruṃ haniṣyāmi sarvābhiṣṭaṃ dadāmyaham ||
ityanena mantreṇa tadavaśeṣaṃ svayamaṅgīkṛtya tasyā vastrakañcukī ābharaṇādikaṃ yathāśaktyā datvā namaskāraṃ kuryāt | iti śaktipūjanam | tataḥ kumāraṃ vaṭukarūpaṃ pūjayet | tataḥ kumārīṃ pūjayet |
atha gurupūjanam | tataḥ gurusannidhau cet tasya pūjādikaṃ vidhāya tasmai gurupātra nivedayet | tatra mantraḥ (-)
tataḥ śrī gururūpāya sākṣāt paraśivāya ca | karābhyāṃ pātramuddhṛtya sadvitīyaṃ samarpayet ||
ityanena nivedayet | sannidhau gururnāsti cet tatsthāne śreṣṭhaṃ pūrṇābhiṣekayuktaṃ ācāryaṃ pūjayet | ācāryo'pi nāsti cet sahasradalakamale gurupātrasthadravyeṇa śrīguruṃ triḥsantarpya svayaṃ gṛhṇīyāt | iti gurupūjanam |
tato vīrapūjādikaṃ vidhāya teṣāṃ śaṅkhodakena prokṣya tebhyaḥ pātrāṇi datyāt | tataḥ puṣpāñjaliṃ gṛhītvā mūlena stotreṇāthavā vaidikamantreṇa devyai puṣpāñjaliṃ samarpayet | pañcamudrābhirnamaskāraṃ kuryāt |
stambhanaṃ caturasraṃ ca matsyagokṣurameva ca | yonimudreyamākhyātā pañcamudrābhivādane ||
iti pañcamudrāḥ | atha kuladīpasamarpaṇam | vāmahaste sacaruṃ dīpaṃ gṛhītvā dakṣahaste pātraṃ gṛhitvā mūlamantramuccārya(-)
dehasthākhiladevatā gajamukhāḥ kṣetrādhipā bhairavā yoginyo vaṭukāśca yakṣapitaro bhūtāḥ piśācā grahāḥ | anye dikcara bhucarāścaravarā vetālagāstoyagā(-) stṛptāḥ syuḥ kulaputrakasya pibatāṃ pānaṃ sadīpaṃ carum ||
ityanena sacaruṃ dīpaṃ bhakṣayet | pātraṃ gṛhṇīyāt | iti kuladīpasamarpaṇam |
āvāhanaṃ na jānāmi na jānāmi ca pūjanam | visarjanaṃ na jānāmi kṣamyatāṃ parameśvari(!) || 1 ||
mantrahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ bhaktihīnaṃ ca pārvati(!) yatpūjitaṃ mayā devi paripūrṇaṃ tadastu me || 2 ||
tvamīśi viṣṇuścaturānanaśca tvameva bhaktiḥ prakṛtistvameva | tvameva sūryo rajanīpatiśca tvameva śaktiḥ prakṛtistvameva || 3 ||
tvameva mātā ca pitā tvameva tvameva bandhuśca sakhā tvameva | tvameva vidyā draviṇaṃ tvameva tvameva sarvaṃ mama devi devi || 4 ||
tvameva kartā karaṇasya heturgoptā vidhātā pralayastvameva | bhūtānyapi tvaṃ karaṇānyapi tvaṃ tvaṃ brahmavidyā hi tvameva cātmā || 5 ||
umā khyātā umā bhoktā umā sarvamidaṃ jagat | umā jayati sarvatra yadumā so'hameva ca || 6 ||
stuvato devatāṃ stutyānayā tuṣṭā prayacchati | aiśvaryamāyurārogyaṃ vidyāṃ kīrtiṃ śriyaṃ sukham || 7 ||
aparādhasahasrāṇi kriyante'harniśaṃ mayā | dāso'hamiti māṃ matvā kṣamasva parameśvari (!) || 8 ||
jñānato'jñānato vāpi yanmayā kriyate śive(!) | mama kṛtyamidaṃ sarvamiti mātaḥ kṣamasva me || 9 ||
iti bahudhā praṇatipūrvakaṃ kṣamāpya viśeṣārghyodakaṃ culukenādāya itaḥ pūrvaṃ prāṇabuddhidehadharmādhikārato jāgratsvapnasuṣuptitūryāvasthāsu manasā vācā karmaṇā hastābhyāṃ padbhyāmudareṇa śiśnā yatsmṛtaṃ yaduktaṃ yatkṛtaṃ tatsarvaṃ gurudevasamarpitaṃ tatsarvaṃ brahmārpaṇaṃ bhavatu ityanena devyāścaraṇāravindayossamarpayet | oṃ hrīṃ bhuvaneśvari kṣamasva iti tālatrayeṇa devīṃ prabodhya tejorūpāṃ tāṃ saṃhāramudrayā nirmālyapuṣpe tattejaḥ
samuddhṛtyāghrāya pūrakaprayogena sahasradalakamalaṃ prāpya tatra kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā suṣumṇāvartmanā aiṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ iti hṛdayakamalamānīya tatra dhyāyan (-)
oṃ hrīṃ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha pare sthāne svasthāne parameśvari (!) yatra brahmādayaḥ sarve surāstiṣṭhanti me hṛdi ||
iti hṛdayakamale sthāpayitvā tataḥ śāntistavaṃ paṭhet | taduktaṃ vāmakeśvaratantre (-)
oṃ naśyantu pretakūṣmāṇḍā naśyantu dūṣakā narāḥ | sādhakānāṃ śivāḥ santu āmnāyaparipālinām ||
jayantu mātaraḥ sarvā jayantu yoginīgaṇāḥ | jayantu siddhaḍākinyo jayantu gurupaṃktayaḥ ||
nandantu aṇimāsiddhyo nandantu bhairavādayaḥ | nandantu devatāḥ sarvāḥ siddhividyādharādayaḥ ||
ye amnāyaviśuddhaśca maṃtriṇaḥ śuddhabuddhayaḥ | sarvānandānandahṛdayā nandantu kulapālakāḥ ||
indrādyāstarpitāssantu tṛpyantu vāstudevatāḥ | candrasūryādayo devāstṛpyantu mama bhaktitaḥ ||
nakṣatrāṇi grahā yogāḥ karaṇādyāstathā pare | sarve te sukhino yāntu māsāśca tithayastathā ||
tṛpyantu pitaraḥ sarve ṛtavo vatsarādayaḥ | khecarā bhūcarāścaiva tṛpyantu mama bhaktitaḥ ||
antarikṣacarā ye ca ye cānyadevayonayaḥ | sarve te sukhino yāntu sarvā nadyaśca pakṣiṇaḥ ||
paśavastaravaściva parvatāḥ kandarā guhāḥ | ṛṣayo brāhmaṇāḥ sarve śāntiṃ kurvantu me sadā ||
śivaṃ sarvatra me cāstu putradāradhanādiṣu | rājānaḥ sukhinaḥ santu kṣemaṃ mārgaṃ tu me sadā ||
tīrthāni paśavo gāvo ye cānye puṇyabhūmayaḥ | vṛddhāḥ pativratā nāryaḥ śivaṃ kurvantu me sadā ||
śubhā me divasā yāntu mitrāṇi santu me śivāḥ |
sādhakā jāpinaḥ santu śivaṃ tiṣṭhantu pūjakāḥ ||
ye ye cāpadhiyaḥ svabhūṣaṇaratā mannindakāḥ pūjane | daivācāraviruddhanaṣṭahṛdayā duṣṭāśca ye bādhakāḥ | dṛṣṭvā cakramapūrvamandhahṛdayā ye kaulikadveṣakā(-) ste te yāntu vināśamatra samaye śrībhairavasyājñayā ||
dveṣṭāraḥ sādhakānāñca sadaivāmnāyadūṣakāḥ | ḍākinīnāṃ mukhe yāntu tṛptāstatpiśitaistu tāḥ ||
śatravo nāśamāyāntu mama nindākarāśca ye | dveṣṭāraḥ sādhakānāñca vinaśyantu śivājñayā ||
ye nindakāste vilayaṃ prayāntu ye sādhakāste prabhavantu siddhāḥ | sarvatra devīkaruṇāvalokāḥ puraḥ pareśī mama sannidhattām ||
iti śāntipāṭhaṃ paṭhitvā sarvān sāmayikān sāmānyārghyodakena abhiṣiñcayet | tato viśeṣārghyapātramuddhṛtya śirasi sthitāya śrīgurave samarpayet | tataḥ sāmayikaiḥ sārdhaṃ kauladharmādikaṃ kṛtvā yathāsukhaṃ viharet | tataḥ sarvocchiṣṭena ucchiṣṭamātaṅgībaliṃ dadyāt | tadyathā(-) klīṃ namaḥ ucchiṣṭacāṇḍāli mātaṅgi sarvavaśaṅkari svāhā iti maṃtreṇa svavāmabhāge trikoṇamaṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā tatra dhārāyuktabaliṃ nikṣipet | dhyānam(-)
dhyāyeducchiṣṭamātaṅgīṃ devīṃ lokaikamohinīm | vīṇāvādyavinodagītaniratāṃ nīlāṃśukollāsinīṃ bimboṣṭhīṃ navayāvakāddha(rdra)caraṇāmākīrṇanīlālakām | hṛdyāṅgīṃ navaratnakuṇḍaladharāmāraktabhūṣojvalāṃ mātaṅgīṃ praṇato'smi susmitamukhīṃ devīṃ śukaśyāmalām ||
iti dhyātvā pañcamudrābhirnamaskāraṃ kuryāt | sarvebhyastāmbūladakṣiṇādikaṃ dattvā visarjayet |
[iti pṛthvīdharācāryapaddhatiṃ śāradātilakaṃ nānātantramatamālambya śrīdā(-)īdevasampradāyinā mātṛpurasthitena anantadevena viracitāyāṃ bhuvaneśvarīkramacandrikāyāṃ pūjāvivaraṇaṃ nāma tṛtīyaḥ kalpaḥ] || oṃ || śrīgurudevārpaṇamastu ||
[śrīpṛthvīdharācāryapraṇītaṃ
laghusaptaśatīstotram]
(oṃ asya śrīlaghusaptaśatīstotramantrasya bhagavān sadāśiva ṛṣiḥ śirasi anuṣṭupchandase namo mukhe trimūrtirdevatā hṛdaye vāgbhavaṃ aiṃ bījaṃ māyā hrīṃ śaktiḥ śrīlakṣmīḥ kīlakaṃ mama caturvidhapuruṣārthe jape viniyogaḥ sarvāṅge ||
namo virañcervaravallabhāyai namostu te śaṅkaravallabhāyai | namoṣtu nārāyaṇavallabhāyai śrīcaṇḍikāyai śaraṇaṃ prapadye || 1 ||
brahmādayo devi bhajanti devā vasiṣṭhamukhyā ṛaṣayaśca sarve | sindūravarṇāṃ taruṇārkakāntiṃ śrīcaṇḍike(!) tvāṃ satataṃ smarāmi || 2 ||
sahasracandrārkasamānakāntiṃ bandhūkapuṣpāruṇapaṅkajābhām | dedīpyamānāgnisamanakāntiṃ śrīcaṇḍike(!) tvāṃ satataṃ smarāmi || 3 ||
śrīsiddhinātha (!) bhavato bhuvanaikabhartu(-) rbhāṣā parāmṛtamayī nigamāntarasthā | eṣā tvananyaśaraṇasya mamāśrutasya vṛttā nisargakaruṇāvaruṇālayasthā ||) (koṣṭhāntarvartī bhāgastu dvitīyapustake nopalabdhaḥ |)
oṃ namaścaṇḍikāyai (kh: śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ |)
yatkarma dharmanilayaṃ pravadanti (kh: kalayanti) tajjñā yajñādikaṃ tadakhilaṃ sakalaṃ tvayaiva | tvaṃ cetanā yata iti pravicārya cittaṃ nitye (!) tvadīyacaraṇau śaraṇaṃ prapadye || 1 ||
pāthodhināthatanayāpatireṣa śeṣa(-) paryaṅkalālitavapuḥ puruṣaḥ purāṇaḥ | tvanmohapāśavivaśo jagadamba(!) so'pi vyāghūrṇamānanayanaḥ śayanañcakāra || 2 ||
tvatkautukaṃ janani(!) yasya janārdanasya karṇaprasūtamalajau madhukaiṭabhākhyau | tasyāpi yau na bhavataḥ sulabhau nihantuṃ tvanmāyayā vikalitau vilayaṃ gatau tau || 3 ||
yanmāhiṣaṃ vapurapūrvabalopapannaṃ yannākanāyakaparākramajitvarañca | yallokaśokajananavratabaddhahārdaṃ talliyayaiva dalitaṃ girije(!) bhavatyā || 4 ||
yo dhūmralocana iti prathitaḥ pṛthivyāṃ (kh: prathitaprabhāvo) bhasmībabhūva caraṇe (kh: samare) tava huṅkṛtena | sarvāsurakṣayakṛte girirājakanye(!) manye svamanyudahane kṛta eṣa homaḥ || 5 ||
keṣāmapi tridaśanāyakapūrvakāṇāṃ jetuṃ na jātu sulabhāvapi caṇḍamuṇḍau | tau durmadau sapadi śambaratulyamūrtīṃ (kh: cāmbaratulyamūrte) mātastavāsikuliśātpatitau viśīrṣau || 6 ||
dautyena(kh: du(dau)tye ca) te śiva iti prathitaprabhāvo devo'pi dānavapateḥ sadanaṃ jagāma |
bhūyo'pi tasya caritaṃ prathayāñcakāra sā tvaṃ prasīda śivadūti vijṛmbhitaṃ te || 7 ||
citraṃ tadetadamarairapi ye na jeyāḥ śastrābhighātapatitādrudhirādaparṇe (!) bhūmau babhūvuramitāḥ pratiraktabījā(-) ste'pi tvayaiva gilitā gagane (kh: vadane) samastāḥ || 8 ||
āścaryametadakhilaṃ yadamū (kh: yadimau) surārī trailokyavaibhavaviluṇṭhanapuṣṭapāṇī | śastrairnihatya bhuvi śumbhaniśumbhasaṃjñau (kh: daityau) nītau tvayā janani(!) tāvapi nākalokam (kh: nākilokam) || 9 ||
tvattejasi pralayakālahutāśane'smin yasmin prayānti vilayaṃ bhuvanāni sadyaḥ | tasminnipatya śalabhā iva dānavendrā bhasmībhavanti hi bhavāni(!) kimatra citram || 10 ||
tat kiṃ gṛṇāmi (kh: raṇāmi) bhavatīṃ bhavatīvratāpa(-) nirvāpaṇapraṇayinīṃ (kh: saṃchedanapraṇayinīṃ) praṇamajjaneṣu | tat kiṃ gṛṇāmi bhavatīṃ bhavatīvratāpa(-) saṃvarddhanapraṇayinīṃ vimatasthiteṣu (kh: vipadi sthiteṣu) || 11 ||
vāme kare taditare ca yathopariṣṭāt (kh: tathopariṣṭāt) pātraṃ sudhārasabhṛtaṃ varamātuluṅgam | kheṭaṃ gadāñca dadhatīṃ bhavatīṃ bhavāni(!) dhyāyanti ye'ruṇanibhāṃ kṛtinasta eva || 12 ||
yadvāruṇātparamidaṃ jagadamba(!) yaste (kh: so'pi) bījaṃ smaredanudinaṃ dahanādhirūḍham | māyāṅkitaṃ tilakitaṃ taruṇendubindu(-) nādairamandamiha rājyamasau bhunakti || 13 ||
antaḥ sthitāpyakhilajantuṣu tanturūpā vidyotase bahirihākhilaviśvarūpā | kā bhūri śabdaracanā vacanātigāsi dīnaṃ janaṃ janani(!) māmava niḥprapañcam || 14 ||
āhāvahanaṃ yajanavarṇanamagnihotraṃ karmārpaṇaṃ tvayi visarjanamatra devi(!) mohānmayā kṛtamidaṃ sakalāparādhaṃ mātaḥ kṣamasva varade(!) bahirantarasthe(!) || 15 ||
etatpaṭhedanudinaṃ danujāntakāri caṇḍīcaritramatulaṃ bhuvi yastrikālam | śrīmān sukhī (kh: sadā) sa vijayī subhagaḥ kṣamaḥ (kh: kṣamī) syāt tyāgī cirantanavapuḥ kavicakravartī || 16 ||
śrīsiddhanāthāparanāmadheyaḥ śrīśambhunātho (kh: yaḥ śambhunātho) bhuvanaikanāthaḥ | tasya prasādāt sakalāgamācca (kh: sulabhāgamaśrīḥ) pṛthvīdharaḥ stotramidaṃ cakāra (kh: pustake etāvān pāṭhastvadhikaḥ(-) prathamā viṣṇumāyā ca dvitīyā cetanā tathā | buddhirnidrā kṣudhācchāyā śaktistṛṣṇāstathāṣṭamī || 18 ||
kṣāntirjātistathā lajjā śāntiḥ śraddha ca kāntikā | lakṣmīrvṛttiḥ smṛtiścaiva dayā dīptistathaiva ca || 19 ||
tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭistathā mātā bhrāntiḥ sarvātmikā tathā | trayoviśaṃtisaṃkhyātā yā devī gaṇitā śubhā || 20 ||
bhuktirmuktirna dūrasthā śuddhapāṭhavatāṃ nṛṇām || 21 ||
sabījapūraṃ sagadaṃ sakheṭaṃ sapānapātraṃ śayanaṃ cakāra | jayātaṭānte kṛtaye na liṅgī tannātha(!) nityaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye || 22 ||) || 17 ||
devyāḥ stavaṃ jñānamayaṃ kṛtaṃ yat pṛthvīdharācāryavareṇa samyak | yaccoddhṛtaṃ saptaśatīsthasāraṃ sarvānvitaṃ tannigamasya sāram (kh: pustake nāstyeṣa ślokaḥ) || 18 ||
[iti pṛthvīdharācāryaviracitaṃ laghusaptaśatīstotram] ||
